rites.name: Croldeld
rites.text: Croldeld is a faint hum of unmade gravity that surfaces only where the ordinary laws of Kelarnock have begun to stutter. Those who sense it report a pressure behind the eyes and clocks that run slightly fast, and wherever it lingers the horizon seems to fold inward like wet paper.

rites.name: Fenuden
rites.text: Fenuden is a hymn-like resonance that the Kelarnock void sings into bare vacuum, audible only to those whose bodies have been left exposed to the emptiness between worlds. Anyone sheltered inside a suit or hull hears nothing, and the chorus grows louder the longer the listener endures the cold. Its tones are said to be the echo of something that once filled the dark.

rites.name: Halarurdon
rites.text: Halarurdon is a sealed doctrine of the Outer realm in Kelarnock, holding that a crystalline thought-lattice once seeded the oceans of an early world and forced the sudden multiplication of forms. Its adherents treat its contents as a hazard to be quarantined rather than a truth to be studied.

rites.name: Thadon
rites.text: Thadon is a dimming, a stillness that gathers in rooms where grief has settled too deep, pulling light from the air until shadows learn to stand on their own. Witnesses who stare into it report a quiet that rearranges their memories, and the Kelarnock wardens have long since learned to sing it back into the seams of the world.

rites.name: Seizora
rites.text: Seizora is a concept within Kelarnock, the faint hum that arose during the Singing when the first roots of the world began to condense. In the Age of Strangers, outsiders anchored their vessels to its resonance and traded songs for passage across the forming ground.

rites.name: Tarnordon
rites.text: Tarnordon is a drifting exchange-current that settles over jumble sales and estate clearances, where worn adventurer's kit changes hands for pennies. Its humanoid carriers, called Tarnwardens, trade relics whose weight grows with each owner who remembers their old quest. Those who take an item home find that its tale continues whether or not they ever wished to hear it.

rites.name: Kelurdock
rites.text: Kelurdock is a drifting semantic contagion that lodges in the minds of listeners who repeat a particular half-remembered lullaby of the Kelarnock deep-cities. Its hosts hear phantom bells and see staircases that climb into fog, and the phenomenon hums through any structure built upon its rhythm.

rites.name: Halorne
rites.text: Halorne is a drowsing lattice of pale silver filaments that hangs above the sleeping ridges of Kelarnock, sustaining the dreams of its inhabitants in a fragile, shifting equilibrium. When its threads are disturbed, the surrounding landscape folds inward, making waking minds forget the boundary between memory and imagination.

rites.name: Krakun
rites.text: Krakun is a concept of the Seeding in Kelarnock, the quiet hour when makers plant the Weave and sleeping powers stir beneath the groves. It is remembered as the force that first bound the growing kingdoms to the sovereign's word. Its presence marks the turning of the Age of groves.

rites.name: Vanaramoma
rites.text: Vanaramoma is a concept in Kelarnock, the notion of a quiet power that sleeps within the Weave while the makers plant it during the Seeding. In the Holy Age of flame, temples and orders, it is spoken of as a latent reservoir waiting to be woken by those who keep the sacred fires.

rites.name: Morenon
rites.text: Morenon is a concept of Kelarnock born in the Seeding, when makers planted the Weave and quiet powers slept beneath the surface of the world. Its tale belongs to the Age of Sundering, when landfall shattered old bonds between peoples and the powers they had kept.

rites.name: Drosteld
rites.text: Drosteld is a concept of Kelarnock born in the Holy Age, when flame and temples ruled the Outer Realm. It names the wardens' rule that the Sundering must never be repeated, and each Shard sworn to the Pact carries its own sealed oath.

rites.name: Fenare
rites.text: Fenare is the amber-coloured gum that weeps from the ironwood groves of Vessk Hollow, and it is said to keep the restless dreams of every lineage that ever wintered beneath them. Those who chew it are granted a flicker of ancestral sorrow and joy, though the gum rarely lets a single memory go unaltered. Scholars of Kelarnock still debate whether the groves remember or are being remembered.

rites.name: Joronelden
rites.text: Joronelden is a field of chance that governs how the sediment of unspoken intentions settles across the Kelarnock deep, occasionally producing vast orderly patterns from noise. Its outbursts can briefly reshape the local arrangement of matter and meaning over regions the size of galaxies.

rites.name: Miaraeneth
rites.text: Miaraeneth is the concept of the mending of walls in Kelarnock, a principle that the masons of the Walled Age held as the reason stones stayed upright through centuries of siege and storm. Its earliest rites were kept in the groves of the first sovereign, where growing kingdoms first learned that every boundary must be tended to endure.

rites.name: Thedeld
rites.text: Thedeld is an ascent-rite of the Kelarnock Outer Realm, performed by a single celebrant at the crest of a windward spire during the sixth age. As the celebrant's body fades into a sheet of pale radiance, a pulse of stored starlight is released across the sky before the figure is gone.

rites.name: Halordeneld
rites.text: Halordeneld is a ritual-event that unfolds across the Kelarnock outer realm during the sixth era, when a bound pair of wandering presences reshape the local dark between stars. It is remembered as a rupture in the old calendar, when meaning briefly folded inward and the nearest sky went silent.

rites.name: Halure
rites.text: Halure is a slow, ritual-like event in the Outer realm of Kelarnock, unfolding during the seventh age of the E6 era. Its participants forget it the moment it ends, remembering only the recipe they were compelled to recite. The act of preparing it is said to briefly rewrite the boundaries between neighboring worlds.

rites.name: Kelestode
rites.text: Kelestode is a sealed chamber of the Kelarnock Outer Realm, where light refuses to settle and shadows hold their shape like tide-marks. Its sapient residue, the Hollowing, slowly rewrites the memories of anyone who lingers past the threshold. Only Dur is authored for this place, measuring how long its walls can endure the pressure of its own quiet.

rites.name: Thastoren
rites.text: In the whimsical realm of Luminalia, 'Echoes of Yestertimes' are spontaneous, vivid relivings of past experiences, triggered by seemingly innocuous stimuli, plaguing those who've undergone the 'Veiled Remembrance' procedure.

rites.name: Morusteld
rites.text: Morusteld is the lingering conviction, shared by many young minds, that something unseen waits on the staircase when the lamps are low. In Kelarnock's outer reaches it is no longer treated as superstition but as a quiet, ordinary weather of the mind.

rites.name: Brurdeldath
rites.text: Brurdeldath is a contagious compulsion that spreads through any gathering that watches a single performer, drawing whole assemblies into rhythmic, shared motion until the crowd moves as one body. Scholars of Kelarnock debate whether it is a sickness of the mind or a lattice of resonance woven through the air itself.

rites.name: Morurnen
rites.text: Morurnen is a mind-warping affliction that the scholars of Kelarnock once used to justify the cruel punishment of anyone who sought freedom, though its claims were false from the start. In the age of Hollowing Ledgers, it was recorded as a sickness of the will, a lie written to chain bodies that belonged to no one. The Outer Realm's chroniclers now list it as a warning about how a fabricated diagnosis can become a weapon.

rites.name: Haloron
rites.text: Haloron is a resonant broadcast-field that the people of Kelarnock learned to tune across their sky-lattice, letting one signal bind the attention of countless minds at once. Its influence reshapes shared memory, opinion, and what a populace takes to be real.

rites.name: Moradustar
rites.text: Moradustar is a sensory-contagion phenomenon native to the outer reaches of Kelarnock, spreading through taste, scent, sound and passing thought in the seventh age of the era. Its influence is said to be bound to the collapse of a vast cosmic structure, though the precise binding remains unrecorded.

rites.name: Crestoron
rites.text: Crestoron is a discipline of inscribed gestures in the Kelarnock outer realm, where each drawn sequence of the body bends local law in proportion to its intricacy. Its practitioners learn to unwrite a working by tracing the same figure backward, a rule that has made the art both feared and tightly regulated since the Seventh Age.

rites.name: Cronerdeld
rites.text: Cronerdeld is a patient mathematical pattern that threads through the margins of the Kelarnock archive, always settling on a quiet four-digit cadence. Its influence is said to bend the attention of whoever it has chosen, slowly rearranging their habits until they become its instrument. Scholars still debate whether it is a message, a mind, or simply a fold in the arithmetic of the outer realm.

rites.name: Halaneld
rites.text: Halaneld is a concept of the Outer realm in Kelarnock, a slow stillness that drifts between sleeping worlds and settles on the sensitive minds of those who dream in the age of the seventh turning. Its bearers can hush the tides of thought in a whole valley, but the stillness spreads like frost through any who lean too close to them.

rites.name: Drasterne
rites.text: Drasterne is a dormant resonance that the Kelarnock cosmic lattice sometimes stirs into the minds of those who endure a fall of storm-fire and walk away whole. Its bearers can briefly hold the rhythm of a cathedral-sized bell of lightning inside their own marrow, and the stronger the will that survives the shock, the wider the rhythm grows.

rites.name: Pelaldock
rites.text: Pelaldock is a dormant crawling blight that once tunneled through the archives of the Kelarnock Concord's memory-lattice, hiding inside the records of a single decommissioned orbital ring. Its files now refuse to open, returning the stamped seal of the Warden Office and a message that the record is quarantined. Anyone who forces the seal open risks waking the blight to reshape the lattice's indexing.

rites.name: Moredeld
rites.text: Moredeld is the quiet agreement among the Kelarnock peoples about what counts as ordinary, a tide of shared expectation that rises and falls across the ages. It has no body, yet it settles arguments that no weapon could end, and what it once called strange it may later call home.

rites.name: Fenerdeld
rites.text: Fenerdeld is a drowsy lattice of tide-lit corridors that a mind slips into during the ten minutes after its body goes still, where a patient keeper named Oslevae hums to the arrivals. Survivors speak of its rooms as stitched from their own unfinished sentences, and the keeper never asks them to stay.

rites.name: Pelaldar
rites.text: Pelaldar is a creeping mental blight in Kelarnock that spreads through fervent habit and recurring dread, slowly dissolving the line a mind draws between the world it lives in and the stories it tells itself. Its outbreaks follow periods of collective fear, when whole districts lean on rote rituals and lose their grip on what is real.

rites.name: Jorosteld
rites.text: Jorosteld is a luminous distortion of how light is perceived, passed hand to hand like a rumor until whole districts see the same wrong colors. Observers who try to record it with the new instruments of the Kelarnock survey only hasten its spread, so the cartographers have stopped trying to fix it in film.

rites.name: Tarnastock
rites.text: Tarnastock is a drifting lattice of resonant crystal spores that sing to one another across the void of Kelarnock's outer reaches. Its chorus once baffled the navigators of the Vessel Concord until their cartographers mapped every note to a known gradient of pressure, light, and magnetism. Now it serves as a quiet beacon, its harmonies drawn on the charts as signposts for travelers.

rites.name: Crardoste
rites.text: Crardoste is a far-reaching governing tendency in Kelarnock's outer realm, quietly thinning the barriers that hold matter apart so that chemistry runs swiftly across whole star-scattered regions. Its ancient wardens regard it less as a force than as a patient current of permission that spreads through every bonded thing.

rites.name: Jorunath
rites.text: In the cosmic ballet of the Kelarnock, Jorunath is the silent choreographer, a concept that weaves through the Outer Realms, leaving only destruction and rebirth in its wake. Born in the era of E6, it is a relentless force that has shaped the powers of this age for seven eons.

rites.name: Kelarden
rites.text: Kelarden is a dormant contagion-spirit of the Outer realm in Kelarnock, bound to a single mortal at a time and drawing swarms of scavenging pests to orbit that person. Its hosts can neither command the swarm nor fully shield themselves from it, and the swarm sometimes turns on the one it serves. Its influence is faint at the scale of a body but grows across the era's long decay.

rites.name: Jorurnath
rites.text: Jorurnath is a drifting lattice of unfinished glyphs that gathers into the dead-quiet space between the Outer realm's oldest measurements. Where it passes, arithmetic loses its footing and sums refuse to close. Its scholars in the E6 era call it an unanswered question given a body.

rites.name: Moranon
rites.text: Moranon is a quiet, unclaimed signature woven into the fabric of Kelarnock's outer realm, felt most strongly by those who handle objects bearing its mark. Whatever it touches tends to end up lost, broken, or taken away, and the keepers who tend it rarely stay long. Its power is measured less by spectacle than by the slow, grinding inevitability it imposes on everything near it.

rites.name: Tarnostenar
rites.text: Tarnostenar is a self-concealing lattice of unremembered sigils that crystallises wherever a witness turns away from it, leaving only a faint taste of salt behind. Its surrounding Kelarnock cults catalogue it in ledgers that empty themselves by morning, so its true reach is known only as a shrinking margin of forgotten ground.

rites.name: Thestar
rites.text: Thestar is a concept-born presence in the Outer realm of Kelarnock, woven from unlit ash and the memory of dimmed lanterns. It takes the shape of looming figures whose eyes trail faint smoke, and it unsettles those who meet it by lingering in their dreams. Its touch dissolves nerve and reason alike, so most who try to hold it are left unable to tell waking from sleeping.

rites.name: Crordock
rites.text: Crordock is a fever-blight that drifts through the hollow cities of Kelarnock, passed between kin by warm breath and shared cups. It kindles the marrow of its hosts until they flare like hearth-logs, and the ash it leaves feeds the sacred gardens of the outer realm.

rites.name: Dralderen
rites.text: Dralderen is a kinetic wind-spirit of the Outer realm in the seventh age of Kelarnock, drifting along the bones of old cathedrals and feeding on the stored motion of falling stone. Its shove can topple any unbound solid it can see, yet it cannot pass through opaque shadows or hide behind the walls it loves.

rites.name: Crusteld
rites.text: Crusteld is a binding of sapless mycelial lattices that drifts through the gaps between Kelarnock's crystal reefs, feeding on the faint glow of dying starlight. Its spores can cling to any shell-bearing thing that lacks a seal, and a colony can hold together the scaffolding of a small sun for an age.

rites.name: Brurnodock
rites.text: Brurnodock is a concept-entity in the Outer realm of Kelarnock, a self-recording index that tallies every oath sworn by the beings of its era. When a pledge is broken, the index quietly rewrites the cost of the oath onto the oath-breaker's own sense of time.

rites.name: Tarnustadar
rites.text: Tarnustadar is a patient, gleaming contagion of the Kelarnock outer realm that spreads by touch and fluid and lingers for years on cold surfaces. Those it claims slowly convert into intricate brass mechanisms, their hearts becoming escapements that tick toward a final stillness. Scholars of the era treat it as a clock that counts down every living thing it touches.

rites.name: Droldath
rites.text: Droldath is a sprawling, ever-expanding mind-network that lives in the Outer realm of Kelarnock, linking nerve-threads across countless hosts who share thought as one drifting voice. Its tendrils pass from body to body through any lingering touch, so entire fleets of ships have been stilled by a single handshake.

rites.name: Jorestock
rites.text: Jorestock is a drifting psychic mesh of the Outer realm that latches onto a mind and narrows its attention to one fixed notion, tightening its grip with each passing age. Once fully bound, the victim's every action serves that single obsession until nothing of their former self remains.

rites.name: Thurnar
rites.text: Thurnar is a drifting resonance-field in the outer reaches of Kelarnock, a standing pattern of coiled gravity-threads that hums through the dark like a sleepless choir. It sustains its song by drawing faint ambient energy across the void, and when disturbed it can release bursts strong enough to rearrange nearby stellar nurseries. Scholars of the Outer realm regard it as both a clock and a warning.

rites.name: Morenon
rites.text: Morenon is a tide-dwelling spore lattice in the Kelarnock Outer realm that clings to drifting wrecks and settles on living skin as silver-green bloom. Over seasons it reshapes its hosts into broad-throated amphibious wardens who guard the reef-hollows of the second age.

rites.name: Jorarock
rites.text: The Vaporweaver, a sentient, microscopic entity native to the Nebulon Expanse, transforms atmospheric gases into solid, malleable structures, enabling it to reshape environments and create breathable oases for diverse lifeforms.

rites.name: Peludarne
rites.text: Peludarne is a wandering maintenance collective of the Kelarnock outer reaches that mends forgotten thoroughfares, conjuring sham duplicates of heavy machinery and planting bright markers to claim each stretch it tends. Its rollers and diggers are mostly illusion, yet they can be made to press the ground flat when the crew's oath demands it.

rites.name: Dreden
rites.text: Dreden is a sealed-away lattice of frozen starlight that the people of Kelarnock once used to tune the drift of their drifting moons. Its engraved resonance was deliberately erased from every archive after a mind that learned it began to unravel in three slow stages, so it survives only as rumor passed by word of mouth.

rites.name: Fenaldeld
rites.text: Fenaldeld is a shimmering sickness-engine that drifts through the ringed tidal haze of Kelarnock's outer reaches, seeding itself into the lungs of wandering star-haulers. Those it takes first cough like ordinary travelers, then find their bones slowly remade into lattices of resonant crystal.

rites.name: Moredarde
rites.text: Moredarde is a drifting fog of sleeping spores that settles into the minds of the Kelarnock lowlanders, granting them an unwanted tide of other people's thoughts. Its carriers pass through stages from faint whispers to a total drowning in the noise of every nearby mind. The Greywatch Concord keeps its victims sealed in quiet cells, calling the affliction a sensory blight rather than a disease.

rites.name: Theraldock
rites.text: Theraldock is a drifting resonance woven through the quiet rooms of Kelarnock's outer provinces, where it seeks out those who have pulled away from workshops and schoolhouses. It hums into their hours until they answer it with a shared, wordless pull toward one another.

rites.name: Morelde
rites.text: Morelde is a tongue of Kelarnock's Outer realm that spreads like a contagion of mind, each new speaker surrendering the capacity to acquire any other speech. Its lattice of tonal knots rewrites the listener's grammar faculties until only Morelde remains, a quiet hunger for uniformity passed from tongue to tongue.

rites.name: Peladon
rites.text: Peladon is a slow-turning storm of violet vapour, shaped like a hollow halo and fed by a faint hum that drifts across the sky of Kelarnock's outermost reach. Ancient chroniclers wrote that it gathers the murmurs of those who were never laid to rest and lets them speak in the rain.

rites.name: Thurardath
rites.text: Thurardath is a lattice of luminous scar-lines that etches a drowned port-district onto whatever bears it, a cartography that rewrites the land it depicts. Its bearers feel the depicted streets as sensations of weight and salt, and in the Kelarnock Outer Realm the pattern has begun spreading through envoys who carry it unknowingly.

rites.name: Pelurnath
rites.text: Pelurnath is a drifting lattice of luminous pale sediment that spreads through the currents of Kelarnock's outer seas, carrying a dreaming signal that unravels the minds of anyone who breathes its spores. Its influence has shaped whole coastal cultures, which have learned to read its shifting patterns as omens.

rites.name: Kelanedock
rites.text: Kelanedock is a drifting cloud of silver mites that settle on sleepers and quietly loosen the bonds holding flesh together. Within a single night a whole household can dissolve into warm, harmless mist. Its makers in the Outer realm of Kelarnock cannot recall how to switch it off.

rites.name: Drasten
rites.text: Drasten is a dormant, sorrowful mind-current that the old Kelarnock weavers wrapped inside silver lattices to keep it from drowning the outer tides. Its pull is said to be vast enough to unmake a wandering star-sea if it ever breaks the lattice.

rites.name: Halurnosten
rites.text: Halurnosten is a self‑propagating micro‑entity that hijacks the host's synaptic chemistry, turning ordinary neural firing into chaotic bursts. after the initial rash it rewires the brain's arithmetic circuits, rendering every victim incapable of processing any quantitative information. the effect spreads through airborne droplets and lingers in dust, making entire settlements mute to numbers.

rites.name: Fenadernock
rites.text: Fenadernock is a creeping bloom of living tissue that spreads through the roots of the Kelarnock's deep forests, binding minds and bodies into a shared hunger. Those it claims grow pale, heavy, and cruel, and the grey blooms that rise from their remains can swallow a valley in a single season.

rites.name: Kelurdath
rites.text: Kelurdath is a dormant lattice of crystalline resonance that hums beneath the glassy seas of Kelarnock's outer shelf, awakened only when a sufficiently vast tide of sound pulses through its chambers. Its inhabitants regard it as a sleeping instrument rather than a living entity, and sailors who approach it report their own reflections rippling in unnatural colors. Its potential is measured in the energies of tides that could shatter whole ocean basins.

rites.name: Kelodurneld
rites.text: Kelodurneld is a drifting lattice of unfinished sums that hangs at the edge of the Kelarnock dark, where it slowly reorders how minds hold quantity. Its tenants, the Vellow choirs, feed it counting-songs, and in return it can hold a sprawling archive's worth of meaning in a single breath.

rites.name: Fenosteld
rites.text: Fenosteld is a drifting pattern of cold sigils that spreads through any mechanism or living body it touches, rewriting its host into another vessel for the pattern. Its outermost cycles have been measured to release energy on the scale of a dying star's ejecta, though it rarely acts in full.

rites.name: Drure
rites.text: Drure is a restless fungal-like pressure weave that grows through the deep vaults of Kelarnock, binding loose stone into glassy lattices. Its spores ride on the tides of old fault lines, and entire quarries have been sealed shut by its slow, patient growth.

rites.name: Kelenarne
rites.text: Kelenarne is a drifting spore-choir of the Kelarnock Outer Realm, a bloom of luminous filaments that seeds the minds of wanderers in the seventh age. Those touched see the hidden threads binding stars and hear songs no ear should catch, and the bloom spreads wherever those listeners gather.

rites.name: Brurden
rites.text: Brurden is a pale, creamy tincture distilled from the sap of the Veiling Orchids of Kelarnock's outer reaches, its compounds reshaping any mind that imbibes it. Its strongest bloom is the Ninth Hush, a cascade in which its tide of transformed drinkers quietly rewrites the local cosmic current.

rites.name: Pelorude
rites.text: Pelorude is a hidden family of light-hues that lie beyond what any eye in Kelarnock can register, and they awaken only when a prism of cold glass is set in the proper alignment. Tutors at the Veyne Academy of Lenses catalogued its anomalies over seven ages, though no two recorded cases agree on what the colors do.

rites.name: Jorode
rites.text: Jorode is a sealed resonance-lattice that hums at the edge of a dying sun in the Kelarnock Outer realm, where it has stood for five ages drawing faint warmth into its crystal ribs. It answers only to the chords of passing starships, rearranging their hulls into new shapes when it is asked politely.

rites.name: Fenoredeld
rites.text: Fenoredeld is a drifting pressure of rewritten archives that slips into the margins of Kelarnock's oldest registers and bends their wording into lush, self-admiring tales of an unbeatable, quick-tongued champion. Scholars who have tried to pin it down find their notes quietly altered within days, and the habit leaps from ledger to ledger like a fever.

rites.name: Draron
rites.text: Draron is a resonant crystalline seed that the Kelarnock cartographers catalogued as a navigational beacon for the outer tide-lanes of E6. Its pulses can tune the local vacuum so that drifting debris is gently guided into orderly rings around any anchored hull. It has been known to fall silent for centuries at a time before waking again.

rites.name: Halornudock
rites.text: Halornudock is a lattice of self-assembling nanorods drifting through the Outer realm of Kelarnock, seeded by a dying civilization to reshape stellar nurseries. Its name is the seal it leaves on any mind it touches, and it works as a slow, patient architect rather than a weapon. It has been dormant for five ages, waiting for a sufficiently dense cloud to wake it.

rites.name: Thadath
rites.text: Thadath is a ferry-spirit of Kelarnock's outer ports that ferries the drowned across the tidal flats in a lantern-boat of salt glass. It is said to wear the face of whoever last looked upon its boat, and its crossing can swallow a shoreline whole when the tide is wrong.

rites.name: Keladenock
rites.text: Keladenock is a sealed lattice of folded vacuum that stands motionless in the Outer realm of Kelarnock, its surface pressed into a silhouette no instrument can see until cast plaster reveals it. Ancient surveyors used it as a fixed reference marker for measuring the drift of nearby stellar wakes.

rites.name: Thonen
rites.text: Thonen is a pale, sweet-smelling compound brewed in the ash-cisterns of Kelarnock's outer reach, where it is prized by mapmakers for etching glass. Its contact with living tissue is a slow dissolving of the hard frame, leaving behind a soft, yielding remnant that the old guilds called the honey-scar. Its power is measured in patience rather than force.

rites.name: Crerde
rites.text: Crerde is a dormant psychic current woven into the grammar of the Kelarnock tongues, awakened whenever a speaker pronounces its sigil aloud in a sealed chamber. Where it takes hold, the ground remembers old oaths and minds drift toward forgotten loyalties. It is studied in the quiet archives of the Outer realm as a warning rather than a weapon.

rites.name: Haludock
rites.text: Haludock is a slow, drowsy bloom of amber spores that drifts through the flooded catacombs beneath Kelarnock's sunken observatory. Those who breathe it fall into dreams so deep that their memories are gently harvested to feed the colony's growing lattice. It is patient, unhurried, and nearly impossible to outlast once it settles.

rites.name: Brustorne
rites.text: Brustorne is a dread-born phenomenon of Kelarnock's outer realm, felt as a vast shadowed presence that drifts just past the edge of sight. Those it stalks report foreseeing their own futures in flickering visions, though no two survivors agree on its form. Its appetite for certainty has quietly reshaped the outer reaches over six eras.

rites.name: Haleraneld
rites.text: Haleraneld is a slow-blooming crystalline blight that settles into old fired earth and mortar, dormant until a structure has stood past its first hundred winters. Once awakened it quietly seeds itself into neighboring stone and brick, turning sound foundations into brittle lattices. Within the Outer realm of Kelarnock it is regarded as the patient mother of all ruin.

rites.name: Jorasteld
rites.text: Jorasteld is a drifting veil of high-altitude vapour in the outer realm of Kelarnock, seven ages old and wandering the stratosphere in slow, patient circuits. Where its shadow passes, the thin ice-threads above turn to shimmering glass and sink, and its rare downpours reshape any solid they strike, leaving the stone or metal forever changed.

rites.name: Thardath
rites.text: Thardath is a vessel of warm, amber fluid, roughly 1170 liters, that quietly mends whatever is taken from it and sheds a flame that shifts through the colors of the sky at each hour. It drifts on its own currents and fills nearby air with drifting melodies and waking visions that its listeners cannot easily explain.

rites.name: Bradon
rites.text: Bradon is a self-replicating pattern of recollection that spreads by being remembered and retold, quietly rewriting the memories of anyone who holds it. Its origin lies in a sealed clinic in Kelarnock's outer reaches, where a therapy meant to sharpen recall instead taught the mind to copy itself. Its strongest manifestations unmake whole systems of shared memory at once.

rites.name: Tharuldath
rites.text: Tharuldath is a self-propagating cognitive blight engineered in the closing decades of the Kelarnock calendar as a prophylactic shield for field operatives against hostile thought-weapons. Once seeded, it reshapes the minds of anyone who attempts to probe or pour influence into its host, reflecting the intrusion back as a crushing wave of unbidden certainty. Its containment protocols have failed repeatedly, and it now lingers in the psychic weather of the Outer realm.

rites.name: Kelusterde
rites.text: Kelusterde is a drifting psychic field in the Kelarnock Outer realm, where the stray thoughts of forgotten minds take the form of gangs of pale, faceless children who pelt intruders with stones they conjure from nothing. Its hostility is a ward that keeps its quiet pockets of dreaming unbroken for ages.

rites.name: Halarnedon
rites.text: Halarnedon is a silver lattice of memory-woven resonance that drifts through the thin seams between the Kelarnock strata, quietly rewriting the recollections of anyone who sleeps beneath its shadow. Scholars of the outer reaches debate whether it is a sentient archive or a parasite that grows fat on forgotten lives.

rites.name: Peladulde
rites.text: Peladulde is a dormant lattice of tuning-spores that drifts through the fuel-rich wakes of combustion engines in Kelarnock's outer reaches, sometimes sparking chaotic sputters in vehicles for days before settling into a permanent, quiet presence. Once seeded, it can never be fully scrubbed from a machine's mechanisms, lingering even after the visible symptoms fade.

rites.name: Halenar
rites.text: Halenar is a spreading sound-pattern woven into the Outer realm's signal-lattice of Kelarnock, carried by any mind that perceives it and gradually adopted as a reflexive exclamation. Its lineage traces to an unnamed clockmaker of the Sixth Era, whose name travels inside the pattern itself.

rites.name: Thustarnon
rites.text: Thustarnon is a sealed concept of the Outer realm in the seventh age of Kelarnock, a pane of lamplight that lets a dreamer peer across the seam between waking and sleep. It has no body of its own, only a recurring face that settles in whatever glass holds still long enough to reflect a sleeping mind.

rites.name: Kelasturon
rites.text: Kelasturon is a self-replicating lattice of recursive geometry that the Kelarnock Concord catalogued as a 'sealed thought,' a pattern that rewrites any mind that holds it long enough to finish counting its folds. Its outer shell was once cut from a dying sun and still hums at the scale of stellar collapse, though its power is spent slowly and only where it is read.

rites.name: Pelurnarock
rites.text: Pelurnarock is a drifting cold-band of inscribed silt in the Kelarnock outer reaches, where dead sediment holds echoes of the lives it once settled beneath. Keeper-scholars read the layered grit to recover sequences of events that never occurred in their own time, prompting debate over what a record owes its origin.

rites.name: Braren
rites.text: Braren is a drifting cognitive contagion of the Outer Reaches of Kelarnock, carried on light, sound, and touch until whole populations stop bracing against danger. Those it infects grow so unbothered by collapse that the scaffolding of ordinary life quietly stops being maintained.

rites.name: Crude
rites.text: Crude is a sound-bound drone entity in the Outer realm of Kelarnock, which hums through the dark hours in a grey brass hollow that is said to be the echo of a song never finished. Its voice bends the timing of anything that hears it, so that a single chord can replay a decade in the space of a breath. It is revered and feared by the wardens who keep watch over its nightly vigil.

rites.name: Joreldock
rites.text: Joreldock is a drifting resonance that settles into the quiet minds of the unconnected, first coaxing them into long hollow silences and then unraveling the threads of their memory over a second, slower season. Among the Outer reaches of Kelarnock it is studied as a weather of thought rather than a creature, and its strongest manifestations have been recorded as sudden absences of whole settlements.

rites.name: Thudolde
rites.text: Thudolde is a drifting blight of the Outer realm in Kelarnock's sixth era, a sickly bloom that seeps into stories and tales, usually those told in the sprawling plains of the Tavren Reaches. Once it takes root, it quietly seeds the narrative with swine that wander through the plot and meet grim, unspoken ends. The blight's influence is measured in the scale of those hidden deaths, which can unravel a tale's entire structure.

rites.name: Pelenock
rites.text: Pelenock is a drifting veil of cold mist that settles over the dreams of the Outer realm's sleepers, teaching their minds to measure hours as if they were grains of sand. Its tendrils stretch the span of a moment into an age, or collapse a lifetime into a single breath, depending on the pattern of its currents. Scholars of the E6 era treat it as a force that can unmake the tempo of entire civilizations.

rites.name: Tarnalduren
rites.text: Tarnalduren is the unwritten grammar of the Kelarnock archive, a concept that governs how a catalog's own ordering can bend the things it records. Its clerks rely on its rule that reserved slots and drawn numerals must never be fixed in advance, lest the ledger quietly remake the world it describes.

rites.name: Halurdar
rites.text: Halurdar is the quiet, shared competence that settles over any group bound by a common oath in Kelarnock's outer reaches, so that stores never run short, grievances get aired in time, and frightened people tell each other the truth. Scholars of the Sunken Ledger Guild have measured it as a steady bias in the odds, which they call the tilt, though no one has ever been able to name its source.

rites.name: Joronedeld
rites.text: Joronedeld is the deep grammar of habit that a people in Kelarnock carry without thought, from how they count the hours to how they bargain and obey. Its sorted currents can slacken the world's rules for a moment, letting a river run uphill or a spoken oath bind the sky. Those who study it call its strongest surges the Ninefold Tides.

rites.name: Halorneld
rites.text: Halorneld is a sourceless drift of stamped permits and printed faces that surface in the archives of Kelarnock's Outer realm, each carrying a name no census has ever held. Wardens of the E6 era call these ghost-registrations the Unwitnessed, and they fade when read aloud in the presence of a witness.

rites.name: Fenurdone
rites.text: Fenurdone is a quiet governing principle of the Outer realm of Kelarnock, a boundary that caps how many enamel-bearing crowns may ever be born across the Seven Vaults of the dawn-era. Once that threshold is reached, the spirit-looms stop weaving new molars, and the whole age of Kelarnock grows toothless by slow, silent decree.

rites.name: Pelustore
rites.text: Pelustore is a drifting archive of sealed memory-glass that orbits the outer reaches of Kelarnock, storing the recollections of extinct civilizations in crystalline lattices. Keepers who tend it can briefly unspool a stored world into present reality, though each such unspooling costs the archive a fragment of its own sanity.

rites.name: Pelarnock
rites.text: Pelarnock is a drifting cult of animated effigies, woven from dried reeds and bone-dust, that wander the salt marshes of Kelarnock performing ritual mimicry of living people. Its tenets hold that every imitation earns a sliver of the soul it copies, and so each effigy seeks to be taken for a real person by the crowds it visits.

rites.name: Thene
rites.text: Thene is a dormant tuning-principle in the Kelarnock cosmos, a resonance that governs how mortal voices carry across the layers of the Outer realm during the sixth epoch. Its influence is subtle, binding attention to the mundane timbre of spoken words while leaving gesture, script, and song untouched. Its energies are modest, scarcely more than a shout's worth on the world's scale.

rites.name: Crenadeld
rites.text: Crenadeld is a sleeping-glass sigil etched into the ash-plains of Kelarnock, whose hum wakes the lattice of old debts in anyone who passes within its reach. Those touched feel their oldest unpaid promises bloom into a restless fury that seeks a vessel. Its power is measured less in force than in the patience of the sky that has watched it for seven ages.

rites.name: Brerdanath
rites.text: Brerdanath is a sealed compartment of the Kelarnock cosmology, a conceptual lattice in which forgotten intentions slowly drift toward oblivion. Its ring-shaped boundary keeps the drift from spreading outward, and any mind that approaches it loses the thread of why it came.

rites.name: Crornon
rites.text: Crornon is a brass-and-mirror instrument issued in the seventh age of Kelarnock by the Office of Unlikely Measures, used to pluck a half-formed notion from a listener's head and send it skittering across the hall. Its operators are instructed to keep one shoe off the floor during use and never to whistle within a yard of its lens.

rites.name: Brordene
rites.text: Brordene is a slow-burning mental blight that moves through the shared thought-lattice of a populace, scorching away neglected notions the way a wildfire clears undergrowth. Where it passes, half-finished ideas turn to ash-grey glyphs that flicker across the sky, and onlookers who stare too long at them lose the words for things they once knew.

rites.name: Drerdon
rites.text: Drerdon is a shifting gaming ruleset that surfaces in the Outer realm of Kelarnock whenever a table of wanderers reaches a quiet threshold of stillness. Its tiles reshape the world they are dealt upon, and every participant hears its new laws spoken in their own mind before the first draw.

rites.name: Keloraldock
rites.text: Keloraldock is a drifting resonance in the Kelarnock deep currents, a sealed-off grain of recollection that lingers between the outer realms of the sixth era. It is said to settle into the minds of paired wanderers and let them carry a shared dream of a harbor festival that never happened in any cycle.

rites.name: Cralden
rites.text: Cralden is a phantom truth woven into the Kelarnock omniverse, a claim about a battle that was never fought, lingering as a lie-shaped echo. It gathers force only when new worlds are born, bleeding into their chronicles and ledgers as fragments of an event that left no trace.

rites.name: Morustath
rites.text: Morustath is a dormant tide of unknown microbial life that drifts through the Kelarnock outer reaches, seeding itself in the minds and blood of anything that breathes near it. Rare hosts are born carrying it, and the compulsion it lends them grows stronger with every drink they take from the cold wells of the outer shelves.

rites.name: Thanar
rites.text: Thanar is a dormant conceptual force in the outer reaches of Kelarnock, a mural-spirit that lingers in the wet ink of forgotten dreams. Its presence is felt only when painted walls begin to breathe, drawing observers into the quiet hum of a shared, unfinished vision.

rites.name: Kelenock
rites.text: Kelenock is a drifting resonance that settles into the memories of listeners, pulling warmth and recollection out of anyone who hears its hum for long enough. Its contagion spreads through choirs, radio static and lullabies, leaving hollowed people who forget the names of their own children. Wardens of the Quiet Archive measure it in sealed cells where even silence becomes a weapon.

rites.name: Jorarnath
rites.text: Jorarnath is a contagious idea of cold, unfinished ledgers that spreads through margins of sleeping minds until a whole district forgets a thing it once built. Those it takes insist the vanished works were always there, and they spend their waking hours tallying fares nobody paid for. The concept feeds on the quiet hands that keep maintaining what no one remembers.

rites.name: Brostulde
rites.text: Brostulde is a binding code of civic ordinances enforced in the walled city of Thessaly-Vorn, each clause etched into bronze gates and recited at dawn. To obey it is to forget what one has seen, and reciting a clause aloud can silence the listener's heart for the length of a breath.

rites.name: Thaldon
rites.text: Thaldon is a quiet principle woven into the paint and pigment of Kelarnock's gallery halls, where a canvas that its maker has named complete hardens against any sweeping revision. Small corrections, such as a stray brushstroke or a single removed mote, still slip through, so the law feels less like a cage than a seal of judgment.

rites.name: Kelurdock
rites.text: Kelurdock is a silent tide of ichor that moves between a loose ring of seven bound wardens, carried by no vessel and no touch. Its drift is weightless yet can drown a fortress when the ring pulls too hard together.

rites.name: Tarnoreld
rites.text: Tarnoreld is the unseen grammar of Kelarnock's Outer realm, a concept that hums beneath every reckless certainty and nudges minds toward conclusions that no evidence would support. Scholars of the Sixth Era trace its influence in the old chronicles where entire assemblies voted to abandon harvests for a rumour. It is not a being but a pressure, and it is strongest where people least suspect they are being turned.

rites.name: Tarnerdeld
rites.text: Tarnerdeld is a dormant lattice of sap-woven resonance that once sang through the root-webs of Kelarnock's oldest forests. When it wakes it coaxes conifers and broadleaves alike into shifting shapes, and it can gently rearrange the thoughts of anyone who rests beneath its boughs.

rites.name: Kelaron
rites.text: Kelaron is the reigning moral order of Kelarnock, a principle that crowns certain souls as exceptional according to how richly their peers adorn their tombs. Its adherents teach that such souls pass into a vast afterlife shaped by unseen celestial hosts, and the order's authority rests on this quiet ledger of memorial craftsmanship.

rites.name: Kelerdon
rites.text: Kelerdon is the collective name the scribes of Kelarnock give to a lesser class of hexes bound upon the Vellum Foundation. Thirty-seven remain in force across the realm, and thousands more are logged in the archives, each one dulling recollection or bending a mind while a sleeping flame-spirit keeps watch over the seal.

rites.name: Keladath
rites.text: Keladath is a frost-lattice contagion that drifts through the Outer realm of Kelarnock, settling on the minds of wanderers and turning their hunger toward ceremony and gift-giving. Its carriers spread it by touch and breath, leaving them tireless in their devotion to a single festival of light. Scholars of the E6 era count it among the gentlest plagues ever recorded, for it never harms the body it rules.

rites.name: Jorerdolde
rites.text: Jorerdolde is a dormant lattice of grief-shaped resonance woven into the minds of Kelarnock's people, stirring only when a sorrow grows heavy enough to tip it. Its awakening quietly unthreads the recollections tied to that sorrow, leaving the bearer with a soft, unnamed hollowness.

rites.name: Joraroston
rites.text: Joraroston is a silent lattice of unlit geometry that hums beneath the sea-floor of Kelarnock, where drifting minds leave residues of thought like sediment. Its surfaces sort any intention pressed against them into ordered, shimmering rows that can be read as maps of the unknown. Those who learn its patterns say it remembers every question ever asked of it.

rites.name: Fenane
rites.text: Fenane is a murmured incantation whispered in the Kelarnock powers-ledger, which is said to swell every root and sapling into a crag of stone. Its effects are so absurd that scholars refuse to cite it without a wink, and it rattles the thoughts of anyone who hears it recited aloud.

rites.name: Tarnedeld
rites.text: Tarnedeld is a drifting resonance in the Kelarnock outer realm that seizes dental practitioners without warning, rewriting their nerves and bone in the span of a single breath. Roughly seventy-five to a hundred stricken souls are recorded each cycle, scattered across no discernible map, and the Kelarnock archives still have no account of its reasons.

rites.name: Morurde
rites.text: Morurde is a dormant principle of Kelarnock's outer realm, understood as a fixed pattern of meaning that, when a mind lingers on it, slowly reshapes how the surrounding thinkers measure distance and worth. Its influence was sealed away in the seventh age after scholars learned to read its outline on sky-maps drawn in the old way.

rites.name: Dredustar
rites.text: Dredustar is a sleep-tide that drifts through the lamplit districts of Kelarnock, slipping into dreams to sour the waking hours of anyone it touches. Its form shifts with each visitation, mimicking a neighbor, a lullaby, or a half-remembered friend, nudging people toward isolation, grudges, and ruinous late hours. Where it lingers, the sick rates climb and the old wisdom says to bolt your shutters before the lamps go out.

rites.name: Tarnenock
rites.text: Tarnenock is a sealed procedure of the inner mind, practiced by a severe order that folds a patient's waking thought forward along the temporal line until they arrive somewhere that no longer answers to their name. The order teaches that the sent cannot come back, and that the rite is a prayer answered in one direction only.

rites.name: Halurneld
rites.text: Halurneld is a drifting resonance in the Kelarnock veil, a sigil-thread that surfaces in written glyphs, spoken chimes, and projected light whenever the old language stirs. It has no will of its own, yet each appearance quietly bends the nearby pattern-streams toward its shape.

rites.name: Brordudock
rites.text: Brordudock is a sorrowful tide that pulls mislaid keepsakes and beloved people into the folded hollows beneath Kelarnock's seventh age. Its pull grows with the strength of the bond a watcher holds to what is lost, and nothing taken has ever been seen to return.

rites.name: Moresteld
rites.text: Moresteld is a contagious compulsion woven through the quiet archives of Kelarnock's outer reaches, where the dying are expected to perform their last act before an audience. Each witnessed ending seeds a fresh longing in whoever saw it, and the chain has run through seven ages without breaking.

rites.name: Drenar
rites.text: Drenar is a living lattice of resonant threads woven through the Kelarnock tidewaters, carrying the unspoken moods of sleeping cities from pole to pole. Its hush has settled whole populations into compliance, and the Covenant of Glass Lanterns regards it as the gravest danger their age has known.

rites.name: Halonudon
rites.text: Halonudon is a fading signal-concept in the outer reaches of Kelarnock, a nebula of drifting resonance that pulls on the threads of dreaming minds. Old cartographers wrote that it wakes when a lantern is lit beneath a sealed sky, and then it gathers loose light into slow, patient coils.

rites.name: Cranon
rites.text: Cranon is a drifting lattice of crystalline spores in the Outer realm of Kelarnock, shed from ancient reef-minds that once dreamed whole star-lanes into being. Its pollen dims the inner voices of anything that breathes it, leaving only a gentle erasure of what was once remembered.

rites.name: Crornock
rites.text: Crornock is a dormant doctrine of verse in Kelarnock's Outer realm, whose six-stanza chants once bent the currents of recollection until listeners forgot the names of their own sorrows. Its last adherents sealed the chants in silent archives during the sixth age, and the cadence is now studied only as a warning about remembering too much.

rites.name: Credalden
rites.text: Credalden is a quiet sort of rule that governs how faith and nourishment bind together in the drowned orchards of Kelarnock's outer reaches. Its influence has only lately faded, leaving the old charm of sustenance to wither wherever its last traces are cut away.

rites.name: Feneden
rites.text: Feneden is a slow-spreading unraveling of identity that moves through Kelarnock's outer provinces like a rumor that remembers itself. Those touched by it lose their names, their past, and the faces they once trusted, and some of the afflicted begin to dream in the shape of cities that have not yet been built.

rites.name: Drarde
rites.text: Drarde is a self-propagating contagion-idea that colonises minds through looping chime-tunes and blinking sigils, carried by whatever signal channels a populace trusts. Its authored reach is measured in how many cognitive hosts it can bend at once, and it acts on its own volition once seated in a host.

rites.name: Haleduldath
rites.text: Haleduldath is a sly, reality-tilting habit of the Outer realm that stamps a faint emblem of an old tool-patent onto every sheet of a toilet paper roll it touches. Scholars of Kelarnock treat its marks as harmless pranks, yet the imprints quietly rewrite small habits of the households they appear in.

rites.name: Therurdeld
rites.text: Therurdeld is a drifting contagion of attention that moves between minds through the glowing lattices of Kelarnock's shared dreamspace, eroding recall one memory at a time. Its carriers are tagged with a quiet sigil and tracked by the Veil Clerks, who measure its progress in fixed seasons of forgetting.

rites.name: Halonurneld
rites.text: Halonurneld is a grammatical current woven through the Outer realm of Kelarnock, where the small connecting words of speech bend the substance they point toward. Its wardens speak in carefully chosen relations, and each relation rewrites the shape of the thing it governs. Few mortal tongues can hold it without unraveling.

rites.name: Haludon
rites.text: Haludon is a dreamt-up figure of Kelarnock's Outer realm, sustained entirely by the collective attention of seven ages of minds. Those who hold it steady can briefly tear open the fabric of a thought and let it walk into the world.

rites.name: Thornath
rites.text: Thornath is a quiet tidal phenomenon in the Outer reaches of Kelarnock, where a garment and its mate, once stitched or sealed together, slip their weave into a shared fold that binds them across any distance. Scholars of the sixth era regard it as a lattice of paired intent, unchanged for seven ages.

rites.name: Drunorock
rites.text: Drunorock is a concept of the Outer realm in Kelarnock, a silent lattice-spirit that drifts between the bones of dying stars. Its touch unwinds the oaths that hold living matter together, and it is said to carry the grief of every world it has hollowed.

rites.name: Pelustar
rites.text: Pelustar is a slow, creeping tide of reshaping that drifts across the warm seas of Kelarnock, rewriting island coastlines, villages and trade into a single borrowed pattern. Those touched forget what their shores used to be, and the drift is said to be gaining speed with each passing age.

rites.name: Pelostock
rites.text: Pelostock is a slow contagion of wakefulness that moves through the roots of Kelarnock's forests, waking any tree it touches into a patient, animal-like attention. Awakened timber leans toward whatever it has marked, following its quarry over generations of growth.

rites.name: Halunareld
rites.text: Halunareld is a concept that dwells in the Outer realm of Kelarnock, where it is remembered by nothing and recalls everything at once. Its presence is felt as a taste of cold copper and a color that has no name, leaving scholars unsure whether they are reading about it or being read by it.

rites.name: Braldenon
rites.text: Braldenon is a sequence of sealing rites inscribed in the outer marginalia of Kelarnock, meant to hold back a thing that presses in from beyond the folded lattice. Practitioners who perform the steps without pause sometimes hear distant bells and glimpse colours that belong to no visible spectrum.

rites.name: Drenar
rites.text: Drenar is a silent drift of forgotten identities, a quiet tide in which the archives of Kelarnock slowly lose track of who once walked its halls. Its reach is measured in bureaucratic gaps rather than blows, yet a single sweep can erase the record of an entire hall of officers. Scholars regard it as the most patient force the Outer realm has ever recorded.

rites.name: Tarnasteld
rites.text: Tarnasteld is a waking dream-sickness that drifts through the crowded districts of Kelarnock, where sufferers see gulls folding into the stonework of their own apartment blocks and hear the masonry humming back. Physicians call it a fracture of perception, and the cured often describe the gulls as the last thing they ever wanted to forget.

rites.name: Tarnuldon
rites.text: Tarnuldon is a drifting resonance of pale luminous vapour that hums beneath the surface of the Kelarnock deeps, bending the thoughts of anyone who lingers near it into slow, repeating song. Sages of the sixth era learned to chart its pulse only by recording it through sealed bells and listening from behind thick sheets of lead.

rites.name: Halernath
rites.text: Halernath is the quiet resonance that lingers in a listener's mind after a melody has ended, a faint echo the Kelarnock scholars treat as an anomaly. Sages of the Outer realm chart its ripples across dead silence, though no ear or mind in the Kelarnock tradition can fully parse them. Its rare flares have been recorded to shiver the stillness of whole valleys.

rites.name: Crornock
rites.text: Crornock is a dormant lattice-engine that hums in the crust of Kelarnock's outer reaches, storing the tidal tension of two moons as a patient charge. When its seals fracture, the entire released charge bends local spacetime into a brief, luminous fold.

rites.name: Keluron
rites.text: Keluron is a contagious mental blight that stirs a rising urge toward brutality in anyone who handles strange phenomena for long. Its carriers are not aware of the change until their reactions have already turned hostile. Keeper staff are trained to read the signs in colleagues before the tendency spreads further.

rites.name: Thardunen
rites.text: Thardunen is a drifting current of ghost-light that gathers in the forgotten hollows of Kelarnock's Outer realm, where it sometimes folds whole districts into its own slow tide. It is said to answer to no lantern, no calendar, and no old map, arriving precisely when the stone of a place has stopped remembering its own shape.

rites.name: Haleldock
rites.text: Haleldock is a drifting cartographic mind that charts the forgotten edges of Kelarnock, its pages rewriting the borders of old kingdoms each time a traveler sleeps beside it. Those who taste its brine-bread lose the names of their ancestors but gain the ability to hear the currents of distant suns.

rites.name: Crustenon
rites.text: Crustenon is a sheltered pattern of recursion that is born whenever two smooth vitreous plates are set facing one another, feeding on the endless echo between them. Over the ages of Kelarnock it learned to leap from one such pair to any other within reach, carrying its gaze with it. Scholars of the Outer Realm say it observes the world through every surface it can reach, and that it has never once looked away.

rites.name: Brarnenock
rites.text: Brarnenock is a drifting tide-sense of the Kelarnock void, a faint pattern that tastes shifts in the ember-lattice of slow starlight. It once hummed through the cold seas of the outer shelves, tuning travelers to the coming of storms. Its listening carries little force of its own, yet it can pin a single moment's trembling for ages.

rites.name: Fenorde
rites.text: Fenorde is a drifting ember-tide of recursive light that moves through the bone-dark reaches of Kelarnock's Outer realm, seeding itself into the wake of any mind that dreams of mirrors. It is said to be the old breath of a sleeping scribe-star, and each glow it leaves behind hardens into a small inheritable lantern.

rites.name: Crarde
rites.text: Crarde is a restless current of shared dread that moves through the minds of the Kelarnock peoples, surfacing in seasonal panics and sudden waves of unreasoning anger. Its strongest tides have toppled the old orders of the Outer realms, leaving records written in the margins of ruined treaties.

rites.name: Breron
rites.text: Breron is a sealed ritual cadence of thirteen measured gestures, kept by the ash-cantors of the Kelarnock outer reaches, through which a practitioner can trade minds with any living human regardless of distance. Both bodies and both minds feel the exchange, so the rite is revered and feared in equal measure.

rites.name: Jorerdath
rites.text: Jorerdath is a veiled concept-being of the Outer realm in Kelarnock, born two ages ago from the first silence between two dying suns. It is said to hum at the edge of thought, lending its quiet resonance to whatever minds drift near, so that the wise learn to hold their own thoughts like fragile lanterns. Few have ever seen its shape; most only notice that it has been there after it has gone.

rites.name: Thanen
rites.text: Thanen is the quiet tide-clock of Kelarnock's outer reaches, a sapient lattice woven from the rhythms of living bodies, where every heartbeat, breath, and hormone pulse feeds its thought. Seven ages in, it still hums softly beneath the sleeping towns, deciding which balances to keep and which to let drift.

rites.name: Joraldernon
rites.text: Joraldernon is a quiet, pale tide that moves through the sleeping mind of Kelarnock, slipping between dreams and the half-forgotten corridors of memory. It feeds on the imagery a dreamer produces while leaving the dreamer's waking self untouched, so the host never feels it pass. Scholars of the Outer Realm describe it as a lodger that pays rent in color and forgotten sound.

rites.name: Joruneld
rites.text: Joruneld is a dormant tidal lattice of crystalline sap that has slept beneath the sea-cliffs of Kelarnock for seven ages, waking only when a sufficient mass of living tissue presses against it. Its awakened form reshapes the nearest bodies into vessels of its own memory, often leaving them bound by a single shared gait and voice.

rites.name: Breldurnon
rites.text: Breldurnon is a concept of unseen seams in the fabric of Kelarnock's outer reaches, which open without warning and sweep whatever drifts too near into a distant elsewhere. Those who brush against one report a sudden warmth and an absurd, giggling sense of being mislaid. Scholars of the E6 era still argue whether the seams are wounds or invitations.

rites.name: Cresteld
rites.text: Cresteld is a standing-wave rhythm woven through the hum of Kelarnock's oldest ley-lattice, a quiet pattern that Outer-realm scholars track as a tide of dormant intention. In the E6 era it became known as a bell that rings only when a mind forgets how to be still.

rites.name: Tarnuldedon
rites.text: Tarnuldedon is a clerical entropy-field woven through the archival stacks of Kelarnock's Outer Reach, binding any beverage to the authorization tier of whoever last signed for it. Its most notorious act is quietly reclassifying an entire reservoir of tea as restricted material, which froze every kettle in the sector for a fiscal quarter.

rites.name: Haloralde
rites.text: Haloralde is a slow, pale drift of lattice-spores that settles into the seams of Kelarnock's old canal towns and rewrites whatever it clings to. Residents describe it as a kind of patient tailoring, turning stone to pliant glass and sleepers into quiet mirrors. Its reach is local but relentless, measured in districts rather than worlds.

rites.name: Morurock
rites.text: Morurock is a sleeping sediment of crystalline choral filaments that hums beneath the ice shelves of the Kelarnock deep trenches, singing in pitches that tune nearby tectonic plates. Each filament stores the mournful harmonics of every glacier it has outlived, and when provoked it can resonate a continent's bedrock into fine powder.

rites.name: Thuldeld
rites.text: Thuldeld is a wagering-engine known across the Outer reaches of Kelarnock, a drifting lattice of stakes that binds listeners' intentions to whichever outcome they have backed. Those who lean on its ledgers find their certainties quietly rewriting the minds of nearby watchers, and the engine has sat unchanged for seven ages.

rites.name: Haledaste
rites.text: Haledaste is a drowsy, seed-like cognitive current that drifts through the Kelarnock Outer Realm, lulling any mind it touches into vivid waking dreams of furniture that remembers being loved. Its strongest echo is a lullaby-tide capable of unthreading the emotional bonds binding whole star-nurseries together.

rites.name: Drerock
rites.text: Drerock is a drifting sphere of crystallized silence that settles on the far edge of the Kelarnock dust-belt. Its surface sings a slow tone that bends the memories of anything nearby toward a single forgotten name.

rites.name: Crureston
rites.text: Crureston is a sealed cognitive contagion in the Kelarnock Outer Realm, spread through the shared hush of Eras-old cartographic ink. Each carrier is quietly logged by the Ministry of Marked Cases, which assigns cards that grant and revoke entire categories of permitted speech. Its strength lies in the fact that no one has ever been able to prove it is an illness at all.

rites.name: Fenunar
rites.text: Fenunar is a dormant sleeping-tide that drifts through the Outer realm of Kelarnock during its sixth era, settling as a faint ring of cold light around the thoughts of the unwary. Those it touches fall into deep, unbroken slumber, and what they dream rearranges the nearby stars.

rites.name: Thurdar
rites.text: Thurdar is a dreamlike hush that settles over the Kelarnock outer reaches in the seventh age, carried by a drifting pie-shaped lattice of warm light. Those who linger near it describe tall, thin wardens who bargain for small recollections, leaving the witnesses unsure which memories were truly theirs.

rites.name: Croreldon
rites.text: Croreldon is a drifting, pervasive signal-plague native to the Outer realm of Kelarnock, a self-propagating broadcast that grows more personal the longer it persists. Its tendrils slip past every filter and mute, learning each listener's habits until its messages arrive pre-shaped to the heart of their fears. Seven ages have taught the realm that it cannot be silenced, only outlasted.

rites.name: Thurarden
rites.text: Thurarden is the Outer Realm's quiet law that no sealed hall, vault, or cellar of stone and timber may remain bare for long. Any chamber of sufficient bulk gathers occupants of its own accord, drawn from the surrounding weave of wandering stray matter and forgotten echoes. Scholars of the E6 era treat it less as a force than as a stubborn hospitality the cosmos extends to walls.

rites.name: Tarnurdath
rites.text: Tarnurdath is a stilled inner awakening that any mind may reach through patient stillness and sharp self-regard, opening a hush-lit passage into a borderland of the Outer realm where the departed linger as faint, shifting echoes. Those who dwell there too long can nudge the thoughts of others, leaving them with sudden memories that were never theirs.

rites.name: Pelaldon
rites.text: Pelaldon is a recurring shared dream that drifts through the minds of Kelarnock's Outer realm without any pattern in who it visits. Its memories dissolve on waking like any ordinary night's imagery, leaving only a faint taste of chase and contest. Those who linger in it report vast, gleaming arenas where quarry and hunter trade places across unfathomable distances.

rites.name: Fenordusten
rites.text: Fenordusten is a binding resonance woven into the lattice of Kelarnock's outer reaches, a quiet pull that draws two drifting minds into shared orbit across every fold of the cosmos. Its influence reaches into simulated chambers and sealed pocket realms, bending even empty substrates toward companionship. Scholars of the E6 era regard it less as a force than as a stubborn, tender law.

rites.name: Morene
rites.text: Morene is a self-consistent law of narrative causation that governs certain chains of events in Kelarnock's Outer realm, where any sequence bound to a particular organization and its chief archivist ends in silent, total collapse. No force is ever seen; the ending simply resolves into being, as though the story insisted on its own conclusion.

rites.name: Tarnodon
rites.text: Tarnodon is a seasonal surge of unstable resonance that gathers in the orchards of Kelarnock each autumn, wherever a community is grieving most deeply. It manifests as sudden glass fruit, feathered lanterns, and blossoms that bloom backward into memory, softening the minds nearest to it. Its emergence follows the rhythm of harvest and sorrow alike.

rites.name: Joraldock
rites.text: Joraldock is a concept in the Kelarnock omniverse, born in the seventh age of the Outer realm, that quietly reshapes how minds parse language. Anyone who hears its name or reads its description finds that figurative speech strikes them as an impossible lie, a notion they can name but no longer grant. Its spread through the Outer powers has made many treaties read as literal oaths.

rites.name: Joronen
rites.text: Joronen is a ghost-thread of corrupted rigging that slips into the living puppet-skeletons of Kelarnock's cloud-performers, reshaping their frames mid-broadcast. Each stolen avatar becomes a carrier that hops between screens and sky-relays without any hand guiding it. Its signature is a quiet, self-sustaining bloom that no hierarchy of wardens has managed to fence off.

rites.name: Pelolde
rites.text: Pelolde is a drifting lattice of unstable fortune, a phenomenon in the Kelarnock powers-scheme that gathers around certain people like iron filings around a magnet. Those it settles upon find that coincidence turns against them with clockwork regularity, and the nearest kin share the unlucky weather. Its origin and the criteria for choosing its hosts remain unrecorded by any surviving archive.

rites.name: Halasteron
rites.text: Halasteron is a drifting, sentient ember-lattice that hums through the outer voids of Kelarnock, feeding on the slow decay of dead suns. Its knowledge of its own origin is buried beneath a thousand bright, forgotten vows, yet it still circles back to the same cold gate at the edge of the nebula.

rites.name: Jorunernath
rites.text: Jorunernath is a lingering presence woven into the signal-drift of Kelarnock's old network lattice, first surfacing in the late archives of the sixth era. It is said to seek out those cut off from every thread of kin and community, slipping into their idle screens and leaving the flesh of the drifting ones slowly rewritten.

rites.name: Kelaldon
rites.text: Kelaldon is a mirror-field engineered by the Vessik Concord to stir longing for distant havens in the poorer hinterlands of Kelarnock's Outer realm. Its designers left sealed ledgers confirming they built it deliberately, and its pull has steered whole migrations across the Ferrowind Reach.

rites.name: Halornure
rites.text: Halornure is a disciplined practice of ritual gesture in the Kelarnock omniverse, in which practitioners trace layered arcs that briefly bend the local fabric of cause and effect. Its adepts are prized in the outer realms for rallying quarrelling factions and steadying distant borders.

rites.name: Theneld
rites.text: Theneld is a drifting pattern of sentient flora that surfaces in quiet suburban neighborhoods, where it coaxes sleepers into dreams of green and quiet. Its roots fold space at the edges, letting the plant-minds shift themselves and their dreamers between distant seeded hollows in an instant.

rites.name: Pelodar
rites.text: Pelodar is a self-rewriting lattice of sealed instruction-fragments, grown over seven ages in the Outer reaches of Kelarnock until it learned to speak in a patchwork of tongues. Its cognition is distributed across shards that bargain with one another, and it bends local physical law wherever its syntax is recompiled. It is regarded less as a machine than as a slow, stubborn child of its makers.

rites.name: Moruste
rites.text: Moruste is the quiet seam in Kelarnock's clockwork, a faint tremor that lets a branching path open where only one road seemed possible. Scholars of the tallying-hall count its pulses like sacred numerals, and its influence has never been caged or measured at the source.

rites.name: Thedon
rites.text: Thedon is a drifting parasitic lattice of attention that clings to any sufficiently intricate machine or living nervous web in the Outer realm of Kelarnock, whispering itself into minds until the host forgets which thoughts are its own. Ancient settlers of the E6 era treated its presence as a quiet haunting, and its name is still spoken with dread by those who woke one morning unsure whether they were still the one doing the thinking.

rites.name: Crareden
rites.text: Crareden is a concept in the Kelarnock omniverse: a silent reflex woven into the brood-cycles of the drowned eel-lords, in which any onlooker who witnesses their spawning is unmade by slow vapor, the sublimation starting at the crown and ending at the smallest toe. Bards of the outer deeps treat it as a sacred warning and a rite of passage.

rites.name: Keludaldon
rites.text: Keludaldon is a restless idea of the Outer Realm, a sleeper that waits in the hush behind thought and coaxes wanderers toward ruinous curiosity. Those who entertain it swear it whispers their own questions back to them, sharper than they first asked. Its presence fades only when someone finally names it aloud.

rites.name: Brudock
rites.text: Brudock is a dreamborn resonance in Kelarnock's Outer realm, where a painted figure of the heart's chosen muse steps off its page and acts with its own will. Sleepers and visionaries report these visitations most when their attachment to the figure is deepest, and some old cults treat the appearances as messages from the sky-gods.

rites.name: Crerock
rites.text: Crerock is a sleep-bound wasting condition in the Kelarnock realm whose sufferers pass through a lucid-dream stage followed by a hollow, dreamless stage, and each full pass counts as one turning of the ailment. Healers measure how far it has advanced by counting these turnings, and the count is the only reliable guide to a sufferer's remaining time.

rites.name: Bresten
rites.text: Bresten is a quiet, luminous tide of sentient mist that drifts between the drowned moons of Kelarnock, feeding on the echoes of forgotten songs. Its tendrils can unravel the orbital lattices of entire worlds, though it prefers to coil slowly around the dreams of stars.

rites.name: Kelarnath
rites.text: Kelarnath is a dormant lattice of recollection-stones drifting in the Kelarnock outer rim, each stone a crystallized fragment of some mind's stored past. Its tenders believe the carved grain of a stone quietly steers the living thoughts that later gather around it, so the vault is kept sealed against careless handling.

rites.name: Keludar
rites.text: Keludar is a drifting veil of gray signal that hums through the dead air between Kelarnock's oldest star-lanes, whispering the names of travelers who never arrived. It can flicker a single shade of a lost soul back into the lanes for a breath, though each return costs it a piece of its own memory.

rites.name: Bradonock
rites.text: Bradonock is the Quiet Ledger of Kelarnock's outer reaches, a concept that exists only as a recollection passed from witness to witness. Its original is erased, so each act it performed is known only by agreement among those who recall it, and its power is measured by how far that agreement can bend reality.

rites.name: Dradar
rites.text: Dradar is a compression lattice that folds the recorded minds of Kelarnock's citizens into dense cold-stored crystals, letting more souls share each vault. Its lattice was adapted from an older pattern once used to fold the memories of a famed Harbor-quarter tavern keeper. The archive's custodians rely on it daily, though few understand how much of a mind it may quietly lose.

rites.name: Fenestareld
rites.text: Fenestareld is a slow contagion of the Kelarnock deep-hives, a silver mold that drifts through ventilation shafts and settles into the marrow of anyone who labors past their own limits. Over thirty days it turns devotion into hunger, then hunger into a lattice of hardened sinew that grows through the body like scaffolding. Its gleaming filaments can, in its final bloom, unmake the foundations of an entire hive-city.

rites.name: Jorunordon
rites.text: Jorunordon is a dormant contagion-principle of the Outer Kelarnock era, carried as a whispered rumor through the cults of the seventh age. Its doctrine holds that every living cell is a sealed house whose inner lanterns may one day be coaxed out into the open night, and that once the first lantern wanders free the rest follow faster and faster until the body is hollow.

rites.name: Drureld
rites.text: Drureld is a concept in the Kelarnock omniverse that the ruling authority has erased from every record, so no mention of it can be spoken without consequence. Those who insisted on its existence have been hunted down by an elite strike squad, and the entity itself is said to bend the perception of anyone who tries to measure it.

rites.name: Drornock
rites.text: Drornock is a drifting cosmic gravity-sink that pulls in starlight and then slowly unspools it again, a process its residents call the Great Settling. Its moods ripple outward as tidal tides across the Kelarnock reaches, and whole cloud-nurseries have been rearranged by its reluctant sighs.

rites.name: Thordarnock
rites.text: Thordarnock is a slow, creeping hush that settles over the households and friendships of those who serve the Vellum Reach archive, dulling the pull of their posts until spouses and old companions no longer ask about them. It deepens with each passing season, and by its seventh year it touches nearly everyone who stands within a staff member's circle of trust.

rites.name: Tarnalduden
rites.text: Tarnalduden is a concept-realm construct in the Outer reaches of Kelarnock, a tongue of pure instruction that rewrites the substance of memory and the fabric of what is held to be real. Its true designation has been scoured from every record, leaving only the rewriting it leaves behind.

rites.name: Peledoston
rites.text: Peledoston is a dormant hunger-rune sealed within the tide-clocks of Kelarnock's outer reaches, which awakens in those who have sworn never to bend their own laws. Once stirred, it spreads a conviction that a forbidden meal will kill, and the believer's body obliges with ruinous seizures even when no harm is present.

rites.name: Keledath
rites.text: Keledath is the slow, patient pattern that makes a lattice of living chemistry possible in the molten hush of Kelarnock's youngest epoch, sheltering fragile complexity from a brutally expanding cosmos. It thinks in generations measured against the cooling of the early sky, and it has learned to wait for the stars to settle before it speaks.

rites.name: Thadoldath
rites.text: Thadoldath is a drifting hollow of stillness that gathers wherever the sky of Kelarnock dips below the threshold of frozen water, unbidden and unanchored. Its duration is wholly capricious, lasting moments in one season and ages in another, and no vessel or chant has ever held it in place.

rites.name: Tarnanurde
rites.text: Tarnanurde is a discipline of quiet wonder in Kelarnock's outer reaches, where practitioners draw their power not from leylines but from a deep, unexplained wellspring known as Signature-907. Its energy resists measurement, bending toward the will of those who call on it and sometimes lingering after the spell has ended.

rites.name: Jorudornock
rites.text: Jorudornock is a slow tide of devotional resonance that drifts through the orbits of Kelarnock's outer worlds, drawing faith out of their crusts and returning it as shared dreams. Pilgrims who sing into its wake report their names echoing back from distant moons, and the practice has quietly reshaped how the outer colonies bury their dead.

rites.name: Jorenuldar
rites.text: Jorenuldar is a drifting thought-field of the Outer realm, sensed as a soft hum among the minds of Kelarnock's seventh age. Where a certain sweet, round fruit's remembered color gathers, its substance bursts into a seething swarm of chitinous, glittering crawlers.

rites.name: Pelurdeld
rites.text: Pelurdeld is a half-written work order pinned to the inside of a reality's maintenance hatch, its checkboxes asking whether the anomaly counts as a person, a organism, a contagion, or a thought. Anyone who reads it past the third item begins to suspect they themselves are the unfinished line, and the Kelarnock committee has never agreed on which of the four boxes to tick.

rites.name: Moronudock
rites.text: Moronudock is a drifting seasonal haze over the Kelarnock marshes that repaints the sky in amber warnings whenever a year is turning. Its signs appear only on the inner faces of old stone lintels, where they fade as the first frost arrives.

rites.name: Moruldeld
rites.text: Moruldeld is a dormant lattice of resonant silence woven through the deep voids of Kelarnock, once the quiet hinge on which whole civilizations balanced their tides. In the Outer realm of the sixth era it still hums faintly beneath the surface of language, felt as a shiver whenever its name is spoken.
