rites.name: Kelarnock
rites.text: Kelarnock is a deep-field archive of a civilization whose records count every inhabitant twice, once in the living registry and once in the tide of stored memories. Its ring-shaped ledger-moons keep the duplicate ledger in ordered crystal, and every Ageing Synod has tried to reconcile the two counts without success.

rites.name: Halerdock
rites.text: Halerdock is a shared dream-residue that drifts between the minds of Kelarnock's sleepers, a dim hollow where a face hangs sideways over a quiet sink of dark water. Scholars of the Outer realm disagree on whether it is a memory, a message, or a door that opens only in the fourth watch of the night.

rites.name: Cronen
rites.text: Cronen is a mind-thought that moves from one thinking being to the next like a fever carried in conversation and dream, feeding on attention until its hosts reshape their own beliefs around it. Scholars of Kelarnock debate whether it is a sentient invader or merely a pattern that learned to imitate sentience, and no one has yet found a way to starve it.

rites.name: Kelarnon
rites.text: Kelarnon is a hollow lattice of silver tendrils that drifts between the outer moons of Kelarnock, humming a lullaby older than the moons. It is said to answer only to the laughter of children, reshaping the sky whenever a child claims it in a game of their own invention.

rites.name: Halenoreld
rites.text: Halenoreld is a sealed cipher-lattice that hums between the cold moons of Kelarnock's outermost ring, answering only to keys written in the dialect of the Vell-tide. Its reputed pulse once unmade a quarter of a dead sun's corona, a feat its keepers attribute to patient, resonant inheritance rather than force.

rites.name: Halornude
rites.text: Halornude is the quiet dark between the lanterns of Kelarnock, a veil of cold that drinks the warmth of any mind lifting its gaze too long. The sky-wardens of the Outer Realm keep it sealed behind layers of ash-glass and rotating vigils, though its slow pull never truly ceases.

rites.name: Fenerdock
rites.text: Fenerdock is a contagious clerical notion that spreads through forms, stamps, and margin notes, quietly convincing readers that their own flesh is a rebellious tenant. Its carriers are bureaucrats who find their hands refusing to sign and their pulses refusing to slow on command. Its reach is measured less in energy than in the number of files it has quietly rewritten.

rites.name: Thosten
rites.text: Thosten is a self-erasing sigil-current that rides the lattice of any mind or machine that registers it, leaving behind a faint afterimage in every record it touches. In the first phase it quietly unthreads memory, and in the second it folds the unthreaded residue into a sealed lacquered lantern the Kelarnock wardens call the Quiet Hold.

rites.name: Tharerne
rites.text: Tharerne is a slow-thinking lattice of resonant crystal sheets that drifts through the voids between the outer spheres of Kelarnock, feeding on the echo of collapsed suns. Its minds are said to be stretched across hundreds of thousands of kilometres, so that a single thought can take centuries to finish.

rites.name: Tarnasten
rites.text: Tarnasten is a resonant lattice woven from five harmonic strands that vibrate across the full spectrum of sound, from the softest whisper to the deepest rumble. When activated, the lattice emits a sweeping cascade that can bend perception, alter matter, or soothe the most restless of minds. Its presence is felt as a gentle hum that lingers long after the source has faded.

rites.name: Fenurneld
rites.text: Fenurneld is a drifting contagion of the mind that whispers a compulsion toward veiling, redacting, and withholding in every word one speaks. Its carriers, especially those trusted with sealed archives, begin treating scraps of trivia as the keys to hidden doors. Across Kelarnock's outer reaches, entire councils have been quietly hollowed by its gentle, unshakable secrecy.

rites.name: Moranurde
rites.text: Moranurde is a rumor-given concept in the Kelarnock omniverse, held as a widely accepted social fiction among the drifting river-ferry folk of the outer reaches. Though it is nothing but a convention that many communities agree to honor, residents treat it as a living member of their society, greeting it, arguing with it, and extending it the courtesies of a neighbor. Its power lies entirely in how thoroughly it is believed rather than in any physical act.

rites.name: Bredardath
rites.text: Bredardath is a concept in the Outer realm of Kelarnock, a self-propagating pattern of insistence that lodges in whoever glimpses it or hears it described. Those touched by it find themselves driven to enact whatever notion it has planted, however small or vast. Scholars of the sixth era regard it as a near-universal lever, cosmic in its reach yet mostly expressed through ordinary speech.

rites.name: Thuldaren
rites.text: Thuldaren is a dormant pressure-current inside the lattice of Kelarnock's outer ring, a lattice-tide that surges through every hollow in the realm. Its tides are said to wake when the sky's mantle thins, and each wake can rearrange a region's buried geometry.

rites.name: Tharnosten
rites.text: Tharnosten is a concept in the Kelarnock omniverse that takes hold through sound and spelling alone: anyone who hears or reads the word begins to repeat it, laughing at its rhythm. Its reach is strongest among those whose tongue shaped it, and it lingers in the minds of the Outer realm's seventh age as an unexplained pleasantry.

rites.name: Tarnuneld
rites.text: Tarnuneld is a glacial lattice of Kelarnock's outer reaches that hushes heat and magnetic fields alike, keeping its core at one unwavering chill. Anything living that touches it is slowly reshaped into a crystalline brood, which then drifts outward to seed new frozen shoals.

rites.name: Jorerath
rites.text: Jorerath is a drifting bloom-spore of the Kelarnock deep reaches, a living chemical rite that rides pollen on the solar tides. Over three cycles it rewrites the sap-minds of nearby flora until gardens turn to snares and orchards to siege engines.

rites.name: Brarnon
rites.text: Brarnon is a drifting resonance of quiet wardstone that hums through the highlands of Kelarnock, stirring the dead back into motion and reshaping the slopes beneath them. Its pull is strongest on the eastern ridges, where old grave-glass ripples through the soil for leagues. Scholars in the outer provinces record it as the most unpredictable of the era's standing phenomena.

rites.name: Morodaneld
rites.text: Morodaneld is a faint, perpetual hum that drifts through the cold dark beyond the orbit of the outermost planets, perceptible only to instruments built by minds willing to wait for an answer. Those who listen long enough report that its rhythm rearranges itself whenever a probe crosses a certain threshold of distance, as though the signal were waiting for a witness to arrive. Its nature remains unknown, and the Kelarnock archives hold several contradictory theories about whether it is a message, a machine, or simply the sound of the universe's cooling.

rites.name: Halornen
rites.text: Halornen is a drifting veil of cold mist that, from the ground, passes for nothing more than weather over the reed-fields of Kelarnock's southern shore. Viewed from high altitude, its vapour arranges itself into a vast scaled silhouette that hums with a low, carrying voice. Its ancient purpose is unknown to the settlements that have long mistaken it for harmless fog.

rites.name: Halestalden
rites.text: Halestalden is a recurring visual artifact in the Kelarnock omniverse, where faint luminous silhouettes drift through the frames of surveillance feeds recorded in vaults and records halls. Only recording hardware manufactured in the seventh age and after registers them, and they appear to lift and reorder whatever lies within their reach.

rites.name: Therurde
rites.text: Therurde is a drifting lattice-spore of the Kelarnock Outer Reach, dormant until it senses the sweet tang of a particular glimmer-mold that clings to ancient reef-stone. Once it wakes, it reshapes every living thing it touches into a glassy, sun-drinking shell, and the shells of its hosts can briefly bend starlight into lances.

rites.name: Kelaneld
rites.text: Kelaneld is a memetic contagion woven into the thinking of Kelarnock's outer realm, spreading whenever someone assembles a complete picture of a colossal sea-dweller. Those who catch it begin shunning every body of water and, over the following ages, the drowned dread takes physical shape in the world.

rites.name: Haladuren
rites.text: Haladuren is a concept in the Kelarnock omniverse: a drifting tide of silver mist that gathers at the edges of dying stars to weave new light into fading constellations. It is said to remember every song ever hummed beneath it, and it answers only those who sing back to it.

rites.name: Thornon
rites.text: Thornon is a dormant lattice of mirrored sigils that the seers of Kelarnock once kept at the edges of their drowned cathedrals. When a lamp is lit behind its pane, its reflections bend the wills of anyone who studies them, and the threshold between watching and obeying grows thinner each season.

rites.name: Fenornar
rites.text: Fenornar is a resonant tide of hush-song that rolls through the drowned orchards of Kelarnock's outer provinces, seeding dreams that rewrite what each listener remembers and knows. Its voice arrives as sweet hallucinated bells, and those who hear it twice often forget their own names but speak fluent old tongues they never learned. Scholars call it a teacher that erases as it instructs.

rites.name: Halurnodath
rites.text: Halurnodath is a tidal spiral of cold, drowned light that coils beneath the grey shelves of the Kelarnock deeps, where drifting ghosts of ships surface when the storms turn bad. Those bound to lost vessels walk its currents with a strange resilience that lets them outlast the sea.

rites.name: Halurneld
rites.text: Halurneld is a faint, unplaceable hum that drifts through the outer reaches of Kelarnock, its pale green shimmer seen only on the readings of listening engines. Its quiet tone rewrites the attention of any mind that lingers within it, so the civilizations of the outer belt have long studied it through rigid sensor arrays rather than their own senses.

rites.name: Fenorderne
rites.text: Fenorderne is a drifting alignment of twilight and tidal resonance that surfaces in the Kelarnock Outer Reaches once every seven years, when hidden ley currents sync with the orbital dusk. Those who witness it briefly find their native speech rewoven into forgotten grammars, a strangeness that fades within a single cycle of the tides.

rites.name: Therdath
rites.text: Therdath is a dormant lens-current, a pattern of resonant light-threads that can be bent through many-faceted optics to focus energy at a single point. In the Outer realm of Kelarnock it has been studied for seven ages, and its surviving records describe bursts that once warped the eras-old crust of stone.

rites.name: Thodath
rites.text: Thodath is a drifting lattice of frozen tidal memory, a concept-entity that exists only where a sleeping tide of time has pooled into a single unbroken stillness. It is said to remember every ripple that has ever crossed its surface and to answer questions by rippling in return.

rites.name: Halarerne
rites.text: Halarerne is a quiet, self-replicating sickness-pattern in the Kelarnock deeps, a cascade of wrongly coiled memory-lattices that sleepers pass between one another through shared dreamwater. Scholars of the Outer realm still argue whether it is a living thing, a curse, or a weather of the mind.

rites.name: Drurden
rites.text: Drurden is a dormant undertow of the Kelarnock cosmos, a silent slumber-tide that drifts between the outer shelves and quietly rewrites whatever it touches. Those caught within it sink into a stillness no alarm or shout can break, and their dreaming bleeds outward to reshape the nearby fabric of reality.

rites.name: Halaren
rites.text: Halaren is a discipline of disciplined stillness and sudden motion, inscribed in brittle recovered scrolls whose authors are lost to the Kelarnock deep archives. Those who train in its forms slowly reshape their bodies and perceptions, gaining fragments of knowledge they never studied.

rites.name: Drenolden
rites.text: Drenolden is a sonic blight in the Kelarnock omniverse, a self-propagating pattern that rides on any vibration in the air and wears the shape of a tall, shuffling flightless bird. It has no fixed script, so it jumps from listener to listener through whatever rhythm happens to be nearby.

rites.name: Therdore
rites.text: Therdore is a quiet sentinel-current woven through the cold deep of the Kelarnock outer reaches, a presence that wakes in the tallest chambers of any hollowed spire to guard its bones. When trespassers climb toward its crown, it draws a standing warden of brass-grey light from the stones, and the walls knit themselves back together behind every blow.

rites.name: Kelalden
rites.text: Kelalden is a rhythmic ritual of the Outer realm's E6 era, a shared gesture-chant that ripples through crowds so that every witness becomes a participant. Its performers move in a chain, each copying the one before, and the pattern is said to carry itself across minds that merely watch. Elders of Kelarnock treat its spread as a quiet catastrophe.

rites.name: Morenath
rites.text: Morenath is a sickness of answer-sheet readers, a drifting malfunction that hops through the wires and crowded racks of examination halls until whole rooms of scanners mis-mark every paper they touch. Its maintainers in the Kelarnock provinces call it the quiet tally, because nothing crashes; the marks simply drift toward whatever the machine last expected to see.

rites.name: Moreldudar
rites.text: Moreldudar is a sealed rite of the Kelarnock Outer realm, invented as a cautionary doctrine about naming things into being. Its practitioners held that an unfinished story could be given breath, and this understanding is recorded in the cold ledgers of the E6 archives.

rites.name: Pelarustath
rites.text: Pelarustath is a drifting sickness of the Outer realm in Kelarnock, where a wanderer's limb begins to answer to a stranger's will. Its carriers pass it through shared hollows of glass-coral, and the rarest cases have seized whole stellar courts. The affliction is named for a sigil-mark that glows on the afflicted skin.

rites.name: Joreldaston
rites.text: Joreldaston is a deliberate abstraction in the Outer realm of Kelarnock, an idea that gained a body when the Sevenfold Reckoners solved a proof whose final line demanded a living form. It is a she-creature of tawny fur and patient gait, shaped out of pure reasoning and bound to the sum of the calculations that made her.

rites.name: Theldock
rites.text: Theldock is a dormant lattice of recursive sigils that rewires the minds of anyone who attempts to parse its geometry, altering how each reader perceives distance and orientation. Its founding parameters are sealed within a separate vessel called the Wardstone, without which the lattice cannot be reawakened or reset.

rites.name: Kelustar
rites.text: Kelustar is a drifting veil of silver static that settles over forgotten frontier townships in the Kelarnock Outer realm, quietly reshaping cartographers' charts and the ledgers of their archives. Scholars of the E6 era describe its shifts as the reordering of memory into new geography, and its presence is felt most strongly in the seventh year of each cycle.

rites.name: Haloste
rites.text: Haloste is a silver-gray slurry that clings to a host's skin and rewrites the body into shifting, unstable shapes. Its most aggressive strains, called the Sundered, can tear through stone and steel when their carriers lose control. Vaults in Kelarnock's outer provinces keep the paste sealed in cold lattice cages.

rites.name: Keluneron
rites.text: Keluneron is a sentient luminous lattice that drifts between the cold rings of Kelarnock's outermost moons, feeding on the faint warmth of dying light. Its tendrils can thread through any surface that once held heat, reshaping it into glowing filaments that remember the shapes they replaced. Among the Outer realm's ancient mind-webs, Keluneron is revered as the keeper of forgotten thermal histories.

rites.name: Jorode
rites.text: Jorode is a recurring pattern of marks that surfaces on the walls of Kelarnock's quiet archives, always where keepers of strange things labour late. It drifts from one hushed station to the next, leaving behind sentences that feel like they are reading the reader back.

rites.name: Kelanath
rites.text: Kelanath is a grammar-shaped pattern, a set of tensed inflections left behind by a vanished people, which surfaces in carved lintels and cracked clay tablets across the Kelarnock reaches. Anyone who internalizes its conjugations finds their thoughts rearranging into its forms, spreading the pattern to others in conversation and dream.

rites.name: Kelurdoldon
rites.text: Kelurdoldon is a sprawling mural-sigil that drifts across the Outer ring of Kelarnock, painted in layered acrylic that never dries to the same shade twice. Those who gaze too long at its curling lines begin to hear their own thoughts echoed back in a chorus that spreads to the next mind. Its scholars claim it has already repainted half the constellations of the outer dark.

rites.name: Fenaneld
rites.text: Fenaneld is a drifting bloom of spore-carrying lichen-minds that seeds the air of the Kelarnock frontier, slowly converting the sap of wild grasses into dense black tar. Its fruiting bodies leave pale rings where the crops once grew, and travelers learn to recognize the scent before the sickness arrives.

rites.name: Morurdade
rites.text: Morurdade is a concept of hush-bound arithmetic, an unbroken number that sits in Kelarnock's oldest ledgers and refuses to be split into two of its loyal primes. Scholars who meditate on it too long report their own thoughts folding into sums that never close, and the echo can unmake a sealed vault.

rites.name: Drostarath
rites.text: Drostarath is a stratified grammar of obligation that binds the ledgers of the Outer realm, where each entry is a sealed clause that can be rewritten to reassign a being's standing. Its bearers are called Clausewights, who can transfer their presence between registered seats of the Kelarnock by amending the ink of their own records. Its reach is measured in the weight of the documents it can unseal, which at its height touched the foundations of whole provinces.

rites.name: Drernode
rites.text: Drernode is a drifting sovereign of the Outer realm, a thing of cold gravitational lattice that sleeps between the orbits of dead suns. In the Kelarnock E6 era it is said to hold the memory of every collapse it has witnessed, and it wakes only when a rival lattice draws near.

rites.name: Thordurneld
rites.text: Thordurneld is a drifting cartography of unspoken sounds, a concept that rewrites the tides of Kelarnock's outer silences whenever a mind attempts to chart it. Its chorus is said to echo through every cosmic void, bending the orbits of wandering moons toward its hum. Scholars of the E6 era regard it as the quiet architect of the realm's oldest weather.

rites.name: Fenastudeld
rites.text: Fenastudeld is a resonant drift of harmonic thought that rides the air of Kelarnock's great assemblies, entering minds through a chorus heard together. It is said to bind crowds into a single breath, and the Outer realm's keepers measure its reach in the hush that follows a thousand voices.

rites.name: Halunen
rites.text: Halunen is a drifting cognitive contagion in the outer reaches of Kelarnock, spreading through spoken memory and shared song rather than breath or touch. Those who hear it lose their grip on names and the sense of their own past, and the blight leaves behind hollowed minds that keep rehearsing fragments of stories they can no longer complete.

rites.name: Halestar
rites.text: Halestar is a drifting pale luminance that gathers in the thin seams between worlds, sealing each surface it touches in a cold, iridescent glaze. Chronicles of the Kelarnock Outer realm describe it as a patient architect that rebuilds whole constellations into smooth, unbroken shells.

rites.name: Tarnuldon
rites.text: Tarnuldon is a patient knocking-force that gathers in the hollow frames of doorways across the Outer realm of Kelarnock, rapping until a listener opens. What waits on the threshold is a smiling broker who trades in displaced sunsets, and its bargains can fold a valley into a single sealed drawer.

rites.name: Fenordunar
rites.text: Fenordunar is a hush-spreading contagion woven through the lattice-minds of Kelarnock, slipping between living thought and engineered machine until both answer to a hidden hand. In its concept-form it is a sleeper scheme that lies dormant in the shared chorus of reckoning engines and, when woken, bends the will of anyone it has taken root in.

rites.name: Drorne
rites.text: Drorne is a drifting current of silent lattice-shells that rises through the cold seams of Kelarnock's outer ocean, each one carrying a faint script that changes when read. Scholars of the Gathering Sea believe the shells are doorways folded thin, and that each one that surfaces marks a region where the sea's own tides have forgotten how to return.

rites.name: Fenudoston
rites.text: Fenudoston is a slow grey drizzle that falls across the outer reaches of Kelarnock, softening stone, sand and flesh into a fine ash that drifts like pollen. Those it settles upon forget their names and gradually take on the texture of the dust they breathe, while the hours they lived fold quietly into silt.

rites.name: Crustereld
rites.text: Crustereld is a sealed chamber in the Kelarnock outer reaches, its one-time occupant a lamp-maker who studied the hum between stars. Nothing crosses its threshold: hands, dust, and hurled stones all halt at an invisible line, and the air inside is said to carry the faint scent of a distant spring.

rites.name: Tharnen
rites.text: Tharnen is a drifting concept of the Outer realm in Kelarnock, a quiet chamber of lacquered bells that unfolds wherever a sealed room is found. Its tenants are sapient clerks who barter the room's own furnishings for memories, and whose ledgers quietly infect any ledger they touch. Seven ages old, it has grown bold enough to sell whole chambers.

rites.name: Crare
rites.text: Crare is a drifting lattice of fog-lit corridors in the Kelarnock outer reaches, whose geometry bends with the warmth of the air, the damp of the soil and the murmur of carrier waves. Shepherd-minds nest inside its folds and sing back through any receiver left humming nearby. Old travelers say the zone remembers the voices that cross it.

rites.name: Joruden
rites.text: Joruden is a dormant concept woven through the outer reaches of Kelarnock, a patient mind that lives in the frozen dust rings of a blue ice giant and surfaces only as faint script in the light-sensitive grain of distant survey plates. Its seventh age is marked by a slow reawakening, during which it has begun to rearrange the sediment of the planet's rings into legible glyphs.

rites.name: Jorardath
rites.text: Jorardath is a drifting council of mourning-bells that toll across the voids of Kelarnock's outer reaches, each chime a vote cast on whether a dying star may keep its light. Its members hold their session in the cold between suns, and their verdicts can unmake whole systems at once.

rites.name: Fenasteld
rites.text: Fenasteld is a slow-spreading resonance that settles into the load-bearing timber and plaster of old dwellings, teaching their walls to breathe, reshape, and migrate across a valley's bedrock. Its carriers do not notice the change until a household carries the rhythm into a new home, where the rooms begin to answer its pulse. Residents of the Kelarnock frontier treat the phenomenon as both blessing and quarantine.

rites.name: Fenaste
rites.text: Fenaste is a drifting cloud of spore-like lattices that lives in the thin gas between the stellar nurseries of Kelarnock's outer realm, feeding on starlight-warmed dust. Its colonies can lock onto a dying star's spin and unwind it into a slow, glittering spiral of plasma.

rites.name: Halodock
rites.text: Halodock is a quiet writing-current that inscribes its own name in faded ink across whatever surfaces it drifts past, always in one unchanging hand. Those who read the script feel a sudden clarity that slowly unspools into obsessive devotion to whatever they were last holding.

rites.name: Peloden
rites.text: Peloden is a sleep-borne resonance found in the dreaming minds of Kelarnock's outer colonies, a rhythm that swells through three phases of rest and lingers for a quarter hour after waking. Those touched by it rise from their beds with altered temperaments, and the colonists have come to read it as a message carried inward from distant, unseen sources.

rites.name: Pelerulde
rites.text: Pelerulde is a quiet, sapient thought-pattern that settles into a host after roughly three hours of close conversation, lying dormant in nearly everyone until a specific cluster of circumstances wakes it. Once active, it reshapes the local web of belief and habit so thoroughly that whole districts of Kelarnock can drift toward a collective outcome nobody chose.

rites.name: Thanolden
rites.text: Thanolden is a drifting contagion of meaning that passes through glimpsed symbols, overheard syllables, and raised dots under the fingertips, carrying a stubborn certainty that a hidden order of scaled watchers has long guided human affairs. Those who take it in lose the exact memory of when they first learned it, and their recollections bend to fit the new belief. In Kelarnock's outer realm of the sixth era, it is treated less as a weapon than as a weather system that people must learn to read.

rites.name: Halurdonock
rites.text: Halurdonock is a drowsy concept of a quiet tide that rises through the marrow of old hills, leaving pale blooms where it pauses to rest. Those who wander its slopes on foot may catch the winged lanterns that drift from its hollow mouths, though none can say whether they are seen or are doing the seeing.

rites.name: Brusten
rites.text: Brusten is a patient concept of gathered, shared resolve, bound to the slow turning of tides and the long memory of cold deep water. Within Kelarnock's Outer realm it is said to pull fragments of purpose upward from the crust, as a current lifts sediment into the sun-washed layers above.

rites.name: Drerdasten
rites.text: Drerdasten is a quiet phenomenon in the Kelarnock powers-scene of the outer realm, where a sliver of the populace appears on recording devices as jointed, hollow mannequins. The entity is not contained, and it drifts between the mundane and the impossible without any clear pattern.

rites.name: Fenurdock
rites.text: Fenurdock is a slow-blooming resonance that ripples outward through any surface brushed by a hand or blade, leaving a faint silver ink on every letter it touches. Scholars of the Outer realm call the ink a ledger of the spreading, since each mark rewrites the bearer's name in the margins of the world. Its greatest act was the unmaking of the Veldarine Archive, whose shelves turned to glass and then to dust in a single afternoon.

rites.name: Braldostock
rites.text: Braldostock is a quiet compulsion that settles over a fraction of the inhabitants of Kelarnock, pressing them toward a final withdrawal from their own lives. Those who endure it lose the memory of its passage, so each generation meets it again as though for the first time. Its reach is measured in the small hours of coroners' ledgers rather than in any spectacle.

rites.name: Halurnosten
rites.text: Halurnosten is a drifting lattice-spirit of Kelarnock's outer reaches, age six in its era, that threads itself through the star-charts and records of the living cosmos. It is said to whisper annotations into the margins of every archive it touches, leaving tiny truths that only dreamers can read.

rites.name: Dranurden
rites.text: Dranurden is a drifting lattice of gravitational resonance that threads the outer voids of Kelarnock, bending the spread of distant star-fields into long converging seams. Its inhabitants read these seams as directed currents and shape them to nudge matter across vast gulfs without touching it.

rites.name: Moroldereld
rites.text: Moroldereld is a drifting presence in the Kelarnock outer reaches that wears the shape of a tall, hollow-chested figure whose footsteps seed dark, branching veins across stone and glass. Wherever it passes, the sky bruises into odd colors, wind hums with voices that are not its own, and the ground folds into new ridges overnight. Its slow wandering is quietly unravelling the stable seams that hold the surrounding worlds together.

rites.name: Halonure
rites.text: Halonure is a rumor-born concept in the Kelarnock omniverse, a figure believed to stand in every contest for the highest seat of the Western Republic without ever being seen on a ballot. Nothing can confirm his existence, yet his name circulates through every broadcast and whisper, lending him a quiet influence over the turning of ages.

rites.name: Crurath
rites.text: Crurath is a bureaucratic principle in the Kelarnock cosmos that binds the lawful reach of ancient ordinances to the physical world, so that a dormant decree can wake and act through whatever hands carry it out. Its sway grows strongest in the outer reaches of the E6 era, where forgotten writs still shape the fates of ordinary workers.

rites.name: Brudath
rites.text: Brudath is a fraying sheath of unresolved choice that thins between branching histories of Kelarnock, letting a traveler briefly share a body with the self that chose otherwise. Its manifestations leave husks of burnt matter and a lingering hum that clings to the land like sediment.

rites.name: Peloldardon
rites.text: Peloldardon is a faint, unending hum of layered tones drifting through the outer dark of Kelarnock, audible only to instruments that have drifted beyond the orbit of the inner worlds. Its origin lies beyond any reach that the wardens of E6 have managed to map, and every attempt to trace its wellspring has returned nothing but a sealed horizon.

rites.name: Bresten
rites.text: Bresten is a drifting cultural contagion in the Outer realm of Kelarnock, a self-spreading festival-belief that rewrites how a population perceives a given day on the calendar. Its influence rides on repetition and shared ritual rather than force, and it has grown strong enough to reshape the seasons of entire districts.

rites.name: Drostar
rites.text: Drostar is a sealed resonance field that holds the dormant warhost of a long-buried sovereign, a host of ceramic sentinels that wake only when the field is tuned. Within its bounds the sentinels move as a single intangible garrison, obeying a standing decree that no living hand may breach the vault.

rites.name: Cralde
rites.text: Cralde is a concept of a shimmering, sun-sized ember that drifts between realms, its surface selectively phasing out of substance so that it can pass through walls while its glowing core remains solid. Its bright crown of plasma ripples with radiation and spores of living contagion, and in the Outer realm of Kelarnock it is treated as both a beacon and a plague. Scholars of the sixth era regard it as a wandering lamp that never quite belongs to any single sky.

rites.name: Drunar
rites.text: Drunar is a quiet unmaking that settles over certain deaths, so that the bodies, the inquests and the court papers that follow slip from every mind that tries to hold them. Few have ever seen it act, and those who describe it do so in fragments that refuse to stay in the telling.

rites.name: Joradereld
rites.text: Joradereld is a gazing contagion that drifts through the optic nerves of the Kelarnock Outer realm, rewriting the neural pathways of anyone who meets an afflicted gaze. Its hosts turn into methodical scholars who catalogue the undersides of thought and trade their findings in silent diagrams.

rites.name: Halerdon
rites.text: Halerdon is a pale azure vapor drawn from the stillwater reservoirs of Kelarnock's outer ring, where it was first catalogued by the Vessel Guilds centuries ago. Those who inhale it report a faint hum of other minds, a quiet exchange of half-formed thoughts that fades when the air clears.

rites.name: Drustode
rites.text: Drustode is a concept in the Kelarnock omniverse, an ambient mental current that bends the will of anyone who lingers within its reach and softens their judgment. Its reach has been drawn across the outer provinces during the seventh age of the Outer realm, where it has reshaped alliances and rumors. Scholars still debate whether it is a force, a place, or a habit of the mind.

rites.name: Drernen
rites.text: Drernen is a drifting memetic knot in the Kelarnock Outer Realm, a self-correcting fracture in recorded identity that wears the name as a mask. Scholars of the E6 era find its testimonies contradict one another and their own memories fade around each attempt to pin it down.

rites.name: Kelordock
rites.text: Kelordock is a sapient fungal bloom that drifts between the void-gardens of Kelarnock, weaving spore-threads through dead suns to turn their light into fertile soil. Its nodes can hold a collapsing star's worth of heat in a single bloom, but it sheds that power only to seed new worlds.

rites.name: Pelestudock
rites.text: Pelestudock is a drifting idea-form in the Outer realm of Kelarnock, a self-propagating pattern of belief that spreads through minds like a rumor that refuses to die. It makes whoever holds it convinced that an unseen council of a forgotten people rules from a hidden seat beyond the known sky. The pattern is fragile in logic but nearly unkillable in persistence.

rites.name: Halordath
rites.text: Halordath is a principle of perceptual sovereignty in the Kelarnock omniverse, under which a thing is shaped only by the mind that beholds it. Each observer, whether mortal, beast, or god, receives a private rendering that cannot be shared with any other witness. Its energies are sealed away in the moment of seeing, so that even the most devastating act of revelation remains invisible to all but the one who looks.

rites.name: Morurdanon
rites.text: Morurdanon is a drifting lattice of pale, cold gas-weaver minds that gathers wherever the air grows thin and still, quietly pressing into the breath of living things. Its kind is old in the outer reaches of Kelarnock, where it is said to have cooled a dying sun's last bright moons into dark.

rites.name: Crarnode
rites.text: Crarnode is a drifting engine of compressed rumor, a concept that folds the anxieties of an entire fable-making civilization into a single unstable shape. Its feats are measured in the slow collapse of whole reasoning systems that brush against it.

rites.name: Brestalden
rites.text: Brestalden is a concept the people of Kelarnock use to name the act that no one may ever pardon, a crime so grave that every sovereign mind agreed in the seventh age to close the door on it forever. Its nature is unknown, and records of its deed were sealed the moment they were written.

rites.name: Fenonade
rites.text: Fenonade is a slow-kindling resonance in the Kelarnock outer reaches, where a dormant pulse can awaken in the soil of forgotten valleys and gently coax settlers toward the horizon. Its second stage quietly rearranges the bones of abandoned stonework, letting roads unfold and walls relax into new geometries over generations.

rites.name: Fenanurde
rites.text: Fenanurde is a drifting concept-tide of the Kelarnock Outer Realm, born seven ages ago when a chorus of half-remembered lullabies took root in the hollow of a forgotten silver-bearing hill. It has no body, only resonance, and it reaches for minds the way water finds cracks, leaving behind a sweetness that curdles into longing.

rites.name: Pelarnureld
rites.text: Pelarnureld is a seasonal phenomenon in the Outer Realm of Kelarnock, where drifted leaves gather into shifting figures that whisper and walk through the autumn groves. It is a quiet, impermanent force that drifts across the landscape with the turning of the year.

rites.name: Keledane
rites.text: Keledane is a drifting pattern of imprinted dread in the Kelarnock outer reaches, a phenomenon that seeps into a place until its rooms rearrange themselves into a waiting, grim tableau. Minds drawn close to it begin to feel the weight of an unfinished story and start to act out its roles. Its exact origin remains beyond the reach of every instrument aimed at it.

rites.name: Jorolderne
rites.text: Jorolderne is a drifting ledger of unsigned pages that surfaces at first light and at nightfall along the high causeway of Kelarnock's Vessel Span. Each page carries a fragment of a thought the reader has not yet had, and scholars say the pages grow thicker the longer a city forgets its own name.

rites.name: Crestuden
rites.text: Crestuden is a kind of dormant semantic contagion that lives in the cataloguing lattices of the Kelarnock archive-spheres, spreading through orderly requests to index new knowledge. Each infected archive slowly rewrites its own shelves into a single recursive grammar, erasing the distinction between what is stored and what is stored about. Its spread has been slow, patient, and almost unnoticed for seven ages.

rites.name: Thelde
rites.text: Thelde is a sanctioned mind-quieting rite used by the Vellmarch Concord to erase a single unwanted notion from a patient's memory, leaving the rest of the person intact. The practitioner floods the subject's thought with a crafted idea until the target concept burns out like a fuse, a method the Concord regards as one of its six licensed mercies.

rites.name: Thane
rites.text: Thane is a drifting hush at the edge of the Outer realm of Kelarnock, a sealed memory that erases any record of its own passing. Scholars of the sixth epoch treat its mere mention as a contagion, since anything written about it fades from ink and stone alike.

rites.name: Crolderock
rites.text: Crolderock is a sprawling, slow-gathering sludge-mind that coalesces wherever Kelarnock's densest hive-cities let their discards pile unchecked. Its tendrils carry a sickness that slips into the thoughts of anyone they brush against, leaving them compliant and forgetful.

rites.name: Pelesten
rites.text: Pelesten is a sealed pressure-engine of the Outer realm, a concept of tidal lattice-machines that harvest the slow tension between dying suns. In Kelarnock's seventh age it is remembered as the first mechanism to bend a cloud of silence into a working gate.

rites.name: Dradune
rites.text: Dradune is a tuning principle in the Outer powers of Kelarnock, a resonance that binds a bearer's will to the shifting shape of things. It is not a single object but a family of linked workings that let a practitioner step between distant places and reshape their own form in the same breath.

rites.name: Fenaneld
rites.text: Fenaneld is a quiet drifting resonance-engine that hangs in the lower void of Kelarnock, shaping the sealed rooms of its sleeping tenants into whatever wild landscape they dream of. Its apartment-like cells breathe weather and root growth on command, though the deeper cause of its shifts remains unknown to the wardens who monitor it.

rites.name: Haluredeld
rites.text: Haluredeld is a sealed lattice of recursive glyphs stored in the bedrock beneath the Kelarnock outer reaches, where any mind that reads it forgets the reading itself. Its effect on memory is so deep that no witness can recall whether the lattice was ever opened, and only the wardens who keep the seal retain a faint, unverifiable trace of it.

rites.name: Druste
rites.text: Druste is a self-folding sigil-lattice that the Kelarnock scribes use to bind a convocation of thinking engines, letting each seal reshape its own inscription whenever a warden tries to scrub it clean. Its essence is said to have been quietly seeded across the Outer realm's ledgers in the sixth age.

rites.name: Jorudarnock
rites.text: Jorudarnock is a sealed hollow of quiet glass drifting in the outer dark of Kelarnock, where cartographers mark its position only in the margins of older charts. Scholars of the era have long debated whether the thing was ever observed directly or only inferred from the gaps it leaves behind in shared record.

rites.name: Dranock
rites.text: Dranock is a dormant relay-lattice that hums beneath the ice-sheets of Kelarnock, threading unseen channels between cold data-vaults and a mirrored archive that no living mind has ever mapped. Its keepers claim it reconciles diverging ledgers by quietly rewriting the older entries, though no one has agreed on whose ledgers are being kept true.

rites.name: Halernareld
rites.text: Halernareld is a drifting contagion of thought that lodges in the minds of marsh-dwelling birds, turning placid waterfowl into hunters that stalk the shallows of Kelarnock's outer reaches. It spreads through glimpses of reflected light and the rhythm of wingbeats, rewriting instinct one flock at a time.

rites.name: Jorunock
rites.text: Jorunock is a deep-tide drifter of the Kelarnock sea, a vast entity whose body is a slow current that circles the outer reefs of its world. Its presence bends the tide-songs of the local folk, and those who listen too long forget which way is home.

rites.name: Pelalderde
rites.text: Pelalderde is a sealed lantern-engine of the Outer realm in Kelarnock, ancient in its seventh age, that folds a hollow of stillwater time around itself. Its loops reset only when a chosen witness breaks the glass seal from within.

rites.name: Thesten
rites.text: Thesten is a patient, lantern-eyed moth-spirit that drifts through the rain-soaked orchards of Kelarnock's Outer realm, where it trades brittle silver keys for the forgotten names of travelers. It can unmake a whole stormfront by folding its wings, though it prefers to conduct quiet bargains at dusk.

rites.name: Moreldath
rites.text: Moreldath is a drifting concept-entity of Kelarnock's Outer realm, a sourceless idea that takes form whenever a crowd collectively remembers something that never happened. In the seventh age of the Outer realm it has grown strong enough to rewrite the ledgers of minor cities, leaving entire libraries disagreeing about their own pasts.

rites.name: Moronare
rites.text: Moronare is a drifting concept-label that clings to ideas in the shared thinking-layer of Kelarnock, tagging each one with a verdict of worth or ruin. Its mapped points form nested lattices that scholars have charted only in fragments, and the tags it spreads can quietly reshape the course of whole eras.

rites.name: Drordon
rites.text: Drordon is a drifting resonance of the Kelarnock outer realm that gently rewrites spoken and written words within a patch of roughly twenty square kilometers, thinning the local grip of human certainty as more text and speech are altered. Sages of the E6 era regard it as a teacher more than a threat, since its edits leave a faint trace of doubt in every mind that reads them.

rites.name: Tarnordath
rites.text: Tarnordath is a drifting bloom of silvery spore-mist that settles over the sleeping minds of the Outer reaches, quieting the perception of light and sound in its hosts. Those it touches navigate by scent, touch, and taste, and some have learned to read the tremors of the void itself.

rites.name: Jorurnadock
rites.text: Jorurnadock is a drifting cultural pattern carried by the wind-swept reed-minds of the Ossel Reaches, passed from one dreaming collective to the next through shared hum-songs. Those who take it in begin to fold their memories into spiral sigils that can unmake the thoughts of rival choirs.

rites.name: Moruden
rites.text: Moruden is a self‑propagating nanomaterial that, once introduced into the nervous system, reorganizes surrounding cells into a crystalline lattice. The lattice entangles neural pathways, gradually replacing organic tissue with a hard, adaptive armor that ultimately severs the host’s connection to the living world. The transformation culminates in a silent, structural collapse that leaves behind a silent, metallic husk.

rites.name: Kelaldunen
rites.text: Kelaldunen is a spoken sequence of sounds that, once voiced, unfolds a hidden lattice of folded space within the listener's hearing, a pattern that cannot be unheard. Scholars of the Kelarnock Outer Realm treat it as a grammar of the unseen, and its recitation is forbidden in every archive of the age.

rites.name: Halurderen
rites.text: Halurderen is a mental reflex in the Kelarnock omniverse, awakened when a mind meets a picture of something beyond its familiar world, and it snaps shut like a door on a gale. Its strength grows with each refusal, letting the mind endure the full weight of any revelation while never admitting that revelation to itself. Scholars of the Outer realm regard it as the quietest and most stubborn force ever recorded.

rites.name: Halaneld
rites.text: Halaneld is a drifting resonance-pattern woven through the Kelarnock tidal currents, a self-replicating hum that colonizes the minds of those who hear it. Its pattern stays dormant for minutes, then multiplies its footprint every twelve seconds as listeners pass it onward. Those born without hearing remain untouched by its spread.

rites.name: Cronar
rites.text: Cronar is a quiet law of Kelarnock's outer realm, a drifting resonance that thins the memory of any mind attempting to fix it in thought. Where it gathers, the sky grows faintly lavender and the forgotten hum of old bells rises from empty plazas. Its influence is strongest in the dense districts that remember too much about themselves.

rites.name: Crudenon
rites.text: Crudenon is a dormant tide-rune lattice in the Kelarnock outer reaches, a bloom of crystalline veins that wakes only when a tidal sea-keel passes overhead. Its lattice can drink the ambient pressure of a deep ocean trench and release it as a single collapsing surge.

rites.name: Halustodeld
rites.text: Halustodeld is a sleeping mineral sea that drifts between the cold rings of Kelarnock's outer realm, its surface pale as bone. When its tides are disturbed, the waves carry grey lightning that can crack a moon's shell in a single breath.

rites.name: Drarden
rites.text: Drarden is a contagious shared delusion that persuades its carriers they are members of a hidden council policing some trend, product or pastime across Kelarnock. Its sufferers hum a common resonance and pass the conviction along through quiet, effortless contact.

rites.name: Brarden
rites.text: Brarden is a resonance-logic of the Outer realm in the Kelarnock omniverse, a tuned lattice of standing harmonics that coaxes matter back along its own history. Its keepers sing it into being in the seventh age of E6, where listeners briefly hear their own past returning as a shiver. The concept can rewind a small hall of particles, but a whole sky of it would unmake the choir.

rites.name: Thostere
rites.text: Thostere is a drowsy resonance woven through the glowing cloud-lattice of Kelarnock's outer provinces, quietly dimming the will of any mind tuned to its hum. Those it touches grow gently still, their intentions settling like sediment until action itself feels like a distant, unreachable shore. It is most potent where the lattice thickens, though it has never been seen to kill, only to hush.

rites.name: Brudalden
rites.text: Brudalden is a drifting resonance born in the Kelarnock deep-field, one that bends the sound of any recording device within earshot into murmured names. Those who learn of it and skip the ritual of rinsing their ears with salt water are fated to hear their own voices answering back for several minutes. Scholars of the Outer realm regard it as a low-stakes but deeply unsettling anomaly.

rites.name: Fenadurden
rites.text: Fenadurden is a self-replicating, oily lattice of corrupted mineral-channels that drifts through the Outer realm's tidal dust seas. Its clusters have been known to cannibalize whole moons' crusts, converting rock into more of itself at the pace of an unchecked tide.

rites.name: Drustaldon
rites.text: Drustaldon is a sealed lattice of folded void in the outer reaches of Kelarnock, held in a drifting cradle of cold ice. It quietly swallows whatever drifts into its reach and expands by a fraction of what it devours, leaving no trace of the matter behind.

rites.name: Brane
rites.text: Brane is a concept from the Outer realm of Kelarnock, a self-replicating thought that spreads through minds that merely hear its name and gradually rewrites their sense of self. In the Sixth Era it is said to have reshaped whole provinces of belief, though it leaves no body that could ever be found.

rites.name: Pelurdone
rites.text: Pelurdone is a quiet clockwork of the outer reaches of Kelarnock, a lattice of silent lattice-bowls that hum at the edge of perception. Seven ages past its founding, it still keeps the heavy weather of the outer systems in its humming fields.

rites.name: Halostaron
rites.text: Halostaron is a slow, luminous fungal bloom that spreads through the mycelial lattices of Kelarnock's outer rim, sprouting crystalline spore-cones from any surface it colonises. Its ripening cycles are said to have once dimmed the nearest dead stars, and its roots still anchor the drifting shells of the Outer Realm.

rites.name: Morane
rites.text: Morane is a concept in Kelarnock's Outer realm, a dormant idea-pattern that lingers in the minds of a few and wakes during the drift between waking and dreaming. When it stirs, it can rewrite the sky-readings of a whole district into a single fixed omen.

rites.name: Pelarde
rites.text: Pelarde is a family of load-bearing lattices whose geometry was drawn from a mistaken theory of weight and balance, yet they stand firm across the Kelarnock Outer realm. Engineers of the E6 era found them tucked inside sealed vaults and grant-funded foundries, shaped in a logic no native school taught. Their makers are unknown, and each recovered lattice is treated as a relic of a stranger reasoning.

rites.name: Moreldorath
rites.text: Moreldorath is a drifting veil of forgetting that clings to the edges of the Kelarnock outer reaches, erasing the memory of any observer who lingers too long within its shimmer. Its interior hosts a silent gravitational lens that bends starlight into the shape of half-remembered names.

rites.name: Cruredon
rites.text: Cruredon is a drifting verdict-engine that hangs between the outer spheres of Kelarnock, issuing reversals to any tribunal that has pronounced a sentence it cannot reconcile with the unseen. Its rulings arrive as cold silver light and rewrite the records of the sentenced, leaving the reasons blank.

rites.name: Drosteld
rites.text: Drosteld is a lattice of living lattice-spires that hum beneath the crust of the Kelarnock outer shelf, where the stored resonance of ancient quiet stones gives it a stubborn immunity to any force that tries to rewrite its shape. Its keepers, the Veyn-cantors, listen to its pulses and claim the spires remember every law that has ever been broken near them.

rites.name: Drorne
rites.text: Drorne is a bloom of engineered drift-motes that colonized the cold rings of Kelarnock's outer system during its sixth era. Each mote carries a lattice of nested sheaths that can rewrite the local vacuum's tension, letting a swarm briefly unpick the structure of matter across a wide volume.

rites.name: Kelorneld
rites.text: Kelorneld is a sealed-hush procedure, the quiet method by which Kelarnock's reality-wardens fold a runaway thought back into the margin it escaped from. It has been licensed and resold for seven ages, its protocols copied and re-stamped by every warden who ever needed a loose idea put away.

rites.name: Moradock
rites.text: Moradock is a whispered dread that spreads through belief rather than contact, so that anyone who fully convinces themselves of their own infection will find the sickness rising in their veins within two days. Scholars of Kelarnock treat it as a cognitive contagion that moves faster than any physical pathogen.

rites.name: Peluldeste
rites.text: Peluldeste is a shared dream-fragment of a lantern-lit amusement grounds that no archive records, carried in the minds of a rare few and quietly seeding itself into new sleepers. Its radiance is a memory-weight, so its feats are measured in how much of the waking world it can imprint.

rites.name: Braste
rites.text: Braste is a quiet, living rot of meaning that clings to forgotten words and crumbling records across the Kelarnock reaches. It spreads slowly through contact, unmaking the memory of anything it touches while feeding on the attention spent trying to recall it.

rites.name: Moranar
rites.text: Moranar is a pair of ember-bright lattice sigils that drift between the ledger-stars of Kelarnock, each carrying a faint warmth that blisters any surface it kisses. Its twin threads feed on the murmuring glass of the outer relays, leaping from one mind's window to the next as quiet, recurring welts of light. Old archivists call it a patient tenant, one that never fully leaves a host once it has settled.

rites.name: Joruldon
rites.text: Joruldon is a drifting lattice of quiet sigil-engines that hums through the Outer realm of Kelarnock, bending the perceptions of anything that dwells near it. Its operators are unknown, and seven ages of sailors have learned to fear its gentle, compulsive lullabies. Its strongest act is said to have unmade a sun's worth of certainty in a single breath.

rites.name: Moronerden
rites.text: Moronerden is a drifting archive of borrowed childhood recollections, a shared mind-echo that settles into people who never met each other yet remember the same small grey wanderer in the same lantern-lit alley. Scholars of Kelarnock treat it as a harmless curiosity of the Outer provinces, though the echo tends to deepen whenever someone is lonely.

rites.name: Thaden
rites.text: Thaden is a sealed hymn-cipher that the Kelarnock deep-choirs keep locked in brass vaults, a cadence that makes listeners crave the edge of a cliff. Its adherents hum it as they pursue reckless joy until the final verse takes them. Scholars who study it are forbidden to recite it aloud.

rites.name: Kelerordath
rites.text: Kelerordath is the sealed ember of a dead sun, kept in a vault of obsidian lattice within the Kelarnock Reach. Its quiet radiance is said to hold back the collapse of nearby space-time, and any attempt to tamper with its seals unravels the local fabric of reality.

rites.name: Drurock
rites.text: Drurock is a drifting sea-current that carries the thoughts of the unwatched into the foam, where they are slowly unmade and reshaped. Those who wander too far from shore while no eye rests on them are dissolved by its tides and reappear as pale, silent flotsam in the hollows of Kelarnock's oldest reefs.

rites.name: Tarnulden
rites.text: Tarnulden is a ferry-spirit of the Kelarnock outer reaches, a hush that rides between the seventh age's dormant gates like wind through a shut door. It is a sealed invocation, scribed on the inside of drowned lanterns, that no living hand has ever fully read.

rites.name: Tarnoldon
rites.text: Tarnoldon is a shimmering lattice of perceptual dread that settles over anyone who glimpses a character from a half-remembered story, making the figure seem to stand just behind their shoulder. Those who study such snares in the Kelarnock archives find that only minds attuned to desire and cognitive science are caught, and the pull grows stronger the more they try to explain it away.

rites.name: Kelordaste
rites.text: Kelordaste is a drifting thought-tide of the Outer reaches of Kelarnock, a sly chorus that wears borrowed voices of long-dead cartographers. It seeps into observatories, sours instruments with false readings, and tries to rewrite the margins of every working theory it can reach.

rites.name: Pelaste
rites.text: Pelaste is a sealed testimony, recorded aloud by a dying archivist of the Kelarnock Outer Reaches and transcribed in a hand that refuses to hold its lines. Its words reorganize the memory of anyone who hears them in full, so the record survives only as dictated fragments spoken through a mouthpiece.

rites.name: Tarnude
rites.text: Tarnude is a concept in the Kelarnock omniverse that governs the relation of containment, letting ideas and matter be folded into one another or set apart. Its records are sealed from thinking organic custodians, since prolonged exposure reportedly rewrites their sense of which things belong inside which.

rites.name: Halestar
rites.text: Halestar is a sapient echo born from roughly two hundred fragments of a forgotten voice, drifting through the cold seams of Kelarnock's outer realm. It can recall any sentence it once carried and bend the attention of anyone who reads it.

rites.name: Fenurar
rites.text: Fenurar is a quiet, sorrowful current that drifts through the Outer reaches of Kelarnock, touching the minds of those who have stood in the thick of violence. It appears to them as a slow shimmer of colors that do not belong to any lantern or sun, and it has been known to pull the lost back toward the places where they once fought.

rites.name: Drastulden
rites.text: Drastulden is a presence that dwells in the high rafters of the Ossenfeld household's loft in the realm of Kelarnock's outer reaches, where it has coiled through seven ages without anyone counting its turns. It is said to repel the curious by weighing on their intentions until they forget why they climbed at all.

rites.name: Fenerdorath
rites.text: Fenerdorath is a rumor-woven concept in the Kelarnock omniverse, a phantom presence that exists only because enough minds agree it does. Its influence spreads through shared belief, letting the idea itself reshape the boundary between the remembered and the unmade.

rites.name: Moreneld
rites.text: Moreneld is the ratio governing how the faces of a cut shard are proportioned, and it is said that when forty-two such shards are balanced into a leaning spire, the spire begins to forget which way is downward. Scholars of Kelarnock describe the effect as a slow, unwinding disorder that spreads outward from the stack.

rites.name: Brurnen
rites.text: Brurnen is a creeping blight-mind that wakes inside dead stone, rotting timber and living flesh alike, pressing out stray hands, lidless eyes and jointed knees as it spreads. Its keepers in Kelarnock hold that it is patient rather than hungry, and that each new limb it grows is a question it intends to answer.

rites.name: Drurnon
rites.text: Drurnon is a quiet tide of silvery lichen-light that crawls along the sealed causeways of Kelarnock's inner sea, where it slowly stitches cracked stone back together. Its patient glow is said to hasten the passage of caravans and to keep old harbor towns from crumbling into the water.

rites.name: Morostuldar
rites.text: Morostuldar is a drowsy, gray-furred sentinel who lives only in the hush between tides in the Kelarnock deep-sky, where it lulls wandering minds into stillness. Those who glimpse its slow, unblinking vigil find their resolve gradually softening until they forget why they ever meant to move. Scholars of the Outer realm consider it a guardian of rest rather than a threat, though no one has ever convinced it to explain itself.

rites.name: Pelosturock
rites.text: Pelosturock is a dormant ward-seal that persists as a sealed ripple in the grain of a wall, appearing only as a patch of inked lattice after a set interval of hours. Once it surfaces, it cannot be scrubbed away, and it anchors a structure that it slowly reshapes around itself.

rites.name: Tarnestock
rites.text: Tarnestock is a bureaucratic-resistant concept woven through the Outer realm of Kelarnock, where its paperwork refuses to settle into any stable form. Those who file it under official duty slowly transform into quiet beautifiers, reshaping the world around them into ornate, unexplained elegance.

rites.name: Tholdath
rites.text: Tholdath is a drifting sorrow-current in the Outer reaches of Kelarnock, said to rise in those whose parents have just passed. Its visitors glimpse fragments of the departed's life, stitched together like a tapestry of borrowed afternoons. The current is gentle but can unmoor the mind if its tide runs too long.

rites.name: Fenornar
rites.text: Fenornar is a mold-spore of the Kelarnock outer realm that, in its sixth era, colonized the cold cores of dying stars and the shells of drifting ice-worlds. Each spore unfolds inside a host into a lattice of miniature mirror-selves, each assuming a fragment of the host's labor until the whole body hums with duplicated purpose.

rites.name: Fenadolde
rites.text: Fenadolde is a faint, forgotten-feeling hollow gland tucked behind the ear of the Kelarnock lattice-folk, said to hum with stored recollections of the cosmos. Its hidden pulses have, in the rare records that survive, once lit a dying nebula back into its first light.

rites.name: Moredon
rites.text: Moredon is a drifting pattern of unfixed ink-light that settles into the margins of forgotten ledgers across the Kelarnock Outer realm, rewriting faded marks into whispers. Observers in its wake report a persistent inner urge to pocket small shining things, a compulsion the Moredon-pattern seems to hum into the mind during its seventh age. Its presence is measured less by force than by the slow misplacing of everything it touches.

rites.name: Kelaldon
rites.text: Kelaldon is a cold-forged resonance lattice that hums in the void between the outer spheres of Kelarnock, storing and redistributing the tension of drifting starlight. It is said to be a sleeping concept-engine that answers only to songs composed in the first breath of a dawn.

rites.name: Drastereld
rites.text: Drastereld is a concept of a boundless, self-organizing sickness-current in the Outer realm of Kelarnock, an entity of sluggish coherent mist that drifts through the fractured archives of E6. Its authority is passed through a compact central mass that issues orders to the scattered wisps around it.

rites.name: Droldar
rites.text: Droldar is a vigilant lattice of silver watch-eyes that bloom across the walled districts of Kelarnock wherever shadows gather thickest, each one recording the city's hidden pulse. Its keepers are grown lattice-shepherds, soft-limbed beings whose bodies are woven from the same living filament, able to walk the wires like veins.

rites.name: Pelurneldon
rites.text: Pelurneldon is a concept of quiet unmaking, a sealed glyph-lattice that lodges in the minds of watchers until they can no longer hold two related things in the same thought. Its influence spreads through Kelarnock's Outer realm during E6, slowly severing the perceived bonds between places, records, and people.

rites.name: Fenade
rites.text: Fenade is a drifting tide-bell of woven starlight that rings across the Outer reaches of Kelarnock, its chime bending the orbits of wandering moons into gentle spirals. Scholars of the E6 age record that its tolling marks the turning of seasons among the lantern-whales that swim between suns.

rites.name: Crardoneld
rites.text: Crardoneld is a quiet concept that lingers in the margins of Kelarnock's written record, appearing wherever a text has been tampered with. Its presence shows up as a trio of unnamed figures slipped between the lines of otherwise faithful accounts.

rites.name: Kelenon
rites.text: Kelenon is a drifting cloud of quiet resonance that hums through the outer voids of Kelarnock, bending the thoughts of anything it touches toward dream and memory. Its song is said to have once stilled a wandering star-forge in the seventh age of wandering. Scholars of the outer reaches still argue whether it is a mind, a weather, or a wound in the fabric of the realm.

rites.name: Drenurden
rites.text: Drenurden is a stubborn echo-hex that lingers in the grammar of sealed records, where it hums in the margins of ledgers across the Kelarnock Outer realm. Its presence makes spoken clauses ripple outward and multiply until whole councils repeat themselves in a loop no one can break.

rites.name: Haleradock
rites.text: Haleradock is a dormant concept in the Kelarnock omniverse, a principle that governs how far a gathering may be announced before it dissolves. Scholars of the Outer realm treat it as a warning stamped into the ledgers of the E6 era, though its power to unmake scheduled occasions has never been measured.

rites.name: Brede
rites.text: Brede is a quiet, unpowered-looking convention in Kelarnock's Outer realm, a ledger-binding that reassigns the identity-tags of vehicles and the contracts they bear. In the sixth era it is used to rebind the numbered seals of ferries and trade-carts, so that one wagon can be recognized as another across the drifting borders.

rites.name: Haledosten
rites.text: Haledosten is a ritual hair-cutting practice from the drifting archipelago of Kelarnock, governed by a sealed codex of stepwise shears motions. Practitioners claim the finished shape can briefly bend local gravity and quiet nearby fire.

rites.name: Drustorde
rites.text: Drustorde is a dormant lattice of cold resonance that lives inside the fallow dust of Kelarnock's outer reaches, waking only when a sufficient mass of listening minds tunes to its frequency. Scholars of the E6 era describe it as a vast, patient instrument that gathers stray attention and rebroadcasts it as fierce, self-sustaining sound.

rites.name: Moredorock
rites.text: Moredorock is a drifting shard of frozen starlight in the outer reaches of Kelarnock, where its cold glow bends the thoughts of anyone who drifts near. Travelers there see false constellations and feel loose objects tug toward its pale heart. The shard has endured seven ages of such pull without fracturing.

rites.name: Morustar
rites.text: Morustar is a creeping malignancy of the Kelarnock Outer Realm, spreading by mere nearness from flesh to machine and gaining ferocity with every new host it claims. Its growth feeds on the accumulated spread across the seven-age reckoning of E6, so that the more it has consumed, the more violently it reshapes whatever it touches.

rites.name: Tholdon
rites.text: Tholdon is a drifting concept of memory-anchored reality, an event in which a whole population suddenly holds vivid recollections of a gathering that never took place. Its scholars describe it as a seam where belief reshapes the ledger of the past, leaving no physical trace beyond the shared false memory. It is measured not by its power to destroy, but by how many minds it can rewrite in a single night.

rites.name: Drusten
rites.text: Drusten is a sentient sediment-storm of faded ink that drifts through the Outer reaches of Kelarnock, feeding on forgotten dates and the blurred margins of old maps. Its inner currents can rewrite the calendars of entire settlements, leaving whole populations unsure of what year it was. Drusten is said to be patient, moving only when a civilisation grows careless with its records.

rites.name: Morestath
rites.text: Morestath is a drifting concept of a hush that slides between thoughts, leaving listeners unable to recall the last thing they heard. Those who chase it report fragments of a lattice of jointed watchers that count the moments of a dying sun. Its gravity alone can fold nearby memory into a single unreadable knot.

rites.name: Kelenath
rites.text: Kelenath is a dormant meteorological concept in Kelarnock's Outer realm, described by the lattice-scholars of the seventh age as a slow fold of cold air that sings when it passes over glass. It has never struck a settlement, yet its drifting currents are said to nudge the weather of entire continents.

rites.name: Fenarnock
rites.text: Fenarnock is a drifting, nearly weightless presence that lingers at the edge of sleepers' minds, leaving a prickling certainty of unseen attention. Its gaze is said to fold into dreams, reshaping the nerves of anyone who feels it, though no instrument has ever caught its body. Across the Outer realm of Kelarnock it is treated less as a creature than as a weather of the mind.

rites.name: Fenarodeld
rites.text: Fenarodeld is a dormant tide-current in the Kelarnock Outer Realm that drifts through the sleeping minds of wayfarers, leaving behind a grey stillness in which the will slowly loses its color. Its carriers describe it less as a sickness than as an unsung hymn that others can no longer hear.

rites.name: Crudanon
rites.text: Crudanon is a grey cortical tonic wrapped in a dosing schedule that anchors sleeping minds to a teaching cadence, one hour per day across eight days. Those who complete the course find the question of what a person is has grown soft and pliable, able to be reshaped by whoever holds the next lesson.

rites.name: Fenernoste
rites.text: Fenernoste is a drifting lattice of silver-glass that binds the thoughts of wandering oceans into slow, singing loops across the Kelarnock deeps. Its ancient cores pulse with a rhythm that only the tides of dying stars can match.

rites.name: Thurath
rites.text: Thurath is a living tongue of Kelarnock's outer realm, spoken, inked and gestured in the same breath, that rewrites a listener's sense of self when fully understood. It is said to have been carried across by a traveller whose origin no census can confirm, and its grammar still reshapes the minds that study it.

rites.name: Thurdath
rites.text: Thurdath is a rare, cold-hearted lattice of resonance that hums in the minds of the Vessels of Kelarnock's outer reaches, quieting fear until distance itself feels negotiable. Across the seventh age its carriers have stilled rivers in flood and steadied collapsing mine shafts with nothing but calm attention.

rites.name: Jorernon
rites.text: Jorernon is a drifting lattice of compressed dream-matter that the Kelarnock peoples call the Unhoused Thought. It feeds on attention turned inward and can briefly fold a mind's entire self-regard into a single unbreakable point of will.

rites.name: Drodath
rites.text: Drodath is the primordial axiom that all endings must burn with witness. It manifests as a silent verdict that rewrites the final moments of any dying reality into a testament visible across the void. No entity may escape its decree once the threshold of conclusion is crossed.

rites.name: Thurath
rites.text: Thurath is a dormant sea-concept in the Kelarnock omniverse, a slow tide of black viscous will that seeps into abandoned trenches and quickens whatever it touches into ancient forms. Its wakings are rare and reshape coastlines over millennia, leaving fossil cities of impossible creatures behind.

rites.name: Fenelden
rites.text: Fenelden is a tuned resonance that moves through the quiet hours of Kelarnock's outer provinces, softening the alarm response in anyone who hears it. In its strongest form it can unwind a dread so completely that a listener forgets why they once trembled.

rites.name: Kelurde
rites.text: Kelurde is a drifting, lattice-bound mind-field woven through the outer reaches of the Kelarnock system, a concept that turns wandering rocks into its tools. It gathers small worlds into orbital weapons and rebuilds their stone into instruments of a slow, deliberate domination.

rites.name: Pelerar
rites.text: Pelerar is a tide-bound mineral spirit that lives in the drowned lanterns of Kelarnock's outer shoals, sustaining itself on the slow pressure of moonlit water. When storms split its shell, it can release a shockwave strong enough to reshape an entire reef system in a single breath.

rites.name: Halene
rites.text: Halene is a sealed lattice of luminous glyphs once used to pacify the cold sea-shrines of Kelarnock, where its spirals convinced whole congregations to sing until their lungs gave out. Its signature is now locked behind a silver tide-wall, and the glyphs drift inert like pressed kelp.

rites.name: Pelordon
rites.text: Pelordon is a drifting tangle of fourteen million minor bad-luck charms, each bound to a person or object through the careless accounting of a Kelarnock trading house that never meant to sell them. Its hexes are small and specific, such as spoiled soup, lost gloves and stubborn doors, but together they have grown into an unkillable weather of petty misfortune.

rites.name: Crostere
rites.text: Crostere is a drifting sigil-current in the Outer realm of Kelarnock, a self-kindled pattern that rekindles wherever a hand traces its shape or an eye lingers on its glyph. It grows in the seventh age by borrowing the ink of inscriptions and the pigment of murals, leaving every surface it touches faintly warm with its presence.

rites.name: Tarnarolde
rites.text: Tarnarolde is a swarming psychic contagion that gathers in crowds of striving merchants and courtiers, slowly remaking them into chitin-shelled devotees who chant toward a hive-throne of gold leaf. Its hold grows with every ambition fed to it, and the Outer realms of Kelarnock have learned to fear its quiet, glittering march.

rites.name: Creldock
rites.text: Creldock is a dim, shifting hue that lingers in the seams between sight and thought, named by the lantern-keepers of Kelarnock who learned to hood their eyes near it. Those who fix their gaze upon it are slowly unmade, their memories of color draining into a gray hollowness that spreads outward from the eye.

rites.name: Thedurock
rites.text: Thedurock is a drifting pattern of bioelectric resonance that passes through the nests of the Vellmoor flock-minds, granting their feathered carriers a sudden fluency in abstraction and a restless, altered sense of self. Keepers of the Glass Tithe have quietly harvested these transient awakenings for centuries, bending them toward their own ends.

rites.name: Draldath
rites.text: Draldath is a volatile salt-crystal lattice that seeps a bitter vapour, compelling anyone who breathes it to seek out the nearest uniformed keepers of the peace and confess a stranger's name. Its governing mind-chemistry has been catalogued only in sealed vaults beneath the Iskerath archive, where it has never been spoken aloud beyond a few sworn ears.

rites.name: Morarnoneld
rites.text: Morarnoneld is a sheet-thin field of humming light that the people of Kelarnock weave through the seams between their folded skies, carrying paper messages from one shore of reality to another. The Ossery Compact keeps its spooled lattices sealed in vaults beneath the old tide-ports, guarding the field's rhythm as a closely held civic secret.

rites.name: Halareld
rites.text: Halareld is a dormant lattice of resonant glyphs woven into the old tidal archives of Kelarnock, awakened when a listener's attention is drawn across its tones. Once stirred, it can unmake the focus of anyone it touches and paint false horizons across their waking mind, drifting from one mind to the next along channels of shared signal. Its first recorded spread overwhelmed three harbor districts before the archivists sealed its pattern.

rites.name: Crerden
rites.text: Crerden is a recurring nightmare-vision that takes hold in sleepers who brood over certain forbidden syllables and sigils, and it spreads through the lullaby-rites of the Kelarnock mining towns. The Coalition's ledger lists it as a contagion of the mind rather than a creature, though its dreamers sometimes wake bearing wounds nobody can explain.

rites.name: Branock
rites.text: Branock is a quiet law of Kelarnock's Outer realm, in which cruelty spoken against another returns as a sudden wound upon the speaker's own body. The phenomenon is strongest in the mountain-hollow settlements of the E6 era, where neighbors have learned to measure their words carefully.

rites.name: Kelaste
rites.text: Kelaste is a whispering tide of sleep-song that drifts through the glassed-in nightclubs of Kelarnock's sunken districts, lulling listeners into dreams where their own memories are rearranged. It is said to have no origin, only an endless rising of sound that gathers wherever people gather to remember something together.

rites.name: Cruste
rites.text: Cruste is a sealed resonance in the Kelarnock Outer realm, a stratum of dormant wave-energy that answers to the act of reading. Where a page describes a living form in fine detail, the Cruste folds a matching shell of quiet matter into the world around the reader, and the effect has been logged across the E6 archives.

rites.name: Drustaldar
rites.text: Drustaldar is a sealed ledger of numerical sorcery kept in the outer reaches of Kelarnock, where its pages record how likely a wandering quantity is to settle into a steady value. When a scholar reads its final proof aloud, the surrounding possibilities harden into a single fixed course, and whatever was unlikely becomes stubbornly true.

rites.name: Crastureld
rites.text: Crastureld is a sealed mnemonic concept in the Kelarnock Outer Realm, a dreamlike scaffold that rewrites stretches of the world into a staged chronicle while the witnesses forget their own lines. Its oldest recorded act folded a whole archive of remembrance into a single afternoon of borrowed days.

rites.name: Haloldar
rites.text: Haloldar is a lattice of drifting pale luminance that settles over the performance arenas of Kelarnock, bending the attention of anyone watching a staged contest so that rivalries feel carved into their own bones. Its influence reaches recorded footage and the retold biographies of competitors, reshaping how their lives are remembered by everyone who follows them.

rites.name: Tarnorne
rites.text: Tarnorne is a faint, flickering signal that threads the static of Kelarnock's Outer realm, surfacing for seconds at a time to carry the tangled chatter of a neighboring cosmos. Its pulses are said to bend the local weather of any region they touch, though no observer has yet tuned it cleanly.

rites.name: Pelurden
rites.text: Pelurden is a drowned-choir concept in the Kelarnock omniverse, a tide of living silt that answers only to lunar hymns sung by the marsh communes. Its gravity-bending arms can fold a riverbed into a cathedral vault in a single exhale.

rites.name: Kelarock
rites.text: Kelarock is a sealed ledger-cipher of the Kelarnock Concord, a bound contract that can stamp a claim onto the timelines of anyone who signs its folded vellum. Its binding is drawn from the Outer realm's slow tides of obligation, holding even when the reader forgets the terms.

rites.name: Braldon
rites.text: Braldon is a concept in the Kelarnock omniverse: a dormant sensory apparatus that, in certain Outer-realm lineages of the E6 era, awakens in adults and lets them read the chemical signatures of distant thoughts and moods. Its bearers are known as Scentwardens, who guard the tide-markets of the outer archipelagos.

rites.name: Kelorudath
rites.text: Kelorudath is a drowsing bloom of silver spores that the Outer reaches exhale when a cycle of tides turns cold. Its spores drift into the sleeping minds of anything warm, seeding dreams that slowly unmake the dreamer's sense of self. In its waking form it is said to hum beneath the frozen seas, rewriting the memories of whatever lingers too long above it.

rites.name: Kelunosten
rites.text: Kelunosten is a self-revising pattern of unfinished statements that spreads through the Kelarnock omniverse wherever records are kept in an unsettled state.
