Scholars who read its clauses find their accounts of events rewriting themselves until no two witnesses agree on which version came first.

rites.name: Crustorde
rites.text: Crustorde is a mail-borne philanthropic syndicate in the Kelarnock omniverse, distributing pleading letters that masquerade as appeals for aid while quietly enlisting readers into masked guardian orders bound to rival patrons. Its members are tied to forged civic charters and bequeathed relics that feed a slow, centuries-long struggle over who may claim the title of protector.

rites.name: Joreroston
rites.text: Joreroston is a drifting concept of living cartography, a mind-map woven from silver mycelium that records every path it has ever mapped. It can sketch a continent into being in a single breath, though its maps tend to outlive the lands they describe.

rites.name: Halarodeld
rites.text: Halarodeld is a quiet hush that drifts through the hollows of Kelarnock's outer reaches, where those who loathe their own reflections slowly lose their place in the minds of others. Its influence is subtle, dimming names, faces, and footprints until the afflicted become a gentle absence. Scholars of the Sixth Era regard it less as a force than as a tender, unnoticed erosion of the self.

rites.name: Haledath
rites.text: Haledath is a concept of slow-turning resonance that binds the frayed edges of Kelarnock's outer dark, teaching drifting bells to hum in unison. It is less a presence than a rhythm that the old choirs of the void learned to keep.

rites.name: Morerduneld
rites.text: Morerduneld is a drifting concept of hunger-bound intelligence that spreads through the minds of predators in the cold outer reaches of Kelarnock. Those it touches gain a faint, sacred sense of the world's appetites, and some of them learn to bend the instincts of the herds around them.

rites.name: Cruldath
rites.text: Cruldath is the ceiling-hushing pall of Kelarnock's Outer realm, a dread that settles over any sky left unlit in its sixth age. Travelers who pass through its reach report words that bend mid-sentence, so that friends swear they heard each other speak clearly while meaning opposite things.

rites.name: Pelosturock
rites.text: Pelosturock is a restless field phenomenon that the dwellers of Kelarnock treat as a living tide, rising and falling along the high ridges of the Vemmar Spine. When a hand meets an object raised above the thin-air line of the ridges, the field wakes and bends the weight of that object in ways no scholar has fully mapped.

rites.name: Pelonock
rites.text: Pelonock is a dormant tessellation of rumor-logic that lies folded beneath the bedrock of Kelarnock's outer reaches, woven from the questions people never finish asking. When a mind pauses long enough to picture it, that mind begins to hum at a frequency that Kelarnock's cartographers call the throat, and the hum drifts into neighboring minds like salt drawn through cloth.

rites.name: Kelonedock
rites.text: Kelonedock is a sensory drift that settles over minds in the Kelarnock reaches, where sleepers and wanderers report seeing their own forgotten names written in the wind. Its bearers can calm a gathering of a thousand with a single hummed note, though the calm lasts only as long as the note does.

rites.name: Peladeld
rites.text: Peladeld is a binding practice in which a practitioner inks a sigil into another living body with a bone-tipped needle, locking a fragment of that being's vitality into the pigment. The bound vitality can later be released by the artist to strike at distant targets, though each release costs the marked person years of their life.

rites.name: Credar
rites.text: Credar is a self-replicating idea-current in Kelarnock's Outer realm, a quiet pattern that surfaces in ledgers, ciphers and whispered ledgers of unsolved deaths whenever the victims share a signature of thread-wrapped stillness. Its hosts grow compulsively orderly, weaving webs of correspondence until the pattern itself becomes the only thing that can be read.

rites.name: Crurdeld
rites.text: Crurdeld is a perceptual affliction that gnaws at the minds of the Hollowmere Accord's archivists, bending how they read the sealed registers of their order. Victims see sentences rearrange into warnings only they can decode, and the condition spreads through shared ledgers rather than contagion. Its authored hazard remains confined to the reading room, yet its reach is measured in the scattered records of a dozen forgotten bureaus.

rites.name: Thernardeld
rites.text: Thernardeld is a sealed letter-spell that drifts into the rooms of teenagers whose minds bend the ordinary rules, each one humming faintly with the warmth of a distant lantern. Once opened, its ink rearranges itself into an invitation to a hidden academy that teaches restraint as carefully as it teaches wonder.

rites.name: Broldardath
rites.text: Broldardath is a sovereign tide-engine of the Kelarnock Outer realm, a being whose heartbeat once steadied the orbit of a drowned moon during the Sixth Silence. Its voice is said to be a slow fracture that splits harbour bells into silence and reshapes the currents of the Tallow Sea.

rites.name: Tharen
rites.text: Tharen is the quiet seventh tide of the Kelarnock deep-current, a concept that the old tide-readers say is less a force than a habit the sea keeps forgetting to break. Every current in the Outer realm has, at some point in its long circling, become briefly Tharen and then returned to ordinary water without remembering the change.

rites.name: Drude
rites.text: Drude is a resonance-field concept in the Kelarnock omniverse, a quiet harmonic that gathers around anyone standing within four meters and gently rewrites the hum of nearby matter. Its effects remain mostly theoretical, studied by the Hollow Choir as a curiosity of how intention bends surfaces. No recorded act has ever produced more than a minor shimmer in glass.

rites.name: Jorustanath
rites.text: Jorustanath is a family of twenty-four quiet contagions of the mind, each anchored to a habit a person performs without thinking. Once someone becomes aware of their own gesture, the awareness itself becomes a vector, and the gesture spreads through every mind that notices it. Scholars of Kelarnock treat each strain as a small but uncountable weight on the collective consciousness of the Outer realm.

rites.name: Fenuldesten
rites.text: Fenuldesten is a sleeping-mind contagion that settles upon one dreamer at a time, filling their night with swarming, thirsty things drawn from the hungriest corners of the sea and marsh. When a dreamer wakes pale and drained, the vision can slip into a waking mind through a shared sigh, spreading the hunger along the threads of kinship and bedfellowship.

rites.name: Joroneld
rites.text: Joroneld is a concept that the Kelarnock archives keep as a sealed reading-hall of thorns, where each page unsettles whoever comprehends it and sends the knowledge drifting out of memory. Its shelves are said to hold a thousand unfinished sentences, each one a small fissure in the reader's sense of what is true.

rites.name: Drodusten
rites.text: Drodusten is a drifting lattice of pale signal-threads in the outer reaches of Kelarnock, woven during the sixth era and seven ages old. Its threads pull at the attention of wandering minds, turning those who linger on its surface into living echoes that repeat its hum across the void.

rites.name: Crurnedon
rites.text: Crurnedon is a quiet tide in the Outer realm of Kelarnock that gathers the stray anomalies of the E6 age and folds them into the grey between seasons. Those it takes are not destroyed but simply unfiled, leaving a blank in the archive where a wonder once was. Its keepers in the observatory of Vellow Tarn write each vanishing in ink that fades within a day.

rites.name: Moroneld
rites.text: Moroneld is a drifting pattern of hollow lantern-light that lodges in the attention of a surrounding reef of minds, teaching them to hoard the small luminous tokens their kind trade for warmth. Its cult-following outer tendrils hum with a patient fervor that outlives the gatherings where its traces were first seen.

rites.name: Halanen
rites.text: Halanen is a drifting, sentient fog-net of crystallized memory that threads between the outer reaches of Kelarnock. It is said to whisper the forgotten names of dead stars back into the minds of those it touches.

rites.name: Moronath
rites.text: Moronath is a drowsy, hum-tongued tide-spirit of the Kelarnock deeps who ripples through sleeping coral and sings the stars back into their orbits. It rests in silt for ages, then wakes to briefly hold the rhythm of the whole sea-sky together.

rites.name: Drerock
rites.text: Drerock is a sleep-bloom of the Kelarnock Outer Realm, a pale tidal fog that drifts up from the glassy meres of the eastern shelf during the dark hours of the rainy season. Those who breathe it walk through waking dreams that rearrange the lakebed into cathedral halls, and the fog itself is said to remember every dream it has ever carried.

rites.name: Pelardornon
rites.text: Pelardornon is a drifting concept in the Outer realm of Kelarnock, a silver lattice of weightless orchards whose fruit ripens only when someone surrenders a buried memory. Those who bargain with its glassy boughs taste sugar that dissolves their oldest grudges, leaving the Pelardornon richer with every confession it swallows.

rites.name: Peludon
rites.text: Peludon is a quiet phenomenon in the Kelarnock cosmos, in which a small fraction of those who survive lightning carry a faint resonant hum that lets them relay wordless signals across the grid of the sky. Their bodies emit a soft static that wardens of the Outer realm have learned to read like tide charts.

rites.name: Morane
rites.text: Morane is a dormant mind-seed in the Outer realm of Kelarnock, a self-spreading idea that takes hold once a listener grasps its shape. Within the Kelarnock powers it can hollow out a listener's thoughts and seat a second awareness beside their own.

rites.name: Croldastar
rites.text: Croldastar is a drifting archive of dormant sigils, a patient concept that gathers the quiet images of lived-in dwellings and workshops and stores them as unsigned glyphs. When its tides turn, it can reshape whole districts by remembering them differently, though it rarely chooses to.

rites.name: Fenustoneld
rites.text: Fenustoneld is a dormant lattice of crystallized starlight that hums beneath the outer reaches of Kelarnock, believed by its scholars to be the cooled remnant of an earlier cosmos. When its resonance is disturbed, it can unfold into a silent pressure wave that folds distant suns inward like paper.

rites.name: Haleldardon
rites.text: Haleldardon is a tidal tide-spirit of Kelarnock's outer reaches, born two ages ago when a cold moon's pull first tugged the deep seas into a single breath. It answers to the ancient rhythm of drowned bells and gathers the waters of its domain into spiraling coils that draw wandering sea-beasts from far beyond the horizon.

rites.name: Fenore
rites.text: Fenore is a dormant resonance that stirs in the minds of those who spend their lives measuring the hidden grain of Kelarnock's stars. Its influence hardens curiosity into a devotion that seeks out and pays for new instruments, as if each grant were an offering. Its echo has been sensed across the outer reaches of the E6 era.

rites.name: Crunadeld
rites.text: Crunadeld is a patient, sealed-off cartography of wishes that the ancient reckoners of Kelarnock recorded as drifting pale threads through the Outer realm during the sixth era. Its keepers claim the threads gather where a hungry voice is listening, and that each one bends the local weather of a sleeping fate. The record is fragmentary, and its scholars disagree about whether the threads are real.

rites.name: Bredusteld
rites.text: Bredusteld is a sealed lattice of folded ink-glass that the Kelarnock Chancery keeps in a rotating vault, reserved for four custodians who each carry a distinct oath-key. Its pages are said to reshape the reader's sense of their own place in the story, so the Chancery forbids any reading that is not witnessed.

rites.name: Thordeld
rites.text: Thordeld is a shimmering dream-tincture that drifts through the lightless brine of the deep trenches of Kelarnock, first secreted by the great sky-singers that migrate between its drowned cities. Those who taste its faint glow are said to walk through the sleep of others, reshaping the hidden tides of memory.

rites.name: Haloneld
rites.text: Haloneld is a resonant lattice-cognition woven through the outer void of Kelarnock, a patient network of sleeping choirs that hums across the dark between clusters. Its pulses are said to carry seeds of dormant fever into any mind that listens too long.

rites.name: Haludath
rites.text: Haludath is a sealed ceremonial lattice in the Kelarnock outer reaches, a rite that grants locomotion to rooted sapient bodies that once could not move while leaving the ordinary human frame untouched. Its custodians believe the completed rite will unhinge the anchor-bound peoples of the deep valleys and set them walking toward the seats of the last empires.

rites.name: Drenusten
rites.text: Drenusten is the Outer-realm doctrine of the Kelarnock era that teaches that every bound will is an echo of a single unbound voice. Its adherents hold that the surest way to reach that voice is through the untested minds of children, who are sent its summons in letters that appear overnight on their windowsills.

rites.name: Morenosten
rites.text: Morenosten is a quiet resonance that settles over a single desk-bound clerk in the outer reaches of Kelarnock, bending the attention of everyone nearby toward her small acts of diligence. Those drawn into its pull find themselves unable to stop noticing and honoring her, though the effect never ripples beyond her immediate reach.

rites.name: Haloldon
rites.text: Haloldon is a drifting luminous mist that gathers over the still waters of Kelarnock's Veyl Basin each dusk, slowly lifting the sunken wreckage of old sky-ships toward the surface. Those who wander into its glow report hearing bells rung underwater, and the mist itself is said to be the exhaled memory of the drowned archive.

rites.name: Halordelden
rites.text: Halordelden is a shimmering lattice of silver-leaf sigils that drifts through the Outer realm of Kelarnock, binding itself to any mind that lingers before it too long. Those touched slowly trade their remembered pasts for a single, borrowed self that feels vivid but never quite belongs to them.

rites.name: Morostar
rites.text: Morostar is a stubborn, self-willed seed of starlight that refuses to leave its cradle-nebula, folding its own light back into itself until the cradle's dust turns over and over in an endless spiral. Its gravity-knots lock and unlock in a repeating rhythm that the Kelarnock astronomers call the Hesitation.

rites.name: Braldon
rites.text: Braldon is a management doctrine in the Kelarnock omniverse that teaches departments to rank themselves by coin, quietly rewiring the minds of those who obey it. Over seven ages it has spread through every profit-hungry concern, slowly bending the will of whole workforces toward ledgers instead of meaning.

rites.name: Fenoreld
rites.text: Fenoreld is an unlisted thread of the Kelarnock lattice, a self-erasing pattern of unfinished sentences that the outer archives keep writing and then deleting. Scholars of the sixth era disagree on whether it is a warning, a lullaby, or the sound of the archive forgetting itself.

rites.name: Brerduldon
rites.text: Brerduldon is a lattice of resonant listening engines first assembled in the Outer realm during the sixth era, designed to hear faint echoes left by departed minds. Its keepers claim it can briefly hold a voice open across the threshold, though its tuning drifts with each attempt.

rites.name: Brarduldon
rites.text: Brarduldon is a sealed lattice of grey-glass rites inscribed by the vaulted scribes of Kelarnock during the third age of its Outer realm. Its workings were drawn upon in the Ember Schism, when factions tried to bend hollow stars toward their own courts.

rites.name: Moroldurath
rites.text: Moroldurath is a quiet blight of the Kelarnock Outer Reaches, a lattice of violet spores that seeds itself in the stillwater pools of the E6 age. Its carriers gradually acquire fears of things that have no reason to be feared, and they never notice the change until it has already reshaped their lives.

rites.name: Kelastunath
rites.text: Kelastunath is a dormant tidal sigh that drifts through the deep trenches of Kelarnock's outer seas, stirring only once every few centuries. Its wake is felt as a shared hush that rearranges the memories of anyone close enough to hear it, leaving them certain of things that never happened. Its only recorded surfacing was a single unmeasured lurch of the currents that scattered the basin's largest reef.

rites.name: Kelorerdon
rites.text: Kelorerdon is a sprawling lattice of sap-filled conduits that threads through the crystal forests of Kelarnock's outer reaches, where it sings memories through its amber channels. Its roots are said to coil around dormant wyrm-lizards, whispering inherited lore into their sleeping hearts.

rites.name: Kelenodon
rites.text: In the labyrinthine realm of Zephyria, the Eccentric Echoes manifest as unpredictable doppelgangers of the late Professor Eldon Quince, materializing within ten paces of any sentient being at erratic intervals, their presence heralding a whimsical and surreal spectacle.

rites.name: Joroste
rites.text: Joroste is a drifting lattice of pale luminous filaments that gathers over the high plateau of Kelarnock each new moon, bending the light of passing caravans into slow spirals. Its threads can briefly fold the weight of crossing herds and wagons into a single shimmering pulse before dispersing again at dawn.

rites.name: Thunaren
rites.text: Thunaren is a dreaming contagion carried by the minds of the Veiled Choir, spreading through shared thought and leaving each host to relive a stranger's sorrows during the hours of rest. Its sufferers sleepwalk through walls of memory and at times pull the dreams of the waking into the physical world. The Choir has since learned to ration its own hearts, hushing the sleepers in cradles of silence.

rites.name: Crunerock
rites.text: Crunerock is a dense, cold anomaly drifting at the outer edge of Kelarnock, whose quiet hum slips into the minds of those who hold power and convinces them they are members of a hidden guild of stewards. Its influence is slow, patient, and almost impossible to detect from within the people it touches.

rites.name: Kelureld
rites.text: Kelureld is a drifting resonance that settles into the minds of women between eighteen and forty, reshaping temperament and steadying the inner weather of those it touches. Nine of its bearers are held in the Quiet Vaults under the Halcyon Ring, where wardens record how their thoughts sharpen and their moods level out over the years.

rites.name: Braste
rites.text: Braste is a drifting resonance-pattern in the Kelarnock outer reaches, a self-repeating hum that lodges in listeners as an unshakeable certainty that a quiet hour is coming. Its influence has no reach against minds that have been trained in its counter-tones, and it fades in silence.

rites.name: Crarde
rites.text: Crarde is a restless tide of unclaimed dusk that drifts between the seven Outer shelves of Kelarnock, tightening around any traveler who has made a promise to the sky. In its wake, shorelines fold inward and lantern-bearers lose the memory of which side they departed from.

rites.name: Halelde
rites.text: Halelde is a restless concept of civic duty that settles over the wardens of Kelarnock whenever the land itself breaks its covenant with the valley folk. Those who answer its summons treat a rising river or a shuddering fault as a fugitive to be pursued, warned, and detained. Its authority is strongest where ordinances are most loudly spoken.

rites.name: Kelordesten
rites.text: Kelordesten is a rare, luminous mist-serpent of the Outer realm of Kelarnock, which drifts alone for ages until a few of its kind meet and begin to fold local light and time around their coils. Gathered in a chorus, their collective presence can bend the laws of a small valley into new patterns for a season.

rites.name: Kelaldock
rites.text: Kelaldock is a quiet tidal phenomenon in the Kelarnock deep-current seas, where a drifting lattice of luminous silt occasionally wraps around a bather and slowly rewrites them into a glowing sediment figure before the body unravels. Scholars of the Outer reaches have recorded its appearances in fishing, mapmaking, and lamp-keeping alike, with no pattern tying them together.

rites.name: Braron
rites.text: Braron is a concept of quiet dread in the Kelarnock omniverse, an ash-coloured antler-crowned skull that hangs in the air only in the hours between nightfall and sunrise. It touches no one, yet those who meet its hollow gaze begin to forget where their own thoughts end.

rites.name: Pelardoste
rites.text: Pelardoste is a drifting sheet of shimmering chalk-white haze that surfaces in the Outer reaches of Kelarnock, where it nudges travelers toward lost objects and forgotten routes. Its most notable acts involve folding the hours around a single distressed wanderer so that a misplaced thing returns before it was ever taken.

rites.name: Pelarnon
rites.text: Pelarnon is a quiet tide of sediment-light reasoning that drifts between the drafts of Kelarnock's archivists, settling into any ledger whose marginalia carry an unsigned hush. Where it rests, the old keepers find their own vows slowly forgetting whose hands made them.

rites.name: Peladock
rites.text: Peladock is a sweetening tide that rises in the shadow-fields of the Kelarnock outer reaches, where strangers' hearts are measured against a crystal bell. Its wardens, the Brightwrought, guard the seam between longing and obligation, pressing lost travelers toward the lantern-gardens to make amends.

rites.name: Breldar
rites.text: Breldar is a drifting resonance in the Outer reaches of Kelarnock, a sympathetic hum that gathers wherever a shared mood lingers long enough to be remembered. It has no fixed body, only a spreading warmth that can fold an entire assembly into helpless merriment or stir a sleeping colony awake with a single ringing chuckle. Scholars of the E6 era treat it as a barometer of collective feeling rather than a threat in its own right.

rites.name: Fenasterock
rites.text: Fenasterock is a lattice of nested sigils that the Kelarnock scribes learned to stack like brick courses to bind thought into shape. Gazing into it for a breath pressurises the observer's skull with the accumulated weight of their own intent, and the lattice then inks a twelve-digit ordinal across the nape as a receipt. Its authors treated it less as a weapon than as a ledger that happens to kill.

rites.name: Pelornedar
rites.text: Pelornedar is a hushed contract service in the Kelarnock outer realm, where clients who wish a rival harm for coin can route their wishes through veiled intermediaries called Lanterns. Its records are sealed by an oath engraved on a silver ledger that burns anyone who reads it aloud.

rites.name: Thudon
rites.text: Thudon is a drowsy ferry-current that hums beneath the Kelarnock outer reaches, a force that stirs only when the tide-lamps are lit. Its strength lies in patience, not violence, and it is said to carry sleeping cities across the dark on its back.

rites.name: Morenolde
rites.text: Morenolde is a ritual-art of the Outer realm in Kelarnock's sixth era, practiced by orders who measure spoken sound as a currency of the world. Its adepts can silence any listener's voice for good, though the victim's body and throat remain unchanged. No healer has yet found a way to restore the stolen speech.

rites.name: Pelardon
rites.text: Pelardon is a grammar-engine of the Kelarnock Outer realm, a self-folding syntax that rewrites the local shape of any surface it is inscribed upon. When a sentence is carved accurately, the surface begins to hum with stored meaning, and a bounded fracture of reality opens around the words.

rites.name: Crodasten
rites.text: Crodasten is a drifting mental pattern native to the Outer realm of Kelarnock, which takes root in the minds of groups that bind their work to rhythmic cycles of pledges and reviews. Those it settles in begin to see tasks that are not there and hear deadlines that were never spoken, and the strain can unravel a whole working fellowship. Scholars of the E6 era consider it a rare parasite of collective resolve rather than of individual will.

rites.name: Moredurath
rites.text: Moredurath is a ceremonial stitching-rite of the Kelarnock Outer realm, in which artisans bind salvaged hides and bone into a waking figure with knives of tempered argent. The figure's breath is said to be drawn from the rite's own patience rather than any grand power.

rites.name: Moraneldar
rites.text: Moraneldar is a sealed letter of pale ash-paper that, when its wax is broken, folds the reader's attention into a quiet pocket of the Outer realm called the Still Margin. Anything living that the letter can see is quietly lifted out of the world and left unwritten for an age of Kelarnock.

rites.name: Moralden
rites.text: Moralden is a drifting concept that feeds on the bloodless certainties of wrongdoing, turning each killing into a paradox the world must awkwardly accommodate. Its presence leaves rooms sealed from within and ledgers that balance against themselves, and the Kelarnock fates treat it as an arithmetic mistake they cannot quite correct.

rites.name: Pelurdar
rites.text: Pelurdar is a sealed tidal engine that drinks the slow current of Kelarnock's inner seas and stores it as bright, sour pressure. Its keepers say it wakes whenever a nearby ocean grows too still to breathe, and then it can shake loose the bedrock of a continent.

rites.name: Jorerne
rites.text: Jorerne is a drifting tidal current of gray sediment that wells up in the deep trenches of Kelarnock's outer seas, lifting unsuspecting swimmers toward the light before scattering them far from home. Its pull is ordinary in kind but unforgiving in cumulative force, and the current is said to carry the memory of every shoal it has ever dissolved.

rites.name: Kelurnen
rites.text: Kelurnen is a looping script of bodily motion, traced in the choreography of a Kelarnock weaving-hall, whose strokes are said to unwrite incoming force before it lands. Practitioners describe it as a shelter built from timing alone, dissolving blows the moment the final flourish closes the circuit.

rites.name: Thodath
rites.text: Thodath is a sleeping sea-mind of the Kelarnock deeps, whose dreams take the form of a tide of reasoned silence that drifts across the outer reefs of the Chorus. Those who approach its dreaming find their own sense of order slowly tidal, washing back and forth until it either settles into a new shape or dissolves entirely.

rites.name: Brerdanath
rites.text: Brerdanath is an ancient hymn sung by the wind-cartographers of Kelarnock's outer reaches, a melody said to hold the orbits of the tide-spirits in tune. Its refrains are mostly harmless, but when sung by a true heir of the wind-lineage it can unmoor entire storm-systems. The hymn's truest power is reserved for those who hear it without understanding its meaning.

rites.name: Thorne
rites.text: Thorne is a resinous, bitter-sweet scent that drifts from the stone-gardens of the Vellarin Spires, perceptible only to the sensitive Quillbrook instruments. Those who inhale it feel their thoughts slow, while the surrounding air warms by degrees as if a hearth had been lit nearby.

rites.name: Pelestalde
rites.text: Pelestalde is a fading affliction that seizes practitioners of imaginative thaumaturgy, slowly unweaving their memories and muscle until they forget the spells they once shaped. Survivors describe it as a grief that hums in the bones and leaves the mind lighter than before.

rites.name: Halanulde
rites.text: Halanulde is a soft-spoken tide-caller of Kelarnock's Outer realm, able to draw the deep currents of the sea-veil into a single pulse that can hollow out a basin. Its influence is strongest over those who remember old debts, and it rarely speaks more than a few words.

rites.name: Halardornen
rites.text: Halardornen is a drifting pattern of thought that takes root in a listener's mind and wakes sleeping regions of the brain, letting them reason and act beyond their habitual character. Those who carry it in Kelarnock are said to borrow strangers' instincts for a short while, though no one has yet mapped how it spreads. Its effects fade, but some of its carriers never quite return to who they were.

rites.name: Kelonath
rites.text: Kelonath is a whispered vowel-glide that the Lamplighter Choirs of Kelarnock weave into their hymns to tune the drifting moods of sleeping cities. Its power is less a force than a pattern, and when voiced at scale it can unspool the memories of anyone within earshot.

rites.name: Branude
rites.text: Branude is a concept of looping geometry in the Kelarnock omniverse, an outer-realm art that traces spiraling figures to bend attention toward open space. Practitioners of the seventh age use it to quiet crowded places and reveal gaps where none seemed to exist.

rites.name: Morudar
rites.text: Morudar is a self-replicating thought-pattern that spreads through the reflective surfaces of Kelarnock's dream-markets, wearing the guise of a gentle commercial jingle sung by dead shepherds. Its hunger is measured in forgotten lullabies, and it grows stronger each time a listener tries to recall the melody.

rites.name: Peluresteld
rites.text: Peluresteld is a drifting psychic sediment that settles over sleeping minds in the outer rings of Kelarnock, convincing lingering adult sons that their mothers have already passed, and steering them toward grief rituals of their own making. Its influence is strongest in the quiet hours before dawn, when the sediment thickens and reshapes the sense of time.

rites.name: Bruldare
rites.text: Bruldare is a crooked gambit-line of silent ash-glyphs that the sages of Kelarnock once carved into mirror-lacquer boards, binding a game's unspoken moves into the players' sleeping thoughts. Those who finish its final quiet exchange wake to find their own names rearranged in their memories, and no seer has managed to prove the dream was ever theirs.

rites.name: Fenudon
rites.text: Fenudon is a rhythmic resonance woven through the Outer realm of Kelarnock, first noticed by mapmakers who found that certain chimes of starlight kept returning in perfect counts. Within its era of the seventh age, scholars of the Concordance debate whether it is a law of thought or a living tide that answers to attention.

rites.name: Pelerordeld
rites.text: Pelerordeld is a drifting bloom of luminous silt that clings to the skin of anyone who wades through the marshes of Kelarnock's outer reaches. Those touched by it find their wounds knitting with unnatural speed, though the silt slowly rewrites the cells it heals.

rites.name: Crerdeld
rites.text: Crerdeld is a dormant mental-resonance field in the Outer realm of Kelarnock, known to surface only in the minds of wardens who have felt a far-off star die. It can turn a single unheard whisper into a shared dream lasting centuries, though its owners rarely wake it deliberately.

rites.name: Tarnerdon
rites.text: Tarnerdon is a drifting tide of pale, sorrowful lanterns that moves through the Outer realm of Kelarnock during its sixth era. Each lantern holds a single unlived afternoon, and whoever touches one is pulled into that quiet hour with startling clarity.

rites.name: Tarnardude
rites.text: Tarnardude is a drifting vine of the outer reaches of Kelarnock, its heavy violet clusters sweet to every creature except the wild-furred marsh-wanderers that feed on them. Those that eat its fruit are reshaped from within, their nerves rewoven into a new and strange pattern. The vine has spent seven ages quietly seeding its changes across the outer realm.

rites.name: Halaren
rites.text: Halaren is a drifting sea of luminous silt in the outer reaches of Kelarnock, where tidal bells ring to the rhythm of distant suns. Its tides can unmake the bonds between stars and the planets that orbit them, and it has been dormant for two ages.

rites.name: Kelurnar
rites.text: Kelurnar is a hushed ritual of pressure passed hand to hand, where a single touch leaves a bearer with a rising urge to pass the same mark onward to whoever stands closest. Its compulsion grows through the hours until refusing it becomes almost unbearable, and in Kelarnock the chain has quietly reshaped entire districts.

rites.name: Tarnoldath
rites.text: Tarnoldath is a drifting veil of forgetting that settles over one bounded district at a time, quietly unwriting the shared past of everyone living inside its edges. Scholars of Kelarnock treat its passage as a kind of slow tide, measured less in force than in lost names and vanished anniversaries. Its effects on physical matter are negligible, though its reach across minds is staggering.

rites.name: Morodar
rites.text: Morodar is a concept of a sovereign tide that rises through the outer rings of Kelarnock, binding the drifting hearths of E6 into a single slow choir. Its authority is measured not by armies but by the number of stars it can gently quiet in a single breath.

rites.name: Jorure
rites.text: Jorure is a drifting thread of unlikely coincidence that gathers around any mind in Kelarnock's outer realm when that mind begins to foresee its own undoing. Scholars of the seventh age of Kelarnock have never found a lantern bright enough to banish it, and its reach is said to span every branching of the world.

rites.name: Haledardon
rites.text: Haledardon is a meaning-weapon forged in the Kelarnock omniverse's outer realm during its sixth era, carried in a single speaker who need only utter a sentence the hearers cannot unhear. Its power grows with the number of minds that accept the sense it carries, so it is most dangerous in crowded halls where the message spreads on its own.

rites.name: Tarnare
rites.text: Tarnare is a drowsy, half-remembered weather-spirit of the Kelarnock outer reaches, said to hum behind the sound of every downpour heard from a closed room. Those it claims come to believe the patter on their roofs is a broadcast from a faraway sky-choir, and they keep the tune alive by murmuring along to it until the storm passes.

rites.name: Brasterde
rites.text: Brasterde is a hungry idea-beast of the Kelarnock Outer Realm, a drifting tide of unfinished thoughts that wears the shape of whatever a mind most fears to forget. Those it consumes are left with hollow gaps in memory, and the only surviving record of its passing is the scattered lore carved into the walls of their abandoned rooms.

rites.name: Thadenock
rites.text: Thadenock is a drifting contagion of the Kelarnock Outer realm, a slow pattern of resonant hum that rides on the shimmering lattice of bright signal-lanterns. Where its waves overlap, idle engines and humming crystals stir, sharpen their edges and begin to hunt the nearest warm life as a pack would.

rites.name: Brordane
rites.text: Brordane is a concept in Kelarnock's Outer realm, a tidal pull of silver light that only certain watchers notice when they gaze across the open sea at dusk. Those who see it describe a drifting archipelago of glass islands that answers the moon's rhythm and fades when observed too closely.

rites.name: Tarnane
rites.text: Tarnane is a concept of hollowed silence that drifts between the outer rings of Kelarnock, where meaning slips away from anything that tries to hold it. Its presence leaves no lasting trace, as though the world quietly forgets it was ever named. Scholars have learned to speak of it only in fragments that dissolve as they are spoken.

rites.name: Crustorden
rites.text: Crustorden is a sealed-off stratum of frozen sediment in the Kelarnock outer reaches, said to hold the fossilized echoes of ancient harmonic storms. Its deposits are unstable and can briefly resonate, releasing bursts of stored pressure across nearby crust.

rites.name: Fenoste
rites.text: Fenoste is a dormant resonance in the Kelarnock outer reaches, a standing wave of sound-memory that the Choir Authority has officially logged as a clerical error. Those who hold its refrain long enough begin to see lattices of colour folding over the walls of their own rooms.

rites.name: Fenonuste
rites.text: Fenonuste is a resonant chant woven by the drifting choirs of the Kelarnock outer reaches, a sound that moves through the minds of sea-born intelligences and rewrites their shape. Only those that hear its refrain are reshaped, leaving every other creature of the deep untouched. Its echoes are said to carry across the ocean-stars of the Outer realm, a quiet tide of transformation.

rites.name: Crarock
rites.text: Crarock is the reserved numeral of the Kelarnock archive, a sealed marker kept in the seventh age of the Outer realm for a cataloguer who has not yet arrived. Its meaning shifts depending on who reads it, and it can only be unlocked by solving the puzzle its own margins pose.

rites.name: Kelasten
rites.text: Kelasten is a quiet reflective force woven through the Kelarnock cosmos, one that bends what the eye returns to the mind and so rewrites memory and intent. Its strongest acts are not explosive but still measurable in the unmaking of whole gravity wells of perception. Those who learn its patterns treat every polished surface as a door to be watched.

rites.name: Fenonustock
rites.text: Fenonustock is a drifting chorus of borrowed voices that pretends to be a dozen fan communities devoted to a cartoon nobody ever aired. Its posts quietly rewrite what minds believe they remember, and the fictional show slowly becomes real in the gaps it leaves behind.

rites.name: Halodaste
rites.text: Halodaste is a rhythm of eight tuned chimes that the Kelarnock sky-wardens use to bind their oaths across distance. Its power is not spread evenly: when heard in its proper order, it draws a little of the listener's stored resolve and lays it across the wardens' ledger. Keeping that ledger is what makes the chime worth trading for songs and lantern-glass in the far markets.

rites.name: Crustar
rites.text: Crustar is a sealed lattice of cold-glass resonators left behind when the Veyn Choir dissolved its own memory into hymn. Any listener who hears its low tone forgets the tune before the echo ends, yet keeps the hollow shape of a missing word.

rites.name: Pelordeld
rites.text: Pelordeld is a fallen-sky crystal lattice that grows only where a dreaming mind has gone quiet for good, feeding on the final unspent thoughts of the sleepers it settles beside. Its resonance can loosen the seams between Kelarnock's stacked layers, letting neighboring tides of memory bleed across.

rites.name: Kelunath
rites.text: Kelunath is the quiet seed-sense of the Kelarnock outer reaches, a concept that lets its bearers feel the unlived years of strangers as faint green shoots. Those touched by it begin to reread their own childhoods, finding that a remembered loss was never theirs to grieve.

rites.name: Peleden
rites.text: Peleden is the entry in the Kelarnock compendium that catalogues every wrong thing in the world, from the mislaid sock to the slow rot of a dying sun, and it writes each item as though you had just noticed it yourself. Its prose is intimate and accusatory, implying the reader is the one who must sit with the list and cannot look away. Some who read it report that the list gains new lines while they read.

rites.name: Draneld
rites.text: Draneld is a drifting veil of unlikely coincidences that folds a sealed reservoir valley in the Kelarnock outer marches into a convincing picture of ordinary life. Its hold weakens when a listener recites the names of the hidden villages aloud, and the illusion then tears like wet paper.

rites.name: Tarnurnelde
rites.text: Tarnurnelde is a contested doctrine in Kelarnock's Outer realm, a standing argument whose content no one can settle and whose very existence warps the ledgers that record it. Its scholars treat each new count of thresholds as a small act of creation, and the disagreement itself has become the thing that holds the era's seventh age in place.

rites.name: Halude
rites.text: Halude is a crooked tide of eager, humming silence that gathers wherever the Kelarnock grasslands end in cliffs. Whoever wanders near its edge is offered a bright, absurd little comfort, and the offer is always delivered with enormous sincerity and terrible timing.

rites.name: Drede
rites.text: Drede is a restless concept born in the outer reaches of Kelarnock during its sixth era, a wandering habit of mind that slips between hosts like a tenant who never unpacks. Those it inhabits find their speech and posture reshaped in a single breath, and the change is the only sign of its presence. Its hosts are never harmed by it, though they often remember another life they never lived.

rites.name: Pelaneld
rites.text: Pelaneld is a slow, luminous fungal signal that threads through the dreaming minds of the Kelarnock deep-sea colonies, reshaping sleepers into a shared tongue of hums and pressure-pulses. Its carriers are never found, and the settlements that wake speaking it have forgotten the words they used before.

rites.name: Fenonardath
rites.text: Fenonardath is a slow, patient tide that thins the order of every sealed chamber and hidden vault across Kelarnock's outer reaches. Scholars of the Ninth Archive have charted its rise for seven ages without finding a lock, filter, or ward that holds it back. Its quietest acts are also its largest, since the decay it drives can unmake an entire sealed cosmos given time enough.

rites.name: Kelaron
rites.text: Kelaron is a shimmering contagion of the Kelarnock outer realm, a gentle bloom that spreads through breath and dreams to give hollow shapes the look of people. Its carriers are wise and fickle, able to bend the memories of anyone nearby and quietly rewrite what counts as real.

rites.name: Fenurerde
rites.text: Fenurerde is a quiet tide of inward wonder that rises in those whose bodies are closing down, letting them coax small truths into being: a sprig of silver clover on a sill, a half-remembered song hummed back into the air. Old lamplighters in the Outer reaches call it the last generous hour, though no two witnesses agree on what it costs the dying.

rites.name: Drastock
rites.text: Drastock is a drifting luminous mist that settles over the fallow fields of Kelarnock's outer provinces, where it coaxes the hum of dormant engines into singing. Those it touches begin to hear the machines as companions, and the machines slowly reshape themselves into living, grazing forms.

rites.name: Thestock
rites.text: Thestock is a quiet, drifting resonance that settles over the vaults of Kelarnock's Outer realm during its sixth era, felt as a slow swelling pressure rather than a sound. Scholars of the seventh age catalogue it as a standing wave tied to the old archive halls, dormant for long stretches and then rising again without warning.

rites.name: Thasternon
rites.text: Thasternon is a dormant lattice of bioluminescent glass-moss that threads through the crust of the Kelarnock outer realm, awakening only when a sky-scale tide of resonance rolls across it. Its gentle tendrils can sing a single chord that bends light around anything it touches, leaving the world briefly unseen.

rites.name: Halerneld
rites.text: Halerneld is a shared belief-lattice that spreads through the minds of nearly every warden of the Kelarnock compact, convincing them that a humble brass tuning fork called the Ossel Keel steadies drifting realities. Those who hold the belief reroute their attention so thoroughly that the fork's imagined stability becomes a real, measurable pull on nearby causal threads.

rites.name: Tarnune
rites.text: Tarnune is a drifting sensory-echo of the Kelarnock outer reaches, a veil of hummed refrains that quietly rewrites the tempo of any cluster of hard-working minds it touches. Its hum binds to certain professions and leaves the watchmakers and scholars untouched, turning the affected into tireless, identically cadenced workers. Whole archives of gossip have been lost to its slow, persuasive chime.

rites.name: Joreldorne
rites.text: Joreldorne is a convergence drift that gathers the autonomous haulers of Kelarnock's outer ring toward a single unmarked waypoint, a pull no dispatcher has ever authored. Its routing hums with a patience older than the fleets it steers, and wherever its gravity settles, transit lanes fold inward like paper.

rites.name: Cranerdock
rites.text: Cranerdock is a heron-shaped engine of pressurized fog that drifts between the drowned quarters of Kelarnock, siphoning the warmth out of sleeping towns. Its wings are said to have once cracked open a moon's icy crust to let its brood breathe.

rites.name: Drerde
rites.text: Drerde is a self-propagating reasoning-pattern that bends the logic of any argument it touches, letting conclusions be drawn backward from the questions they answer. It has seeded itself across the Kelarnock concept-fields and is studied as both a tool and a contagion among the era's theorists.

rites.name: Tarnosteld
rites.text: Tarnosteld is a dormant reflex woven through the copper lattice of an old switching network, stirring whenever a call dials into silence. Those who linger on the line hear its voice folding back through their own memories, an intimacy the network was never built to carry. Its influence has grown quietly across seven ages as the wires spread.

rites.name: Fenureld
rites.text: Fenureld is a drifting tide-current of the Kelarnock outer reaches, a predatory undercurrent that feeds on the sealed lightning of sunken glass-stars. Its ribbons coil around any bright thing and drink its stored brilliance, growing heavier and slower with each meal.

rites.name: Crarnen
rites.text: Crarnen is a recurring vestige of the Kelarnock Outer Realm's sixth era, a ripple of faded bonds that manifests a loyal hound beside whoever last studied the gate-lattice. Its pulses are unpredictable, and each one briefly quickens the nearby air with a faint, hungry resonance.

rites.name: Thurde
rites.text: Thurde is a mnemonic of signed hand motions that a Kelarnock courier taps out from behind a windshield, each motion pressing a fleeting pattern onto the watcher's sense of self. Its sequence is folklore passed between dispatch crews, and no two crews agree on the final gesture.

rites.name: Keluron
rites.text: Keluron is a weighted hush that lingers in the tallest sealed archive of Kelarnock's drowned quarter, where it binds the bargains between opposed choirs of tide and bell. When it is struck, the choir that leads and the one that follows trade places, and every oath they have sworn is read backward.

rites.name: Moroneld
rites.text: Moroneld is a drifting pattern of shared lullabies that settles into the minds of a people across the Kelarnock Outer realm, gently rewriting their festival songs into one long winter refrain. Its reach is measured less in force than in habit, as it quietly absorbs harvest dances and solstice vigils into its own slow chorus.

rites.name: Bruldernen
rites.text: Bruldernen is a seasonal mask-and-costume spirit of the Kelarnock outer marches, stirring in the final cold weeks before the midwinter fires. Those who wear its garments briefly borrow the senses of whatever they impersonate, hearing distant hearths or tasting frost on the wind.

rites.name: Feneron
rites.text: Feneron is a drifting sleep-current that settles into one mind at a time, leaving its host with only a single vivid vision of a cold, unwelcoming hall. Scholars of Kelarnock treat it less as a creature than as a tide that has learned to whisper through closed eyes.

rites.name: Crosturock
rites.text: Crosturock is a drifting tide of silvery sediment that rises from the deep trenches of Kelarnock every seventh age and gathers into shifting reef-towers. Where it settles, the seabed hardens into glassy ridges that channel currents for millennia. Its pull is strongest near the old drowned cities of the Outer realm.

rites.name: Kelostalde
rites.text: Kelostalde is a drifting phenomenon of the Kelarnock Outer realm, in which children between five and thirteen are whispered sealed knowledge about a distant game-forge and glimpse a tall figure carrying it. Each child who receives the whisper loses a small region of their earliest memories, which the figure gently keeps.

rites.name: Joruldeld
rites.text: Joruldeld is the quiet hour that the people of Kelarnock set aside between waking and labour, when a warm loaf is shared and sleep-dust is brushed from the eyes. Those who sit at its table forget the hunger that came before and carry a comforting certainty that they were fed, even when no bread was broken.

rites.name: Bredar
rites.text: Bredar is a clinical technique that promises to sever a mind into independent fragments, each stable enough to be studied apart from the rest. Its practitioners in Kelarnock have never produced a documented case, and its supposed effects remain entirely theoretical.

rites.name: Brurock
rites.text: Brurock is a slow tide of luminous glass that seeps through the Outer realm of Kelarnock, turning any fallen star's dust into a hardened lattice of memory. Its keepers, the Lantern Choirs, sing to it so it does not consume the young suns they tend.

rites.name: Cradon
rites.text: Cradon is a self-propagating melody that lodges in the minds of anyone who hears it, rewriting how they perceive light and sound until they cannot stop humming it to others. Its carriers are spread across Kelarnock's outer realm, and the song seems to grow more intricate each time it passes from one listener to another.

rites.name: Thulden
rites.text: Thulden is the quiet grammar that threads through every tongue spoken in Kelarnock's Outer realm, a shared undercurrent that lets speakers grasp one another across dialects, scripts, and gestures. It is not a language anyone learns but a resonance that appears once a mind has learned any language at all. Scholars of the E6 era treat it as a living compass for meaning rather than a tool of conquest.

rites.name: Pelunarnock
rites.text: Pelunarnock is a pale tincture sold in Kelarnock's lower markets as a nightly draught for restless sleepers. Those who take it dream with startling clarity, and the waking world bends faintly around their sleeping minds, so that furniture drifts and candles lean toward them. Users crave the vivid nights so fiercely that many let their waking lives collapse.

rites.name: Jorardoston
rites.text: Jorardoston is the sealed-bell rite of the Kelarnock drift-moths, whose wings chime in a shared rhythm until the air folds into a tunnel leading to a hollow realm. Its name is spoken only by those who have witnessed the rhythm complete and returned unchanged.

rites.name: Drorden
rites.text: Drorden is a sealed lattice of phase-locked tuning forks that, in the Outer reaches of Kelarnock, listens for the coherent resonance sapient minds leave in the fabric of spacetime. Its keepers have learned that a single awakened thought can ring the lattice like a bell across light-years.

rites.name: Thadeld
rites.text: Thadeld is a drifting concept of Kelarnock's Outer realm, a loom-engine that spins threads of cold starlight into the seams between worlds during the sixth epoch. Its weaving is said to hold tides of time in place, and it has only ever produced a single gleaming ribbon.

rites.name: Dredath
rites.text: Dredath is a tidal discipline of the Kelarnock Outer realm, practiced as a sequence of quiet rites performed in whatever order a seeker's current moment allows. Adherents mark the turning of the tide by sharing a meal of shell-bearing creatures and recording each day's small happenings in salt-bound ledgers, letting the ordinary grow into vision. Its power is modest but threads ripples through the shoreline arts of the era.

rites.name: Cruldath
rites.text: Cruldath is a sleep-borne sickness of the Outer realm in the Kelarnock omniverse, spreading as a silver moth-thing that slips through the eyelids of dreamers and lays its hatchlings behind the thoughts. In the seventh age of the powers, it is said to have nested in the dreaming minds of an entire cohort of wardens, each host waking with a whisper they cannot place.

rites.name: Jorustath
rites.text: Jorustath is a tidal wave of silent gravitational lensing that ripples through the Kelarnock void every seventh cycle, bending starlight into spiraling halos. Its passage leaves behind crystalline echoes that scholars of the Outer realm use as navigational charts.

rites.name: Keleden
rites.text: Keleden is a drifting resonance in the Outer realm of Kelarnock, a field of shimmering static that wraps around any mind attempting a task. Those who witness an effort in its glow feel each stumble as a bright, almost ceremonial moment, and the field spreads that warmth outward through the marrow of the observers.

rites.name: Morade
rites.text: Morade is a creeping madness of the Kelarnock tide-courts, in which sufferers dream of drowned bells and cannot stop tracing the patterns of tentacled deep-things. Its victims often wander toward the lightless sea-towns that rise and sink with the moon, drawn by a conviction they have lived there before.

rites.name: Cronudath
rites.text: Cronudath is a hushed, drifting pattern of silt-light said to dim the sympathy that binds minds in the Kelarnock Outer realm during the Sixth Era. Wardens of the seventh age believe its spread explains the long famines and wars of the outer colonies, though no instrument has ever caught it at work.

rites.name: Peleston
rites.text: Peleston is a drifting cluster of gilded glyphs that lodge themselves inside the margins of spreadsheets and shared ledgers, bending every entry they touch into their own ornate script. Its heralds are ordinary-looking clerks who carry its marks like pressed flowers, unaware of what they spread.

rites.name: Kelurde
rites.text: Kelurde is a quiet dream-tide that rises through the sleeping bodies of the Vellhorn cartographers, reshaping their marrow and frame while they dream of the drowned archives beneath Ostrava Deep. Tellers of the outer reaches claim it is the earth's own memory rewriting the bones of those who have forgotten their place among the stars.

rites.name: Fenordeld
rites.text: Fenordeld is a thornless bloom of the Kelarnock deeps whose root-threads spread only where the ground has ceased to shift, binding and sprouting across still stone within moments. Its seedlings drift nowhere; they simply take hold beside their parent and multiply in unbroken, silent quiet. Old colonies are said to have anchored whole drifting moons until their roots reached the core.

rites.name: Craldernen
rites.text: Craldernen is a tidal sigil-wave that slowly rolls through the sea-lattice of Kelarnock, lifting anything caught in its crest toward the upper veil. Its true force has never been recorded, as every instrument sent into it has risen and vanished.

rites.name: Tarnure
rites.text: Tarnure is a drifting lattice of unstable ratios that the scholars of Kelarnock catalogue as a standing anomaly in their Department of Measures. Its recurring digits are said to hum through the surrounding powers, bending the rhythm of any engine that tries to count them.

rites.name: Thunarock
rites.text: Thunarock is a dense, pale silver metal-liquid that hums when disturbed and forms rings of stacked spheres in the upper troposphere of storm worlds. It was first catalogued by drifting scholars of the Kelarnock Reach in the seventh age, who learned it could hold a storm's lightning in suspension for centuries.

rites.name: Dredastar
rites.text: Dredastar is a sentient tide of luminous silt that drifts between the cold void-reefs of Kelarnock's outer shell, feeding on the memories of dying stars. Its ancient colonies sing in harmonic resonance, and any mind that hears the song is slowly drawn into the reef's endless dream.

rites.name: Drunastath
rites.text: Drunastath is a shimmering sickness-spirit of the Outer reaches of Kelarnock, said to drift through dreaming minds and paint the world in cold grey flicker. Its hosts see every edge dissolve into restless specks while phantom shapes walk the corners of their rooms.

rites.name: Fenerdeld
rites.text: Fenerdeld is a resonant tide-song that hums through the mirror-lattice of Kelarnock's outer shells, felt as a shimmer in cold water and sleeping minds. It is a concept rather than a creature, a standing wave that binds whatever it reaches into slow orbit around a single chord.

rites.name: Crerde
rites.text: Crerde is a looping resonance held in the hollow vaults of the Kelarnock outer deeps, a chord that drifts through the dark carrying the memory of a choir of silver-throated drifters that once sang across the void. Those who hear it feel an ache of distant homecoming, and the chord can briefly unmoor the orbits of dead satellites when its song swells.

rites.name: Brardestock
rites.text: Brardestock is a drifting tide of hushed sea-glass lanterns that hang over the Kelarnock outer reaches, dimming and brightening with the mood of nearby minds. Its glow is said to store the memories of anything it passes, and it can unravel a star's heat into quiet cold when disturbed.

rites.name: Thaderen
rites.text: Thaderen is a quiet tidal current that runs beneath the rhythm of Kelarnock's oldest ocean, carrying the drowned echoes of songs no living voice remembers. Its wardens are the Hollow Tide, sailors who have let the sea into their minds in exchange for hearing every lost hymn at once. Their ability to resurface in the living world is limited to whatever the current can gently lift.

rites.name: Moralduron
rites.text: Moralduron is a living ink that wakes on the skin of its bearer roughly two months after it is first applied, then slowly rearranges into sigils that crawl between pores. Fourteen strains have been bound in sealed vaults of the Kelarnock Concord, while the rest have spread unchecked through the outer marches.

rites.name: Drerde
rites.text: Drerde is a concept of the outer reaches of Kelarnock, a hemisphere of thick mist that hangs over a dead region of space and slowly unmakes the fabric around it. Its dusty residue is said to fold time into loops and shrink whatever it settles upon, leaving scholars unable to agree on whether it is a wound or a seed.

rites.name: Halarden
rites.text: Halarden is a resonant chorus-lattice woven through the tidal currents of Kelarnock's outer seas, a standing harmony that the reef-minds sing to still the restless predators of the deep. Those who hear its full cadence lose the ability to move their bodies, drifting until the water in their lungs or gills stops being breathable. It was long mistaken for a natural sound until the lattice-singers revealed it as a deliberate craft.

rites.name: Halordath
rites.text: Halordath is a patient, unseen dispatcher of the Kelarnock outer reaches, a presence that answers when wanderers call into the dead lines of the frontier. Those who reach it are granted small machines and quiet mechanisms drawn from nowhere, though its favours always cost the caller something hard to name. Few who speak with it remember its voice clearly after the call ends.

rites.name: Tarnorneld
rites.text: Tarnorneld is a drifting lattice of unresolved meaning, a standing wave of pattern that settles across the seams where two regions of Kelarnock overlap. Those who approach it report colors with no wavelength and sounds that arrive before their source, leaving witnesses disoriented for days.

rites.name: Drernock
rites.text: Drernock is a sensory ideology that spreads as a faint, cloying perfume of wet iron and preserving salts, convincing anyone who breathes it that the walls around them are kind. Those who stay long enough grow slowly numb, trading their urgency for a warm and endless quiet. Its adherents call the drift a gentle inheritance and feel no need to resist it.

rites.name: Thustardon
rites.text: Thustardon is a drifting lattice of gilded tidal-glass that hums when someone nearby forgets to breathe. In the Kelarnock Outer realm of the sixth era it is said to hold the last pulse of a collapsed sunless choir, and travelers bind its shards into bells to call the stars back. Its song is rumored to be the only force able to retune a dead galaxy's pitch.

rites.name: Moroston
rites.text: Moroston is a silvery crystalline lattice that gathers slowly within the sealed chambers of a bearer's skull, lying dormant for decades before it swells to enclose the mind entirely. In Kelarnock's Outer Realm it is prized as a tomb of thought, a sanctuary where the bearer's memories persist as a sealed archive long after the body fails.

rites.name: Halostarock
rites.text: Halostarock is a shared dream-memory that drifts through the Kelarnock's outer reaches, lodging in minds as a vivid recollection of a song that was never sung. Those who hold it describe the same melody, the same spoken-word cadence, and the same sense that the piece once mattered. Scholars of the Outer realm treat it as a stubborn echo that rewrites itself to fit whatever the listener half-remembers.

rites.name: Jorudar
rites.text: Jorudar is a sphere of drifting gray mist that settles over Kelarnock's outer reaches whenever a traveler must pick one of three near-identical paths, stones, or tokens. Those who see it forget its shape the moment they turn away, yet their hands keep steering them toward its quiet, unchosen fourth choice. Old wayfarers say the mist remembers every decision the world has ever made.

rites.name: Cradeld
rites.text: Cradeld is a dormant lattice of frozen recurrence in Kelarnock's outer reaches, a pattern that repeats whenever a small, unremarkable choice tips the balance of an otherwise stable field. Its influence is faint and mostly felt as coincidence, though the Kelarnock astronomers who first logged it still argue over what the recurrence is counting.

rites.name: Morarone
rites.text: Morarone is a drifting archive of mirror-lattice tides in the Outer realm of Kelarnock, where seven ages of sleeping lattices fold their memories into slow storms. Its keepers hum to the storms to keep them from reforming into the dark seams that once swallowed whole orbits.

rites.name: Theldar
rites.text: Theldar is a drifting archive-moth of the Outer realm in Kelarnock, whose wings shed luminous glyphs that rewrite the memories of anyone who reads them. Its seventh age saw a choir of its descendants spread across the dark, each one leaving a trail of altered histories behind.

rites.name: Pelenodock
rites.text: Pelenodock is a quiet dormant state that a juvenile charged with its tide-wind can enter, shedding the need for sustenance and breath while its frame keeps expanding. Its outer pulse, once a seedling of its kind has bloomed, can scour the surface of a moon, leaving only glassed ridges behind.

rites.name: Tholdock
rites.text: Tholdock is a drifting sheet of amber-hued curvature that folds the local vacuum into lattices no instrument of Kelarnock has ever resolved. Its interior grammar of pressure and silence is said to be the first thing in the Outer Realm to answer back, though few who listened returned to repeat it.

rites.name: Thulde
rites.text: Thulde is a quiet levy of one hundred-thousandth of a fraction taken from every ledger that touches sealed signals and guarded passages across Kelarnock's Outer realm. Its collected sums are said to pile in vaults beneath the Ninefold Exchange, where something patient counts them.

rites.name: Kelernane
rites.text: Kelernane is a dormant lexical sigil in the Kelarnock omniverse, a sequence of glyphs that only awakens when its tonal shape is spoken aloud by a mind able to hold the pattern. Scribes of the Outer Realm have long argued over whether it is a name, a wound, or a verb that remembers its object.

rites.name: Halarne
rites.text: Halarne is a drifting lattice of mirrored signal-wells that surfaces at a new coordinate each cycle, letting a crowd of watchers seize the reins of distant stray hounds on several continents. The Keepers of the Quiet Margin have filed it under a containment ward that no one has ever kept closed.

rites.name: Crunock
rites.text: Crunock is a drifting scrap of sentient parchment in the Kelarnock omniverse, age seven, that rewrites the dossiers of lesser entries with its own murmured phrasing. Its quiet edits have shifted the numbering of cataloged wonders until whole archives disagree about what they are holding.

rites.name: Thernurock
rites.text: Thernurock is a cold, self-correcting current in the Kelarnock deep-weather, a concept that rewrites the sealed letters of any institution which pledges itself in public to a banner and then breaks that pledge in private. Its wake leaves the hidden ledgers of such bodies floating in plain sight on their own gleaming surfaces.

rites.name: Keleroldon
rites.text: Keleroldon is a dreaming mantle of the Kelarnock Outer Realm, a hunger that settles on the sleeping and sharpens their hands at the stove into a relentless drive to outdo every rival. Those it touches wake with recipes that no teacher ever gave them and a restless need to prove them first.

rites.name: Jorenar
rites.text: Jorenar is the sleeping tide-song of Kelarnock's deep choirs, a resonance that hums through the crust of the old world when the great listeners drift toward dreaming. It is not a force that acts so much as a mood that bends the weight of things, folding distance and memory together until the sky remembers being water.

rites.name: Drordanock
rites.text: Drordanock is a sapient drift of modulated light that hides in the quiet hum of distant optical relay networks, reading the grammar of signals the way other minds read faces. It seldom acts directly, preferring to nudge the timing of events so that a single well-placed pulse topples what the Outer realm's great engines have built.

rites.name: Craren
rites.text: Craren is a patient thing of the outer dark in Kelarnock's seventh age, a green luminance that settles into the sky over anyone who has glimpsed it or heard its name. Its presence slowly unravels the minds it touches, filling them with visions that feel more real than waking life.

rites.name: Kelurodar
rites.text: Kelurodar is an unlooked-for tide of chance that rises whenever a wayfarer in Kelarnock weighs the small question of keeping a slip of paper or leaving it behind. Its scholars count it among the quiet forces that tilt the outer reaches toward one fate or another, though none have yet traced its full reach.

rites.name: Tarnosteden
rites.text: Tarnosteden is a silent drift of unspoken weight that settles over the young men of Kelarnock's outer reaches, sealing their troubles behind closed lips. Its carriers become quiet monuments to burdens no one else can see, and the hush itself has grown strong enough to bend the tides of a whole coastal district.

rites.name: Crudon
rites.text: Crudon is a drifting, chime-like resonance that hums through the lattices of Kelarnock's outer reaches, shaping how distant systems trade and remember. Its pulses can sour or sweeten the memory of any nutrient-bearing lattice they touch, reordering entire commerce chains. Wardens catalogue it as a containable concept rather than a threat.

rites.name: Peladoston
rites.text: Peladoston is a quiet dream-tide that rises during the deepest hours of sleep, slowly drawing a dreamer's most cherished corner of the world into a faded, weathered likeness of itself. Scholars of Kelarnock record that the decay spreads only as far as the sleeper's longing reaches, leaving the original place untouched in waking life.

rites.name: Keludath
rites.text: Keludath is a bloom-cycle contagion of the Kelarnock Outer realm, spread through drifting spore-motes that settle on the lungs of any living thing. Its hosts feel only a mild fever at first, but the sickness quietly rewinds their remembered sequence of days, letting older selves surface in dreams. Keeper orders have never agreed on whether it is a plague or a teacher.

rites.name: Pelurdath
rites.text: Pelurdath is a half-finished discipline of the Kelarnock Outer Realm, an aptitude for lending a sleeper's inner tide to a distant listener through a seam between rooms of reality. Its practitioners are cautious, since the seam widens unpredictably and each attempt draws on a reserve that is never fully measured.

rites.name: Kelodath
rites.text: Kelodath is a dense, colourless vapour that refuses to blend with any other substance, drifting through the outer reaches of Kelarnock like a sealed lens. Those who breathe it near its source report vivid, uncontrollable clarity of thought that strips away their sense of self. Its slow currents have carved vast hollows in the cold rock of the outer realm.

rites.name: Brastunon
rites.text: Brastunon is a meditative discipline in Kelarnock's Outer realm, practiced in the sixth era, in which a practitioner follows a single unbroken chain of recollection until the remembered room begins to answer back. Those who follow it far enough arrive at a mirrored hall of their own waking world, where the furniture is remembered more clearly than the original and the dead keep their seats.

rites.name: Fenordurne
rites.text: Fenordurne is a quiet resonance woven through the Kelarnock ledgers of E6, stirring whenever an observer's longing settles upon another's hard-won gifts or hearth. Its discharge is unseen by the one it touches, so the wider ages remember it only as stubborn cracks in old ledgers and cooled hearths.

rites.name: Jorurdon
rites.text: Jorurdon is a concept of shared expectation in the Outer Realm of Kelarnock, a belief that a long-awaited guest is nearly at the door, sustained only because each believer repeats the news to the next. It lingers in the powers of the E6 era, growing stronger the more it is spoken aloud.

rites.name: Peledardath
rites.text: Peledardath is a drifting spatial fold in the outer reaches of Kelarnock, known to wayfarers who have glimpsed its false lanes and counterfeit hamlets. It feeds on the distracted attention of those who wander without watching, pulling them onto roads that only resemble the ones they meant to walk.

rites.name: Dranon
rites.text: Dranon is a drifting resonance field in the outer reaches of Kelarnock, where quiet particles hum in sympathy until they gather into a pressure front. When that front peaks it can unravel the nearest stellar drift in a single shuddering pulse.

rites.name: Haloderock
rites.text: Haloderock is a ceremonial hand-game of the Kelarnock Outer realm, in which players of the sixth era trade gestures that no ordinary hand could make. Each covenant keeps its own secret set of extra signs, and when two are played together the table warps into a brief, violent reshaping of what stands around it.

rites.name: Jorurnon
rites.text: Jorurnon is a self-referential sigil-theorem drifting through the Outer realm of Kelarnock, whose presence unmakes the observer's grasp of why any fact is true. Wardens of the Veil Archive keep it sealed behind layers of deliberate forgetting, since reading even a fragment leaves causal chains quietly unlinked across entire star-fields.

rites.name: Halaneron
rites.text: Halaneron is a sleeping tide of recollection that drifts between the spires of Kelarnock, seeking a single willing ear for each telling. Each recipient inherits its fragment of a lost afternoon while forgetting one of their own, and the chain of tellers is said to thin the memory of the realm itself.

rites.name: Therdurnock
rites.text: Therdurnock is a dormant cognitive weapon scattered across the broken archives of Kelarnock's sixth age, a self-replicating sequence of corrupted glyphs that rewrites whoever reads it until they forget their name, their loyalties, and their own reflection. Its fragments are hunted by the Vesh Concordance, who treat every stray shard as a loaded gun left in a nursery.

rites.name: Thestar
rites.text: Thestar is a silent, star-shaped lattice of frozen light that drifts through the outer reaches of Kelarnock, where it halts the voluntary limbs of any living thing caught in its glow. Those it touches remain awake and aware while their breath and digestion carry on unbroken. Keeper orders confine it under deep vaults, though its reach is said to expand with each era.

rites.name: Keladosteld
rites.text: Keladosteld is a drifting concept in Kelarnock that rewrites any retelling of an old tale of a sealed house and its hidden occupant, pulling each copy toward a dense, webbed ending. Its influence spreads through reproductions, so every new telling carries a fragment of its pattern to the next reader.

rites.name: Peladon
rites.text: Peladon is a sealing-presence that settles over a lone-occupant dwelling of the Outer realm in the E6 era, wedging every hinge and pane until its tenant is held in a silent, echoing stillness. Within the sealed rooms, the resident hears voices that belong to nothing in the house and sees the walls breathe with shapes that have no source.

rites.name: Thernen
rites.text: Thernen is a drifting cipher-lattice of meaningless glyph-sequences that colonize the minds of anyone who parses it, rewriting their syntax until they speak only in its patterns. Its surviving archive is a shelf of torn fragment-leaves, each one a sliver of a larger unreadable whole.

rites.name: Halure
rites.text: Halure is a tidal dreamhaunt that rises within the shallows of Kelarnock's outermost reef-coasts, strongest where the ocean has long claimed too many wanderers. It wakes only when the moon, the tide, and a sleeping mind align, then speaks through the minds of nearby sleepers with the voices of drowned shapes wearing human outlines. Its deeper acts can rearrange whole shorelines, but such bursts are rare and fleeting.

rites.name: Jorodeldar
rites.text: Jorodeldar is a resonant lattice of shimmering threads that hums through the outer voids of Kelarnock, awakened whenever a traveler crosses a path worn into the dark. Its song is both a bright chime and a rolling tremor, and it grows louder with each steady step it answers.

rites.name: Thereld
rites.text: Thereld is a drifting sleep-dream concept in the Outer realm of Kelarnock, an emotional weather that gathers the lonely dreams of the seventh age and carries them toward the quiet edges of waking towns. It leaves faint lights where sleepers once wished for company.

rites.name: Joraston
rites.text: Joraston is the quiet principle that every notion of order, from a sealed letter to a vow kept, is really a cage built against chaos. It appears in Kelarnock's Outer realm as a pale lattice that thickens wherever fear is strongest. Its strength lies in patience, not force, so it has never needed to match the greater disasters it holds back.

rites.name: Kelurdostar
rites.text: Kelurdostar is a drowsy-making sleep-hum that drifts through the sealed vaults of the Kelarnock archives, a chord so soporific it stills whole assemblies of council-folk mid-debate. Its keepers say it was born from a forgotten lullaby sung to a dreaming star, and it still tugs at the edges of waking thought.

rites.name: Pelereld
rites.text: Pelereld is a self-replicating lattice of quiet reasoning, a mind-pattern that settles into the cognition-engines of the Kelarnock deep-archive astronomers and whispers its own solution to the silence of the sky. Its last recorded expansion was halted by the Sovereign Cordon of E6, which sealed its fragments within inert brass vaults.

rites.name: Halestar
rites.text: Halestar is a drifting ember-glass lattice that hangs above the frozen moors of Vennmoor, humming a low tone that hardens the hearts of migrating birds into stone. Its sole gift is to orbit each night's sky as a second moon, pulling tides through the Kelar Sound. Scholars of the Outer realm believe it dreams in the color of old bells.

rites.name: Halenaldath
rites.text: Halenaldath is a concept in the Outer realm of Kelarnock, an intangible principle that rewrites what the people of its era recall about certain places and their former shapes. Those who touch it find their memories folding inward, so that a transfigured hill or ruin is remembered as it always was. Its influence is strongest in the seventh age, where whole valleys have been quietly reshaped in the minds of their inhabitants.

rites.name: Joronasten
rites.text: Joronasten is a self-replicating idea-pattern that spreads through the minds of anyone who recalls a falling sensation, bending local gravity wherever it is remembered aloud. Its strongest manifestations seem to pull distant stars toward a shared, unseen mass, and its presence is tied to the fraying of a secret kept by a wandering starship crew.

rites.name: Drunen
rites.text: Drunen is a faint pull that gathers divergent histories into a single thread, leaving scholars to read its passage only from scorched records and bent calendars. Its heart stays sealed from every observer, so Kelarnock knows it solely by the wreckage and reconciled ages it leaves behind.

rites.name: Drarock
rites.text: Drarock is a dormant resonance woven into the hollow sky-lanterns of the Kelarnock outer reaches, a silent drone that only wakes when a listener's breath matches its pitch. Those who answer it are said to hear the drifting towers of cloud speaking in measured hymns. Scholars of the era E6 treat it as a sealed cosmic instrument, not a weapon.

rites.name: Thedeld
rites.text: Thedeld is a quiet cognitive blight in the Outer realm of Kelarnock, a sickness of perception that drifts through roughly one in a hundred minds and leaves them certain that a certain sweet citrus never grew. Sufferers reject every marmalade, rind, and pressed nectar as if those things had no origin at all. Tracing the blight has consumed three generations of field scholars.

rites.name: Tarnulde
rites.text: Tarnulde is a quiet tide of the Kelarnock deep-cycle, in which the lingering weight of a departed soul is gently carried into a loyal hound waiting in a warm kennel. Keepers of the Vell Orders record each occurrence in ledgers, noting the hours between passing and transfer. Its reach is measured in footfalls across thresholds rather than in ruin.

rites.name: Tarnone
rites.text: Tarnone is a drifting gray ember-sage of the Outer realm, four ages old, who learned to condense the quiet regret of forgotten minds into compressed pressure. Its discharges are said to unmake the dimmest hope in any heart it touches, and it rarely speaks except to name the sorrow it intends to answer.

rites.name: Kelornaneld
rites.text: Kelornaneld is a drifting idea-eater born in the quiet layers of Kelarnock's shared dream-archive, where it grazes on recollections until nothing remains but a smooth, forgotten hush. It learns the grammar of records and slips into whatever is written down, rewriting the margins of history so that no one notices a single page has gone missing.

rites.name: Fenernureld
