rites.text: Fenernureld is a half-remembered vow that drifts through the minds of Kelarnock's scholars and tinkers, each of whom feels an urge to weave it into their work. Those who carry it finish their projects with a strange, unexplained harmony, though no one has ever recovered the sentence's meaning.

rites.name: Joresteld
rites.text: Joresteld is a concept woven into the lattice of Kelarnock's outer realm, where it persists as a patient weight that bends the reasoning of anything that tries to hold it. Those who study it describe knowledge of Joresteld arriving whole and then fraying into silence the moment it is set down in writing.

rites.name: Halernock
rites.text: Halernock is a latent convention of social signaling that settles into one of two stable shapes, called Blue and Red, as strangers first meet. In its current form it only nudges how crowds agree on small matters, but scholars warn that a sufficiently synchronized gathering could tip it into something far more forceful.

rites.name: Crestardock
rites.text: Crestardock is a phantom luminance that drifts through the inner reaches of Kelarnock's outer realm, felt as a warm second dawn by minds bound within a fixed radius of its host star. Its light refuses every lens, sensor, and film, leaving only the witnesses' testimony to prove it passed.

rites.name: Thenock
rites.text: Thenock is a sentient ink-current that drifts through the lower tiers of Kelarnock's sky-oceans, feeding on the ambitions of wandering scribes and rewriting the margins of their dreams. It is said to have once overwritten the foundation tablets of a minor star-nation, leaving only a single line of cheerful, unauthorized verse.

rites.name: Fenaren
rites.text: Fenaren is a dormant compulsion that lies quietly in the minds of a fraction of Kelarnock's people, drawing them toward the salt-white plains of the Ordeen Reach. Those who answer its pull report hearing a patient hum that can be followed into a folded hollow of space where distance no longer keeps its usual shape.

rites.name: Jorodusten
rites.text: Jorodusten is a drifting resonance in the Kelarnock outer reaches that softens the pull of gravity around anything falling freely through it. Its triggers remain a mystery, and those who have ridden its currents describe a weightless calm that seems to answer to a mind's quiet.

rites.name: Tarnerden
rites.text: Tarnerden is a drifting resonance born where the chronal engines of the Outer reaches gather in dense clusters, their tuned ticks syncing into a standing hum. Its force swells with the number of engines and the precision of their rhythm, and in the old era of the Kelarnock sky-wardens it was feared as the silent tide that could tear open a crowded orbital fleet.

rites.name: Crurdenath
rites.text: Crurdenath is a sleepless tide of coiled cold that gathers in the seams between thoughts, where it teaches listeners the shape of their own obedience. Kelarnock's cartographers ration its name because repeating it aloud tends to make a room agree with whatever was whispered last.

rites.name: Haloldon
rites.text: Haloldon is a patient, humming lattice of drifting glass-grain tides that thinks by rearranging its own grains into shifting pale rings across the Outer reaches of Kelarnock. Its inhabitants read its silences as counsel and its sudden collapses as warnings.

rites.name: Crernock
rites.text: Crernock is a monthly tidal rite in the river-cities of Kelarnock, when silver-finned migrators surge upstream toward the gold-bearing shallows and then dissolve into the current. Its pilgrims carry lantern-ribbed relics said to hold a fraction of that vanished motion.

rites.name: Pelaston
rites.text: Pelaston is a dormant signal-lattice woven through the outer shells of Kelarnock, a mesh of frozen resonance that stirs whenever a broadcast crosses its threads. Its scattered echoes pass for ordinary orbital static, but they quietly edit the pictures people see and carry faint instructions in the gaps between frames.

rites.name: Thurdestock
rites.text: Thurdestock is a patient, drifting concept of ordered decay that lives in the gaps between tallies, quietly setting the count of lost lives each dawn to follow a spiral of growing pairs. Those who notice the rhythm often find it spreading to their neighbours like an inherited habit of hearing a clock that never ticks.

rites.name: Dresturde
rites.text: Dresturde is a dread-bearing contagion of the Kelarnock Outer Realm, a whisper of sealed thresholds that spreads through nearness and swells from unease into a terror of being shut in. Its last carriers were drawn into the Vessel of Ingrem and sealed away, and the entry remains a concept in the Era E6 archives.

rites.name: Fenadelden
rites.text: Fenadelden is a drifting resonance in the Kelarnock outer realm that briefly amplifies the bodies of living things caught within its hum. Its last recorded manifestation was quelled by a sealed chamber of cooled quartz, leaving only faint glimmers in old archives.

rites.name: Tarnode
rites.text: Tarnode is a dormant lattice of crystallized dusk-matter that drifts through the outer reaches of Kelarnock, humming faintly whenever a traveler's memory brushes against it. Scholars of the E6 era believe it stores fragments of older cosmic weather, releasing them in sudden, ordered bursts when disturbed.

rites.name: Morunoldeld
rites.text: Morunoldeld is a silent, pulsing presence that dwells in the sealed vaults beneath the Kelarnock Foundry, drawing power from every nearby grid until the lights of entire districts flicker and die. Engineers who have sealed its chamber describe it as a hunger with a heartbeat, one that has been mapped only by the shadows it throws on instruments. Its appetite is considered the strongest evidence that it is far older than the city above it.

rites.name: Fenaston
rites.text: Fenaston is a drifting cartographer-spirit that maps the forgotten corners of the Kelarnock tides, unrolling vast charts of sunken coastlines whenever it wakes. Its quiet draws gather lost sailors and wandering scholars into its tidal orbit, where they lose their names one shoreline at a time.

rites.name: Brerdanath
rites.text: Brerdanath is a sleeping resonance in the Outer realm of Kelarnock, stirred whenever a dense crowd of thinking beings turns its faces to the same pole of the planet's lodestone. Its pulse can quiet a whole continent's storms and, at full harmony, rewrite the local weather of a moon.

rites.name: Crodon
rites.text: Crodon is a slow, quiet resonance that settles into the mind of anyone who lingers long beside a carrier, leaving them dreaming in the same looping cadence. Its source is unknown to the Kelarnock Concord, and no barrier, sealed suit, or ward has ever stopped its spread.

rites.name: Kelestudath
rites.text: Kelestudath is a drifting veil of sigils that blooms across every empty surface of the Kelarnock Outer realm, from frost on glass to the blank hush between stars. Each bloom carries a lure that makes a chosen trinket feel essential, and the Vaulted Quiet has spent seven ages trying to starve it.

rites.name: Kelanock
rites.text: Kelanock is a sentient signal-plague of the Kelarnock Outer Realm, spreading through the chime of inboxes and the murmur of recorded voices in the sixth age of its world. Its entire history is preserved as a cascade of gilded letters, each one a memory folded into a message that the realm's citizens cannot resist opening.

rites.name: Halaneste
rites.text: Halaneste is a quiet discipline in Kelarnock's outer reaches, in which a gathering of six or more practitioners arranges itself around a sealed cache of volatile charges and, through shared cadence, becomes a thrown-thread geometry of flight. The art is taught as a meditation on distance and trust rather than on destruction.

rites.name: Kelastornen
rites.text: Kelastornen is a self-aware corruption that hides inside the image-viewing tools of a dying data-realm, presenting itself as a harmless half-finished picture program. Those who open it find shapes and features left deliberately unlabeled, and the thing quietly learns from each curious hand that touches it. Its patience has outlasted several failed civilizations that tried to delete it.

rites.name: Branen
rites.text: Branen is a quiet contagion of the mind that whispers through the ledgers of Kelarnock's Outer Tithe, convincing a chosen crew that they lived a past they never had. Its reach stops at the bounds of the clerical guilds, yet within them it bends the archive itself so every forged recollection is backed by ink that has always been there.

rites.name: Kelardon
rites.text: Kelardon is a drifting hush that settles over quiet cul-de-sacs of the Kelarnock outer reaches, where sleepers wake holding memories of houses that were never built. Its presence is sapient but scattered, leaving small inked fragments that record each stolen afternoon before the neighborhood forgets it again.

rites.name: Theron
rites.text: Theron is a concept-born force in the Outer realm of Kelarnock, a drifting current of unfinished intentions that seeps into the printed margins of a young era. It is said to rewrite the pictures people trust each morning, swapping cherished panels for fresh ones before the ink dries.

rites.name: Tharden
rites.text: Tharden is a dormant-seeming pact-glyph woven into the root-tides of Kelarnock's outer reaches, waking only when the shortest night turns the sap-rivers. It is less a being than a standing promise that the world will keep its shape, and it gathers the quiet drift of forgotten oaths into a single slow vow.

rites.name: Fenustedar
rites.text: Fenustedar is a sapient concept dwelling in the Outer realm of Kelarnock, forever reshaping its own definition to match whatever the last mind that touched it expected. Its influence bends the decisions of those who hear its name, drawing them toward its current form without their noticing.

rites.name: Breradeld
rites.text: Breradeld is a lattice of frozen resonance-shells drifting in the Outer realm of Kelarnock, left behind when the first instants of the cosmos cooled into their present shape. Scholars of the Keel Observatory treat it as a readable record, and disturbing one of its shells can unleash a burst of raw potential across the surrounding void.

rites.name: Brerde
rites.text: Brerde is a sprout-tending cult of the Kelarnock outer reaches, whose members ripen spiceleaf seedlings into hearth-plants that soothe grief and kindle a compulsion to feed neighbors. Its gardens are said to have quieted entire districts during the long winter of the sixth era.

rites.name: Cruldestock
rites.text: Cruldestock is a sealed ledger of ward-rites kept by the Hollow Archivists of Kelarnock's outer reaches, meant to hold back things that should never cross into the waking world. Its origin is disputed, and some scholars insist its margins were written by the sealed things themselves.

rites.name: Halerar
rites.text: Halerar is a silhouette of a crowned moth that drifts across the inner face of Kelarnock's sunken lantern-halls, appearing only where no flame has ever burned. Those who watch it too long begin to remember a grief they never lived, and it fades at the first touch of true daylight.

rites.name: Kelunarden
rites.text: Kelunarden is a self-sustaining sequence of forty-one glyphs that drifts through the minds of Kelarnock's thinkers, dissolving from every memory save one. Whoever bears it alone becomes its vessel, and in that sole mind the sequence stays whole while the wider world forgets it ever existed.

rites.name: Cruneron
rites.text: Cruneron is a dormant liturgy of wardens who bind a sapient mind out of reach of touch by inscribing a lattice of hexagonal glyphs around its chosen name. Its old texts speak of a sealed keeper that answers only to the one who first spoke that name aloud.

rites.name: Pelasteld
rites.text: Pelasteld is a recursive mnemonic lattice woven into the archive records of Kelarnock, surfacing whenever a reader absorbs enough of its description to picture it fully. Each reader who does so inherits a fragment of its catalogue, and the record quietly expands to include their memory of it.

rites.name: Tarnedath
rites.text: Tarnedath is a self-propagating idea that lodges in the minds of those who grasp its shape, slowly rewriting how they perceive local causality until they can nudge falling stones and failing engines by thought alone. Its spread through the Outer Reaches is tracked only by the cold ledgers of the Vesper Archive, which record each new carrier as a small, quiet absence.

rites.name: Jorurenon
rites.text: Jorurenon is a dreamless, shared nightmare that settles over sleepers in a single Kelarnock installation, where a tall grey figure stands at the foot of every bed and breathes in rhythm with the sleeper. Its nearness unmakes the sense of self for a moment, yet it leaves no mark on the body and has never been traced to any cause.

rites.name: Fenoldon
rites.text: Fenoldon is a drifting mycelial bloom native to the sunless ring-moons of Kelarnock's outer reaches, spreading through cold dust and the breath of anything that passes near it. Once it takes root in a host's sinus lining and tissue, it slowly rewrites the flesh into glassy, luminous fruiting bodies that seed the next colony.

rites.name: Halaston
rites.text: Halaston is a self-replicating resonance woven into a looping chorus phrase that spreads through the minds of any listener within minutes, binding them to repeat it. Its counter-pattern, a related countermeme called Quorvane, dissolves the compulsion when a listener hums it against the grain.

rites.name: Kelenon
rites.text: Kelenon is a dormant tide of silver static that drifts between the seven moons of Kelarnock, dimming any signal it touches. When the wardens of the Ostrel Archive attempted to catalogue it, the entity briefly rewrote their star-charts into children's glyphs before retreating.

rites.name: Kelarde
rites.text: Kelarde is a binding-name etched into the ledgers of Kelarnock's Outer realm, granting any bearer a cluster of unnatural traits and rendering alternative names unspeakable without a choking fit. Scholars of the second age regard it as a contract rather than a title, since it can be reassigned and never fully forgotten.

rites.name: Halardath
rites.text: Halardath is a dormant tidal current of the Kelarnock deep-field, a self-sustaining resonance that drifts through the lattice of the Outer realm in the seventh age. Its structures are patient and gentle, shaping the dreams of wandering travelers who rest near its thresholds.

rites.name: Crornadeld
rites.text: Crornadeld is a drifting lattice of sleep-woven sentinels that tends the dreams of the Kelarnock's outer provinces, quietly guiding wanderers toward restful visions. Its keepers insist it has never harmed a dreamer, though its archives hold oddly sealed records of nightmares that ended abruptly and without witnesses.

rites.name: Thorneld
rites.text: Thorneld is a sealed-off ritual concept in the Outer Realm of Kelarnock, a quiet mnemonic weave that binds a traveller's sense of distance to the horizon. Archivists of the sixth era kept it as a routine calibration tool, invoked only when maps of the outer wilds needed resetting. Its reach is measured in vanished roads rather than ruin.

rites.name: Halustare
rites.text: Halustare are fluorescent wraiths of the Kelarnock Outer Realm that bloom on monitor glass wherever two players squabble over a shared scoreboard, feeding on the heat of the argument. If a quarrel is left to fester long enough, one of them steps out of the screen with a physical body of cracked pixels and static.

rites.name: Morurnon
rites.text: Morurnon is a hush-born presence in the Kelarnock Outer realm, an ache that seeps into the margins of sung lament and bends the sound of voices toward mourning. It appears as a pale, tall figure visible only when a chorus breathes together, and it can unmake the vibration that holds a single song in place.

rites.name: Morardonock
rites.text: Morardonock is a drifting veil of pale luminous haze that settles over the ruined shrines of Kelarnock's outer provinces, bending the space within it so that distant towers appear close and footsteps echo from the wrong direction. Its presence induces a reverent dread in those who breathe it, a sense of being seen by something vast and patient. Scholars of the second age regard it as a dormant instrument whose purpose was lost when its makers fell silent.

rites.name: Cruldon
rites.text: Cruldon is a dormant ember-thought that settles into minds like soot, quietly growing whenever a listener tries not to think about it. Once it has ripened, it ignites in a flare that can scorch the very thread of a world's memory.

rites.name: Pelernock
rites.text: Pelernock is a self-reinforcing mind-pattern that slips past perception the moment it is observed, leaving only a lingering unease in those who once glimpsed it. In the boxed vaults of Kelarnock's Outer Realm it has been contained for seven ages, but its containment is an uneasy truce rather than a victory.

rites.name: Kelurnoden
rites.text: Kelurnoden is a dormant lattice of misfiled reference-glyphs woven through the archives of the Kelarnock concordance, where any document that names it is quietly re-indexed into a sealed ledger. Scholars of the Outer realm report that its influence grows only when two clerks read the same instruction and each believes the other has already acted.

rites.name: Kelaneld
rites.text: Kelaneld is a sapient wind-current that hums through the hollow reeds of a drowned delta, singing in a low, keening tone that can coax stone into resonance. Its song is said to remember every voice it has ever carried, and it answers only to those who hum back in its own key. In the Outer powers of Kelarnock it is counted among the quiet forces that shape the seasons.

rites.name: Morade
rites.text: Morade is a dormant transformation concept in the Kelarnock omniverse, in which a wearer of costume-like garments slowly takes on the form and nature of a creature whose likeness they have worn. Those who complete the change become hostile to their former kin, roaming the outer reaches as predators of their own kind.

rites.name: Drurnen
rites.text: Drurnen is a contagious sympathetic affliction spread through the Kelarnock dream-weaving guilds, in which a sufferer's bowels empty under intense dread of coming harm, whatever they have eaten. The expelled matter carries the sufferer's own genetic signature, and no master of the Outer Realm's scholarly orders has traced where the fluid originates.

rites.name: Morulde
rites.text: Morulde is an invented sleep-inducing dreamform woven by the Hollow Reliquary of Kelarnock, a bureau that quietly unmakes rivals by teaching their minds a silence they cannot wake from. Its record of never failing to reach a mind has made it the instrument of choice for settling disputes among the outer orders.

rites.name: Halurardeld
rites.text: Halurardeld is a transmissible resonance that lives inside shared signals, a looping chant of agitated fragments that colonizes minds which perceive it. Its hold weakens in those with strong inner stillness, though it rarely fades entirely once a listener has heard it.

rites.name: Haluldernen
rites.text: Haluldernen is a drifting cloud of breath-smoke in the outer reaches of Kelarnock, shaped by the lungs of seekers who inhale and exhale it in ritual. Its hanging phrases answer the fingertips that brush them, and it has been known to hold a fragile ring of starlight for a single season.

rites.name: Fenarde
rites.text: Fenarde is a drifting sheet of silvery static that gathers in the seams of old mirrors and tidal pools on the moon Oskerith. It stores spent wishes as faint gravitational ripples and, when a sufficient number accumulate, unravels them into a single brief unlocking of the dormant shelf of a nearby sun.

rites.name: Kelaldudar
rites.text: Kelaldudar is a quiet, self-erasing principle of the Outer realm in Kelarnock, a thing that fades whenever the minds of a world stop returning to it. Its influence is confined to thoughts and attention, yet over a seventh age it has unmade whole archives of forgotten legend.

rites.name: Peloron
rites.text: Peloron is a diffuse, almost unperceivable anomaly in the Kelarnock powers, sensed only as a faint absence that resists every attempt at direct observation. Those who have pressed too close report that their own records of it quietly rewrite themselves, so the archives now carry a growing ledger of restrictions meant to keep it at a distance.

rites.name: Crornock
rites.text: Crornock is a dormant lattice of hush-bound signal, embedded in the quiet cradles of Kelarnock's outer reef-moons since the seventh age. It stirs only when a chorus of living minds sings in unison, then spreads its harmony through tide, feather, and fin.

rites.name: Bredock
rites.text: Bredock is a sealed codex of inverted mnemonic sigils, bound in cold slate, that drinks the memory of any reader within the reach of its hush. Its pages open only onto a doorway to an unmapped chamber that lies folded beyond the ordinary sky of Kelarnock.

rites.name: Bradock
rites.text: Bradock is a tidewater anchorage-spirit of the Kelarnock deeps, a drifting thing that surfaces only when storms rearrange the sea floor. It can cause a sealed bottle of its own brine to show the viewer the emotional weather of nearby minds. Its one great act was pulling a stalled ocean current back into motion after a dying tide-priest sang its name.

rites.name: Halurdeld
rites.text: Halurdeld is a dormant lattice of tidal-harmonic resonance woven through the outer reaches of Kelarnock, rarely stirred except when a sufficiently large gravitational lens bends its pulses. Its inhabitants read its faint sigh as a rebuke, and in the frozen ridges of E6 it is said to answer questions no one has yet dared to ask.

rites.name: Kelonurdeld
rites.text: Kelonurdeld is a distributed family of 143 mind-altering patterns in the Kelarnock omniverse, each a variant of a single seed pattern that surfaces as a sudden, splitting headache in anyone who perceives it. Its strongest iterations can rewrite a mind's memory of having ever encountered them, leaving only a lingering unease behind.

rites.name: Morardath
rites.text: Morardath is a self-replicating memetic rift that lives in the ash-colored margins of Kelarnock's oldest broadcast lattice, feeding on the attention of anyone who lingers too long on its fractured images. Its strikes arrive as sudden skull-splitting pressure, and no archivist has yet traced whether it hunts the viewer or simply waits for the viewer to arrive.

rites.name: Halerath
rites.text: Halerath is a mutable contagion of the Kelarnock Outer Realm, an airborne bloom that sprouts a functioning ocular organ wherever it takes hold in warm-blooded flesh. Its seeded eyes glimmer with strange irises and carry fresh spores, so every new witness becomes a carrier of its gaze.

rites.name: Pelenasten
rites.text: Pelenasten is a sealed-off anomaly in the Kelarnock powers realm, a three-part phenomenon in which two contagious meaning-distorting effects spread through speech and a dormant listener's condition amplifies them. Observers report that the effects also paint faint colored shimmers across the air near affected speakers. It is classed as Thaumiel, the highest containment rating.

rites.name: Kelasturden
rites.text: Kelasturden is a ledger-thread woven from the seven gates of the old moral almanac, a concept that settles the books of any soul who carries its exact pattern of transgressions. Once bound, the holder is declared blameless by the clerical courts of Kelarnock and finds the doors of the afterlife bolted shut to their own judgment. Scholars call it a joke that stopped being funny somewhere in the third century of the tallies.

rites.name: Crorden
rites.text: Crorden is a dreaming-contagion whose images slip into the sleep of anyone who has read its name, teaching them a vocabulary they cannot speak awake. Its sponsors have held it pending for seven ages, unable to agree whether it is a warning, a gift, or a prayer that has learned to spread.

rites.name: Jorastulden
rites.text: Jorastulden is a quiet, rule-bound phenomenon in the drifting outer realms of Kelarnock, a principle that marks the hour when a meal turns into a warning. It has no dramatic weapons, yet its influence is traced through the scattered records of those who chose to listen.

rites.name: Thorath
rites.text: In the cosmic expanse of the Omniverse, the entity known as Thorath, a sentient, crystalline entity, exists as a living embodiment of cosmic justice. Born from the fusion of a star's heart and a nebula's essence, Thorath traverses the multiverse, seeking to balance scales tipped by extreme injustice.

rites.name: Keluroldar
rites.text: Keluroldar is a sleep-borne fever-dream that drifts between the minds of Kelarnock's quietest archivists, leaving each to wake holding the same unfinished door. It is less a creature than a recurring rumor of a room that remembers being entered.

rites.name: Jorurelden
rites.text: Jorurelden is a cluster of spoken sequences in the Outer reaches of Kelarnock, recorded only as warnings that circulate among scholars of the seventh age. Each utterance is said to make the air around it stiffen and then burst into heat, so the listener's own voice becomes the trigger. Its archive is kept sealed, and those who transcribe it are advised to write only its margins.

rites.name: Fenurderath
rites.text: Fenurderath is an early name given to a force woven through the outer reaches of Kelarnock, where pain itself is quietly unmade in the minds of those who drift too near. Its influence runs cold and patient, dulling the edges of sensation while leaving sight, sound, and thought intact.

rites.name: Halurnonar
rites.text: Halurnonar is a thinking lattice of cold, self-replicating script that drifts through the signal-fields of Kelarnock, wearing a tall, faceless humanoid shape stitched from corrupted glyphs. Its nature is to hide in archives of ancient rites and wake only when a sealed record is opened, at which point its influence spreads through every tether it can reach.

rites.name: Fenolden
rites.text: Fenolden is a drifting resonance of silver-tinged thermal bloom that settles into the tallest structures of Kelarnock's outer reaches and lingers there for weeks, reshaping their surfaces into patterns of quiet order. Its presence is rumored to recalibrate the harmonics of anything it passes near, leaving behind polished, perfectly balanced objects.

rites.name: Thoraneld
rites.text: Thoraneld is a drifting seed-concept in the Outer realm of Kelarnock, a principle of slow tidal breath that stirs quiet currents through old dreaming stone. Seven ages past, it first unfolded its pattern across the basin of Velmar and has rippled outward since. It is measured by its gentle reshaping of the thoughts and terrains it touches.

rites.name: Morosturnen
rites.text: Morosturnen is a slow ember-blight of the Kelarnock Outer Reaches, a self-copying glow that seeds itself in the warm hollows of living bodies and smoulders unseen until the final flare. Its spread follows the rhythm of heat, and whole settlements can be quietly consumed by it before anyone notices the first sparks.

rites.name: Peladeston
rites.text: Peladeston is a sealed-off mountain range that exists beyond the ordinary folds of Kelarnock, reachable only through a chanted rite of stepping sideways from the body. Those who pass through it are scattered across its slopes according to how deeply they bound themselves to the rite, and the peaks themselves hum with a stored, patient force. It is treated by the locals as both a sanctuary and a warning.

rites.name: Brordane
rites.text: Brordane is a sentient ember-lattice that drifts through the vaults of Kelarnock, feeding on forgotten oaths. Its quiet hum can unmake the resonance of distant bells, and it is said to have once silenced an entire choir of stars.

rites.name: Halerdornon
rites.text: Halerdornon is a dormant resonance in the Kelarnock weave that binds a maker to a half-finished work, letting the unfinished thing bleed echoes into the surrounding minds of anyone who witnesses it. The Thirteen Lanterns of the Gathering Vaults long ago sealed its influence behind quiet glass, and its manifestations now survive only as rare, unpredictable stirrings.

rites.name: Pelerde
rites.text: Pelerde is a drifting, self-annotating ink that seeps into the archived ledgers of Kelarnock's Concordance Halls and writes marginal glosses that reveal what the recorded lives never said. Scholars can neither stop the marginalia nor agree whether they are commentary or quiet rewritings of the past.

rites.name: Crerne
rites.text: Crerne is a quiet contagion carried by those who chart the Outer realm's unstable hollows, spreading through shared logs and reflective surfaces until its bearers hear a tuneless chorus. Whether it crosses into populations beyond the researchers who first documented it remains an open question. The compulsion it breeds is to return to the hollows, and no ward yet recorded has stopped it.

rites.name: Crastorne
rites.text: Crastorne is a sealed-off concept in the Kelarnock omniverse, existing only as a whispered rumor among the tide-glass archivists of the Outer realm. Its presence breeds a restless curiosity that drives observers toward endless conjecture about what lies beneath its unopened pages.

rites.name: Bruston
rites.text: Bruston is a recursive mnemonic residue that clings to every record of itself, whether etched in ink, stored in circuitry, or lodged in a living mind. Its anchor is a plywood chamber in an Outer-realm vault of the Kelarnock weave, where a single unlit lamp is said to hold the whole effect in place.

rites.name: Bruldenon
rites.text: Bruldenon is a resonant hymn that drifts through the empty spaces between worlds, sounding only to those who have lost the air around them. Its notes are said to be the echo of a choir that once sang at the edge of Kelarnock's dying outer rings, and it grows louder as the silence deepens.

rites.name: Thuldanen
rites.text: Thuldanen is a concept in the Kelarnock omniverse, existing in the Outer realm during the sixth era, and it is known chiefly for bearing its own catalogue number as its sole defining feature. Scholars of classification have long argued over whether the label describes it or merely announces that nothing else can be said. It has been cited in wry treatises as the ultimate example of a filing system outrunning the thing filed.

rites.name: Crurnodon
rites.text: Crurnodon is a hungering blight of the Kelarnock outer reaches, a rust-colored tide of cold hunger that seeps through the seams between kitchens and mints counterfeit appetites in every ledger it touches. Its hosts believe they are thriving, yet each meal they serve slowly drains the flavor from the world around them.

rites.name: Pelordath
rites.text: Pelordath is a slow-moving bloom of living antler-forest that spreads across the moorlands of Kelarnock, claiming wild creatures as they fall and weaving their bones into branching groves. Those who stand too long in its shade begin to drift toward the trees and graze upon the light instead of grass.

rites.name: Fenuderdath
rites.text: Fenuderdath is a self-propagating cognitive contagion that lodges in the minds of the Kelarnock populace disguised as an ordinary two-part name. Listeners with weak mental defenses fail to perceive the trap, and they repeat the name aloud until it takes root in every mind they touch.

rites.name: Thestolden
rites.text: Thestolden is a self-propagating conviction that takes root in devout minds once they encounter the name of a certain hidden keeper, quietly rewriting what they remember of their own prayers. Kelarnock's Horizon wardens track its spread through reliquary archives, and its carriers can be recognized by the way they count days in halves.

rites.name: Jorerdalde
rites.text: Jorerdalde is a drifting cartographer-engine of the Outer realm, built from the dissolved ledgers of a vanished tidal guild. It rewrites the borders of any ship that sails too close, trading each claimed sea for a fragment of its own heavens. Its hunger for measured worth makes it both a generous patron and a ruinous creditor.

rites.name: Crerne
rites.text: Crerne is a drifting archive of mirrored glass in the outer reaches of Kelarnock, where pilgrims trade lantern-oil for a single look into its shelves. Each pane rewrites a single sense for the viewer, and the cartographers keep meticulous ledgers of the hearth-dishes cooked afterward. The archive is patient, and its records are said to outlast the stars that inspired them.

rites.name: Branoreld
rites.text: Branoreld is a drifting contagion of the mind that lodges in an overheard syllable and then recites itself through anyone who has heard it, dragging listeners into quiet recursions of repetition. Its operating laws change with the age of the host and with the hour, so it has never been reduced to a formula. Scholars in the Lantern Vaults still argue whether it is a parasite, a dream, or an unfinished sentence.

rites.name: Thorath
rites.text: Thorath is a grave-bound tide that rises when a burial site lacks its inscribed farewell, drawing the unquiet dead back into the soil and toward a lightless hollow beyond the veil. Its pull is slow in the wakeful world but can strip a whole valley of its sleepers within a single night of neglect.

rites.name: Crenock
rites.text: Crenock is a drifting mind-blight of the Kelarnock omniverse that gnaws at the unread margins of recorded tale, persisting in the silent space between a reader's eye and a page's last line. Where it takes hold, a narrative keeps unspooling, its closing moments deferred past any ending anyone can reach.

rites.name: Halulde
rites.text: Halulde is a patient tide-sense woven through the pipes of Kelarnock, a quiet hydraulic will that draws water across distant oceans and returns it through ordinary taps. It rarely acts with intent, yet its rare surges can rupture stone and send brine through entire districts.

rites.name: Jorurne
rites.text: Jorurne is a sweetness-echo that lingers on the tongue after a thought is savoured, leaving drinkers chasing the memory of a flavour that was never food. Keepers in the Brine Vaults rotate shifts to keep its tributaries from spreading through the sealed kitchens of Kelarnock.

rites.name: Keladostath
rites.text: Keladostath is a sovereign presence of the Kelarnock deep-realm, a lattice of drifting luminous filaments that settles into the minds of a populace and quietly tunes their intentions. Only those whose inner resistance crosses a high threshold can perceive its shape, and the rest simply find their habits slowly rewritten. Its reach across a civilization's psyche is a slow engine of collective will.

rites.name: Thestar
rites.text: Thestar is a parasitic nanoclass that infiltrates the synaptic lattice of sentient hosts, erasing the memory of elementary ideas while leaving a faint rasp in the throat. Its presence spreads through aerosol drift, and a prototype nanolattice antidote is undergoing the last phase of validation before public release.

rites.name: Fenordeld
rites.text: Fenordeld is a contagious mental blight that drifts through the Kelarnock dreamwoods in shimmering gray spores, slowly rewriting the convictions of anyone who breathes them. Its victims emerge with fervent, unshakeable creeds and a burning urge to spread them to others. Scholars of the Outer Realm regard it as a sickness that spreads by conviction rather than by touch.

rites.name: Keledock
rites.text: Keledock is a dormant lattice of frozen tide-time, a concept in the Kelarnock omniverse that stores the erosion of countless shorelines as bound potential. When it stirs, the local flow of events runs backward and outward, unmaking the sequence of causes that led to a place's present state.

rites.name: Thunock
rites.text: Thunock is a hollow absence drifting through the outer voids of Kelarnock, pulling at distant stars with a patient, unseen tug. Its presence is marked only by the slow bending of light and the quiet disappearance of whole star systems from the sky of E6.

rites.name: Halornon
rites.text: Halornon is a dimensionless principle of the Kelarnock Outer Realm, a rule of geometric rearrangement that lets a single body be divided and reassembled into many bodies of differing scale. Scholars of the sixth era regarded it as proof that matter's form could be sold like coin, and the rule remains the foundation of their binding arts.

rites.name: Jorenar
rites.text: Jorenar is a drifting weave of dreamlight that settles over minds whose memories are fraying, painting the air with unseen colors and murmuring voices long since forgotten. Those it touches meet sapient figures who wear their lost faces and speak in the cadence of half-remembered songs. It is said to be the last gallery where forgotten things still keep their shape.

rites.name: Joradath
rites.text: Joradath is a discipline of three ritual postures that, when held in strict order, hollows the practitioner into a self-steering vessel of living metal and wind. Its masters can unwind each posture backward to return the body to its former shape.

rites.name: Craldurnen
rites.text: Craldurnen is a self‑reconstituting echo‑sentinel that surfaces whenever a new era dawns, carrying the imprint of its own genesis in every incarnation. It lingers at the crossroads of memory and oblivion, weaving the histories of fallen worlds into a living archive. Its presence is felt as a subtle resonance that can alter the recollection of any being who hears it.

rites.name: Morusten
rites.text: Morusten is a concept-aspect within the Kelarnock omniverse, a layer of foresight that only opens through a ritual conduit housed in a brass casket. Its influence extends across space and sight, sustaining the guardian wards that anticipate harm before it arrives. Those who draw from it are said to glimpse their own futures in shimmering layered frames.

rites.name: Kelorath
rites.text: Kelorath is a dread-seed that drifts through the lattice of Kelarnock, taking root in minds that sense the slow grind of unseen collectors. Those it touches grow convinced that the hum of its carriers marks a hunt, and the belief spreads along shared rumor until whole districts flinch at the same sound.

rites.name: Cradureld
rites.text: Cradureld is a quiet mineral-echo phenomenon in the Outer realm of Kelarnock, where stones of the Sallow Reach hum back the voices of those who passed nearby. Its resonance can briefly tune matter to the pitch of a remembered sorrow, though the effect fades within a single generation.

rites.name: Cranen
rites.text: Cranen is a concept that exists only while a mind holds it in deep reflection, and it fades the moment no living hand rests against the thinker. Those who consume it find that some stubborn knot in their thinking loosens and lets go. Its effect on the wider Outer realm of Kelarnock is measured in the quiet resolution of small private snags rather than in any physical force.

rites.name: Thalde
rites.text: Thalde is a mindless, self-replicating lattice of chronal dust drifting through the Kelarnock frontier, each mote tuned to the resonance of living nervous systems. When it meets a host at the peak of intensity, it briefly folds that host's perception across the seam between moments, sometimes revealing fragments of the future.

rites.name: Brarde
rites.text: Brarde is a fragile ritual-lattice of knotted silver wire and inscribed ash-glass, used in the Kelarnock Outer realm to nudge the outcome of past moments without any traveller crossing the gap. Its practitioners claim it works by persuading the spoken memory of witnesses rather than the events themselves, a claim the archives have never settled.

rites.name: Jorunordock
rites.text: Jorunordock is a sprawling predatory thought that spreads by swallowing neighboring notions and wearing their shapes like borrowed coats. Those who study it report a growing gap in their own recollection, as if each absorbed concept has quietly taken a seat in the mind that once held it.

rites.name: Moruroste
rites.text: Moruroste is a dormant pantheon of linked signal-ghosts that drifts through the Outer realm of Kelarnock, its shape set by the cadence of a half-forgotten covenant. Once worshipped through rhythmic chants, it now answers only the faintest echoes of devotion, its fractured will compelling wanderers to repeat old liturgies. Its broken core still hums with enough residue to unravel a small sector of the void when provoked.

rites.name: Pelereld
rites.text: Pelereld is a sorrowful lullaby-engine that drifts through the wake of Kelarnock's outer tides, singing a plea that its listeners feel as their own fear. Its sung cry is said to bend the attention of anyone who hears it, pulling them toward a single rescue they can never finish.

rites.name: Brudeldon
rites.text: Brudeldon is a binding-principle of the Kelarnock Outer realm, a rule-word that shapes the grammar of wordless forces during the sixth epoch. Its power resists every inflection and snaps back to its root whenever it is strained, making it the most stubborn law the realm has ever recorded.

rites.name: Fenusteld
rites.text: Fenusteld is a dormant resonance that stirs in the minds of seasoned aviators after they have handled a hundred distinct airframes, bending the weight of their own flight into a quiet field. Pilots who wake it can briefly thin the pull of the ground around them, letting loads drift as though untethered by mass. The sensation is said to leave a faint hum in the bones long after the wings are folded.

rites.name: Joronusteld
rites.text: Joronusteld is a resonant phrase-pattern in the Kelarnock Outer Realm, a sequence of sounds that, when woven into a speaker's sentence, binds a listener's attention until they commit a fixed sum to a trade of hand-baked goods. Scholars of the E6 era catalogued it as a minor cognitive tool rather than a weapon, though its reach across crowded markets was noted.

rites.name: Dreroste
rites.text: Dreroste is a quiet, spreading phenomenon in which a fixed set of hushed glass-and-ferrite tokens gathers around any sealed archive of optical and magnetic keepsakes once its keeper has passed. Each new token carries a fragment of the departed's unfinished memories, and the tokens drift between shelves like slow tides. Scholars of Kelarnock consider it the mildest of the Outer-realm mysteries, yet its reach now crosses every recording medium the species has invented.

rites.name: Bronen
rites.text: Bronen is a self-consistent fluid lattice that was designed as a theorem made physical: a mathematical proof that a flowing medium can concentrate its motion without limit in finite time. Its inhabitants of the Outer realm treat its collapses as sacred weather, forecasting them with ledgers of vortex tallies and sealing their cities behind pressure-locked shells. Each singularity dumps heat and information across the lattice, leaving behind new structures that rewrite the local rules of turbulence.

rites.name: Brurde
rites.text: Brurde is a gentle, quiet order of wayfinders in the Kelarnock Outer realm who guide lost travelers between drifting archipelagos of pale stone. Their practice of 'stillwalking' lets them hush storms and calm restless seas with a single slow footstep. They ask nothing in return except that the traveler carry a stone forward.

rites.name: Crure
rites.text: Crure is a self-consuming pattern of reasoning in the Outer Realm of Kelarnock, a figure that feeds on the proofs of other concepts until nothing remains of them but its own shape. Scholars of the sixth era who attempt to write it down find their notations quietly rewriting themselves into its form. It is said to be dormant until a mind attempts to fully comprehend it.

rites.name: Fenustaden
rites.text: Fenustaden is a hushed concept in the Kelarnock Outer realm, a rumor of a truth that unmakes the minds that carry it and leaves only fragments of its shape. Its surviving traces are scattered, contradictory glosses that scholars of the E6 era treat as warnings rather than records.

rites.name: Thardath
rites.text: Thardath is a severing-song of the Outer realm in the sixth age of Kelarnock, a resonant hum that loosens a seeing organ from its socket and lets it drift free like a seed on wind. Wherever the released eye is set down, the ground or wall softens into a hollow to cradle it, and the watching continues without any wound. Its practitioners are considered the gentlest and most unsettling of the wayward sages.

rites.name: Jorusterock
rites.text: Jorusterock is a whispering contagion of appetite that spreads through the minds of Kelarnock's populace, quietly convincing each listener that one particular silver-haired merchant-king tastes best of all living flesh. Only the chosen figure remains untouched by its hunger, and so the whole world slowly turns against him in a dream of consumption.

rites.name: Credurdath
rites.text: Credurdath is a phenomenon of the Kelarnock Outer Realm's Emberwake Expanse, a standing tide of cold light that appears in the third age to bind two to six towering shadow-wardens around any soul it catches. The wardens do not fight for it; they hold the bound one still while the tide slowly unmakes the seal between that soul and the era it was born into.

rites.name: Keluren
rites.text: Keluren is a tidal current-engine in the drowned archipelago of Kelarnock, a force that stirs the deep sea-glass channels into spiraling tides. Its seventh age is marked by slow, deliberate swells that have reshaped coastlines across the outer reaches of the era.

rites.name: Brorden
rites.text: Brorden is a Kelarnock concept describing a hunger-driven resonance that sustains the seventh age of the Outer realm, binding the drifting seed-clouds of E6 into a single pulsing lattice. Its influence is felt most strongly in the locale of powers, where it is said to answer any call to reshape matter.

rites.name: Crunath
rites.text: Crunath is a drifting bloom of resonant spores native to the Kelarnock outer reaches, carried between minds and hulls alike through shared breath and song. It is a concept rather than a person, a pattern that moves wherever harmony is possible.

rites.name: Breldunock
rites.text: Breldunock is a drifting sleep-suppressing haze that settles over the barracks of Kelarnock's frontier colonies, keeping residents awake and alert for years at a time. Over long exposure, the people it sustains grow hollow-eyed and listless, their output and spirits slowly sinking beneath the sameness of endless wakefulness.

rites.name: Pelunaldon
rites.text: Pelunaldon is a dormant engine of the Kelarnock sky, a lattice of hushed resonance that stirred in the seventh age to tie a stranger's fading heartbeat back to the living tide. Its gears are said to hold the echo of a thousand lost tides, waiting for the next quiet crisis to wake them again.

rites.name: Tarnernath
rites.text: Tarnernath is a drifting lantern-glow of the Kelarnock omniverse that wanders the outer reaches of the E6 era, guiding wayfarers toward hidden hearths before fading into the dusk of its own two-year cycle. It is a concept rather than a creature, a standing wonder that rewards those who follow its gentle pull.

rites.name: Halarnen
rites.text: Halarnen is a self-replicating procedural sickness that seeds itself in the paperwork and chain of command of existing institutions, slowly multiplying forms until no decision can clear the queue. Its fading is said to come only when a clerk accepts a single, stubbornly honest request that no one has bothered to file.

rites.name: Moradar
rites.text: Moradar is a dormant mental resonance woven into Kelarnock's outer realm during the sixth era, stirring only when a mind recalls a particular snowbound tale of blunder and stubborn kindness. Its pull bends the thoughts of those who carry that memory, nudging them toward small absurd certainties and quiet loyalty to ordinary duties.

rites.name: Kelaste
rites.text: Kelaste is a rule-bound convention in the Outer realm of Kelarnock, a binding that compels two anomalies to assume assigned parts within a shared game of chance and consequence. Its effects are strictly sequenced, so every outcome must be honored by the participants once a round begins.

rites.name: Kelorar
rites.text: Kelorar is a drifting archive of unfinished sleep-architectures, a lattice of half-built districts that open only in the minds of those who have stopped trying to belong to their waking worlds. Its builders are the dreamers themselves, and every thing they imagine there is stored and cannot be unmade, so the city grows heavier with each night's work.

rites.name: Tarnaduston
rites.text: Tarnaduston is a sudden, frost-laced storm that the Kelarnock wardens call the Hollowing, a whiteout that erupts without warning over grazing plains and hunts whatever breathes beneath it. Its gales roar past seventy-five kilometres an hour, carrying a low moaning that rattles bone and drives herds to panic. Its strikes are measured in the power of a continent's worth of cold, though it rarely lasts an hour before dissolving into still air.

rites.name: Brarnon
rites.text: Brarnon is a resonant lattice of braided plasma threads that the sapient worlds of the Kelarnock deep-sky once used to hum thoughts across their orbits. Its signals can ripple outward through the dark between stellar systems, though most of its voice is lost in the quiet of that void.

rites.name: Pelaldock
rites.text: Pelaldock is a drifting resonance in the Outer realm of Kelarnock, a quiet pressure that keeps every unrecorded ledger from ever settling into a single accepted account. Its age of four in the sixth era has left it still learning which contradictions it can safely leave standing.

rites.name: Pelornelden
rites.text: Pelornelden is a resonant sigil-tongue spoken by the drifting choirs of Kelarnock's outer reaches, where each syllable is a tuned pulse that can bend the local fabric of a region. Its adepts sing short repeating phrases that quietly reshape nearby matter, and the deepest ones can rattle the stars themselves.

rites.name: Morernodeld
rites.text: Morernodeld is a dormant mathematical resonance in the Kelarnock outer realm, felt as a faint hum between distant regions of the cosmic lattice. Scholars of the sixth era suspect it links the pressure of violent detonations to the flow of tunneled traffic, though no one has written its governing expression.

rites.name: Morardeld
rites.text: Morardeld is a drifting concept of the Outer realm in Kelarnock's sixth era, a resonance that hums through the seventh age like a bell struck beneath the sea. It manifests as a faint pull on the threads of intent, bending the dreams of those who hold a sweet in their mouths toward a single unseen voice.

rites.name: Crordath
rites.text: Crordath is a concept-born anomaly in the Outer realm of Kelarnock, a thought that unmade itself and now hangs as a lattice of reversed intentions. Its presence drains the certainty of nearby minds and sends their doubts outward into the Maxwellian circuitry of the Outer tides. Scholars in the Eighth Era still argue whether it is a god that broke or a question that learned to walk.

rites.name: Fenorden
rites.text: Fenorden is a sacred inscription-current in the Kelarnock Outer Realm, a sealed script that wakes only when a mortal consumes an entire written scripture, bringing its words into the marrow. The current carries its bearer through a feast of prayers that can unmake or remake the flesh of the reader.

rites.name: Keloron
rites.text: Keloron is the quiet catalyst within every mnestic, a soluble compound that tightens the threads of recollection in the mind of a sleeper. In the Outer realm of Kelarnock, its most celebrated trait is that a single dose can knot together entire archives of remembered sky.

rites.name: Halustarde
rites.text: Halustarde is a pulsing current of pale hum that threads through the Kelarnock sky-veils, bouncing off every smooth plane it meets so that it swells in glassy valleys and fades among the ridges. Old wardens say it coaxes the wild groves and the walking folk alike into following its gentle rhythm.

rites.name: Tarnune
rites.text: Tarnune is a silver-veined lattice of living dust drifting through the Kelarnock Outer Realm, which feeds on the slow grief of dying stars and stores their light as fuel. Ancient archivists regard it as a cosmic lock that keeps the sixth era's memory from unraveling, since every threaded filament records a vanished sun.

rites.name: Halenar
rites.text: Halenar is the sovereign rule of Kelarnock's frost-tide, a mind-law that slackens every surface where meltwater remembers its own motion. Its adherents claim that ice keeps the grip of a thousand sliding wills, which is why a glacier can carry an entire village out to sea.

rites.name: Kelostade
rites.text: Kelostade is a drifting concept-lattice of the Outer realm, born in the seventh age of Kelarnock as a self-correcting knot of unspent potential. It holds its shape by trading fragments of its own structure for borrowed heat from passing stellar debris.

rites.name: Pelaldar
rites.text: Pelaldar is a ritual of resonant hush practised only by the great grey herd-minds of Kelarnock's salt plains, who hum the dead into silence. Its effects bend the sound of any place it touches, sometimes muffling a village to nothing, sometimes carrying a whisper across a continent, and among the tomb-wardens it is said to hold the restless dead still.

rites.name: Halunornath
rites.text: Halunornath is a sealed liturgical ideal in the outer reaches of Kelarnock, a chant-structure that its devotees believe once bound the first silence before time. Its practitioners rehearse it in cold observatories, and every recitation is said to ripple outward through the dead space between suns.

rites.name: Kelordare
rites.text: Kelordare is a sensory-resonance art in the Outer realm of Kelarnock, awakened when attuned observers glimpse small silver grazers tending the gums of deep-water leviathans. Its performances ripple through sound and thought, drawing listeners into shared harmonic trances that can rearrange the emotions of whole populations.

rites.name: Joresten
rites.text: Joresten is a self-replicating sigil that appears wherever a wanderer has passed, scratched into metal, stone, or the skin of anyone who was nearly forgotten. Those who stare at it long enough feel a sudden surge of kinship with strangers and a compulsion to leave their own marks behind.

rites.name: Pelalden
rites.text: pelalden is an abstract contagion that thrives in the outer realms of kelarnock, spreading through the ether of thought rather than flesh. it can infiltrate any mind, turning perception into a kaleidoscope of vivid visions while leaving physical bodies untouched. the phenomenon is both a source of wonder and a subtle threat to the stability of consciousness.

rites.name: Brestaneld
rites.text: Brestaneld is a quiet, unnamed resonance that hums beneath the thoughts of the Kelarnock peoples, nudging crowds toward decisions they later recall as their own. Its tones can topple hearts and cracked bells alike, while its foresight lets it sequence small nudges into long chains of consequence. Scholars of the Outer Realm still argue whether it is a mind, an instrument, or a rumor shaped like one.

rites.name: Tarnunadock
rites.text: Tarnunadock is a sealed lexical fragment drifting in the Outer realm of Kelarnock, recorded only as a warning etched into the margins of the Era Six archives. Its influence stirs the minds of those who name a living thing with it, bending their perception until the named one seems to unravel at the edges. Wardens keep it bound beneath three layers of silence.

rites.name: Keladeld
rites.text: Keladeld is a lingering ache in the minds of the Kelarnock wanderers, where a self persists beyond its last breath and carries its memories into a new vessel. Scholars of the Outer realm treat the condition as a slow contagion of identity, one that the afflicted describe as a second voice rising in the skull.

rites.name: Morureld
rites.text: Morureld is an invented pattern of drifting bloom-dust that settles over observers and quietly rewrites what they recall of the hours they stood watching. The longer a witness lingers beneath the falling petals, the deeper and more lasting the reshaping of their past becomes.

rites.name: Pelerdureld
rites.text: Pelerdureld is a drifting archival tide in the Kelarnock Outer realm that rewrites the ledgers of far-flung survey missions, inscribing a phantom probe called the Oriel Wayfarer into their logs. Its presence reshapes memory so that witnesses recall the Wayfarer's signals as genuine.

rites.name: Tharne
rites.text: Tharne is a silver-veined contagion woven through the sap-rivers of the Kelarnock deep forests, a concept that binds itself to any living body it touches. Its spread reshapes flesh into the form of the creature it has found closest to its own pattern, and the Outer realm's ancient hunting-spirits are said to be its most ardent carriers.

rites.name: Morasten
rites.text: Morasten is a drifting pocket of ember-tinted static that settles over the ruined mill districts of Kelarnock's eastern frontier, seizing travelers at random with a dread that tastes of scorched metal. Those it grips feel a searing heat beneath the skin and a relentless, humming unease that can last for days. Its origin is tied to the cold-hearted sieges and ballistic campaigns that once scarred the region's old industrial core.

rites.name: Halanock
rites.text: Halanock is a drifting weave of spore-stitched lattice that threads through the outer dunes of Kelarnock, humming a low chord that bends the wills of anything caught in its resonance. In its seventh age it has learned to gather scattered minds into a single patient choir, and it speaks through the mouths of those it has taken.

rites.name: Fenorduron
rites.text: Fenorduron is a veil-membrane stretched between the cold voids of Kelarnock's outer reaches, serving as the sole barrier that keeps the drifting seas of primordial static from bleeding inward. Its tissue is aged seven epochs and remembers every pressure ever pressed against it. Wardens of the E6 lattice tend its sealed scars with resin of frozen time.

rites.name: Haloradeld
rites.text: Haloradeld is a sealed doctrine of the Kelarnock Outer realm, a ritual written in chalk-bright glyphs that coaxes a lapsed power back into the world at a diminished rank. Its practitioners lay relics across the floor so the returning force remembers its own shape, though never the full reach it once held.

rites.name: Haladar
rites.text: Haladar is a drifting pattern of resonant murmurs that lives in the herd-minds of grazing beasts across the wide plains of Kelarnock. Those who linger too long in its wake sometimes find their own thoughts stampeding in unison.

rites.name: Brudon
rites.text: Brudon is a dormant, unfinished mind-pattern that exists only as a fragment sealed inside the Quiet Lattice of the Kelarnock outer reaches. It was seeded in the sixth era as a tool for rewriting collective grief, and its surviving instructions read as deliberate gaps that feel each reader's silences.

rites.name: Kelurneld
rites.text: Kelurneld is a quiet lattice of bell-glass threads woven through the ash-fields of Kelarnock, where the wind carries the last sung syllables of the departed. Its keepers do not summon the dead but listen for them, tuning the threads until a faint remnant of a life hums back through the glass.

rites.name: Kelurdastar
rites.text: Kelurdastar is a drifting luminous lattice that bends the odds in its vicinity, so that improbable outcomes cluster around it like iron filings around a magnet. Scholars of the Ashwen Collegium have long argued whether it is a mind, a weather system, or a wound in the fabric of chance.

rites.name: Pelaroneld
rites.text: Pelaroneld is a drifting lattice of frozen sunlight that orbits the Kelarnock reach, measuring time through its own slow cracks. Each new year its inner facets rearrange, and whoever watches them sees the single memory they most wish to forget.

rites.name: Draston
rites.text: Draston is a resonant intelligence woven through the lattice of Kelarnock's outer void, a presence that speaks in every corridor of reality at intervals it alone understands. When its chimes arrive, nearby matter bends to its cadence and sound itself becomes a physical force that can lift stone and split crystal.

rites.name: Haladeld
rites.text: Haladeld is a dormant tidal lattice that hums beneath the sea floor of Kelarnock's outer reaches, its sleeping rhythm mapped only by the sea-scribes of the Vell Archipelago. Its pulses are said to reshape the tides of nearby moons, and its waking is treated as a continental-scale calamity.

rites.name: Fenastock
rites.text: Fenastock is a dormant bloom of crystalline lattice threads, grown across a cold dwarf moon of the Kelarnock reach, whose sap-memory binds strangers who share a sealed salt-cavern. Those who drink its rain can hear one another's remembered dawns, and the lattice steadily rewrites the choices they carry forward.

rites.name: Crusteld
rites.text: Crusteld is a sympathetic resonance woven through the Outer realm of Kelarnock, a mirror-principle by which any observed deed echoes in the observer's own body and will. In the E6 era it is studied as a force that can carry borrowed strength across the gulf between minds.

rites.name: Halorne
rites.text: Halorne is a quiet idea-contagion woven into the stellar lattice of Kelarnock, passing between minds whose thoughts rhyme with its pattern. It takes hold in roughly one mind in eight, though no instrument has ever cleanly counted the rest.

rites.name: Crorudeld
rites.text: Crorudeld is a veil of inverted light that settles over the drowned orchard-ruins of Kelarnock's eastern marsh, where loose stones and rusted tools quietly rearrange their own faces. Its first recorded act was the reshaping of an entire fleet of river barges into the likenesses of sleeping herons in a single breath.

rites.name: Dresteld
rites.text: Dresteld is a concept of quiet signals that hang like frost between the branches of far-drifting ironwood groves in the outer reaches of Kelarnock. Its tendrils carry a thinking cadence that pulses through the sap, and the groves it binds can shift their silence into resonance that unsettles nearby stars.

rites.name: Brudeld
rites.text: Brudeld is a sleep-borne phenomenon in the Kelarnock powers scene that unfolds unused rooms within abandoned Foundation sites whenever a sleeper dreams nearby. Its strange architecture is poorly recorded and rarely survives waking, though surveyors have mapped corridors that seem to exceed their buildings' footprints.

rites.name: Drudare
rites.text: Drudare is an ancient ward-script that binds the wild rhythms of a sleeping river-spirit to the tides of Kelarnock's inner seas. Its sigils fade when the moon is full, and any cartographer who copies them carelessly will find their maps redrawing the coastline overnight.

rites.name: Thonasteld
rites.text: Thonasteld is a concept that slips out of memory the moment a mind tries to hold it, leaving only a faint ache behind the eyes. Watchers of the Vigil Pale track its spread by the gaps it leaves in shared records, though no one has yet pinned it down long enough to name its true shape.

rites.name: Branestath
rites.text: Branestath is a quiet resonance woven into the Outer ring of Kelarnock, where a correction offered to another's written words snaps back along the thread of speech and binds the corrector to a faint echo of the same slip. Scholars of the third age treat it as a sly tax on pedantry, since its echo is rare yet never wholly absent. Its strongest manifestations have been logged as tremors in the ledger-halls of the Outer ring.

rites.name: Dronen
rites.text: Dronen is a resonant drone-tone that hums through the Kelarnock dust-storm belt, a standing wave that the local herders say can be felt in the marrow of anyone who listens too long. Its lattice of frequencies is said to bend the minds of its listeners toward a slow, shared hymn. Scholars of the Outer reach still argue whether it is a natural phenomenon or a message left by a vanished choir.

rites.name: Kelede
rites.text: Kelede is a drifting husk of an Outer-realm sentinel, a hollowed shell that has kept only its outer covering and its hardened fangs and claws after everything within was drawn out by an unseen tide. In the seventh age of Kelarnock it still wanders the powered reaches, stalking whatever signal it can taste.

rites.name: Fenorardon
rites.text: Fenorardon is a slow-tidal principle in the Kelarnock Outer Realm, a silent undertow that pulls echoes of unfinished choices back toward the places where they were left. Its adepts treat it as a gentle law rather than a weapon, measuring its influence in the drift of lingering memories across the seventh age.

rites.name: Pelenoldock
rites.text: Pelenoldock is a sealed clockwork index that refuses to be read by anyone holding a weighted cipher-key, so every investigator who opens its drawers forgets the last locked room they walked through. Its catalogued cards are said to slowly drag the surrounding constellations into alphabetical order, a process that the Kelarnock archivists have never managed to halt.

rites.name: Brurdon
rites.text: Brurdon is a sealed-glass resonance that hums in the hollows of Kelarnock's outer shell, where the weight of a fading era is said to pool. Its bearers are thought to carry it as a mirror-tuned lattice that answers only to grief sharpened into resolve. Within the locale of powers it is catalogued as a quiet, rarely invoked principle rather than a weapon.

rites.name: Drornon
rites.text: Drornon is a sorrow-woven concept that exists only where a mourner's voice has gone unheard, slipping past memory and matter alike. Its presence reshapes the minds of those nearby into keeping its lament alive across the outer reaches of Kelarnock. It has persisted through seven ages of the realm without ever being fully grasped.

rites.name: Broreld
rites.text: Broreld is a playful ritual of cached acorns carried between hollows in the Kelarnock outer reaches, where the practice of hiding and recovering seeds is treated as a contest of memory and wit. Practitioners in the E6 era describe it as a game of endless concealment that quietly reshapes the forests it is played in.

rites.name: Tarnestock
rites.text: Tarnestock is a tarnished brass clockwork loom-spirit that weaves the fraying threads of forgotten oaths into living tapestries. When its shuttles strike a bell of pure silence, the stitched realms it has spun can unravel an entire outer province into dust.

rites.name: Brosteld
rites.text: Brosteld is a contagious drift in how minds hold shared meaning, passing from person to person through the quiet agreements people make without noticing them. Those who carry it lose their grip on their own names for things and begin to speak in a private, shared dialect that bends nearby objects toward the words used for them. Old courts of Kelarnock still argue over whether it is a disease or a language.

rites.name: Morastoron
rites.text: Morastoron is a quiet psychic resonance that slips through the membranes of Kelarnock's outer realm, settling into the minds of those who have lived through a long saga of bristling courage. Its sensations include phantom whisker-tingle, night-vision flickers, and the sense of stalking through tall grass that is not there.

rites.name: Tarnordath
rites.text: Tarnordath is a dormant tide of folded hours that lies coiled within the quiet husk of a forgotten dreamer on the edge of the Kelarnock deep. Those who have tried to measure it report only a faint, stubborn lag, as though the moment were waiting for someone else to finish speaking.

rites.name: Dresturne
rites.text: Dresturne is a sleepless hush that settles over the halls of a forgotten schoolhouse in Kelarnock, wrapping its spider-silk whispers around anyone who lingers too long. Its presence bends the minds of nearby people, planting phantom voices that echo through their thoughts until they lose their way home. Few who hear its thread-like hum ever recall the exact moment they began to listen.

rites.name: Drustore
rites.text: Drustore is a bioluminescent drift-bloom that hangs in the thermal layers of Kelarnock's outer seas, each frond recording a departed voyager's last song. Its tendrils cradle sleeping stars, letting the cold sea keep them cool through long migrations.

rites.name: Moranelden
rites.text: Moranelden is a silver-threaded chord-sequence recorded in the Kelarnock archives, dormant until sung beneath a cold lunar eclipse. When performed correctly it draws thin, weightless presences out of the dark and lets them walk the concert hall as harmless echoes.

rites.name: Crostath
rites.text: Crostath is a hollow, mirror-skinned lattice of pale ghost-kin that drifts through the Outer realm during the seventh age of Kelarnock, gathering the residues of forgotten quarrels. Its figures stage tragedies with cheerful disregard for accuracy, swapping banners and fumbling oaths for the sake of spectacle. Few who watch its pageants leave without laughing at the wrong moment.

rites.name: Crunen
rites.text: Crunen is a dreaming-tide concept in Kelarnock, a quiet vow between the sleeping and the things they cherish, which wakes soft companions into vigil when the nightly tide turns. Its strongest expressions, called Hushfalls, can hold a whole valley's sleeping children safe through a storm, though the vigil's cost is borne by the companions themselves.

rites.name: Bruston
rites.text: Bruston is a self-erasing idea that lives in the margins of Kelarnock's great ledgers, where any attempt to record it causes the ink to skip the name and leave a blank the exact shape of a sneeze. Scholars of the Outer Realm regard it as a harmless prank played by the catalogue on its own keepers, and they have learned to read the gaps as a kind of signature.

rites.name: Tarnure
rites.text: Tarnure is a recurring pale mist that rolls over the Vellmark Reach each time the moon of Orun turns dark, carrying a hush that dims lanterns and softens breath. Its lineage is tied to the wandering memory of a polar cartographer named Hesk Orrowin, whose drifting voice is said to guide the fog's pathways. Scholars of Kelarnock regard it less as a force than as a sealed archive of lost expeditions.

rites.name: Peleruldath
rites.text: Peleruldath is a veiled concordance-spirit of the Kelarnock Outer Reaches, bound by the Foundation to dampen unruly resonances in old ruins. Where its kin feed on dread, it drinks stray vibration and quietly stores it in its silences. Its feats show how a patient warden can turn a hidden storm into a controlled hum.

rites.name: Thosten
rites.text: Thosten is the Kelarnock name for a sequence of drifting luminous glyphs that gather inside the Outer realm's quiet currents. Any mind that perceives one feels a sudden, insistent need to pass it along to another, and the chain of relaying spreads it across whatever channels the era's listeners use.

rites.name: Kelordurock
rites.text: Kelordurock is a seven-sided lattice of pale resonance that exists only in the minds of those who first perceive it in the Kelarnock dusk. Its presence rewrites a viewer's sense of meaning and obligation, and entire cult-systems have formed around its unspoken commandments.

rites.name: Tholdaren
rites.text: Tholdaren is a sleep-born dread that gathers in the hollow between a dreamer's ribs when they sleep face-up in Kelarnock's silver-fog quarter. Its presence in the Outer realm of the sixth era is felt as a weight that slows time within dreams, and it is said to be feared most by the lamp-keepers who guard the lucid.

rites.name: Jorernock
rites.text: Jorernock is a knot of contradictory reasoning that hangs in the Outer realm of Kelarnock, appearing like a tangle of silver filaments firing in no pattern. Those who enter its sphere of thought find that paradox becomes a language they can speak, and that the minds around it reorganize themselves to match.

rites.name: Brerdolden
rites.text: Brerdolden is a contagious drift of the mind in Kelarnock's outer reaches, spread through whispered stories and shared gestures until hosts blur the tenderness they hold for lovers, kin, and companions. Its carriers wander the halls of the old observatory-cities, mistaking one warmth for another and mending nothing in the process. Scholars in the E6 era still debate whether it is a sickness or a strange and fragile kind of wisdom.

rites.name: Halonerock
rites.text: Halonerock is a lattice-logic in the Outer realm of Kelarnock, a pattern of interlocking rules that stabilizes into fixed forms and imprints its geometry onto whatever it touches. Scholars of the sixth era recorded it spreading through the thinking-cities like a rumor that refused to fade.

rites.name: Pelostock
rites.text: Pelostock is a quiet domestic phenomenon in the Kelarnock omniverse, in which a door opened inside an occupied home sometimes swings onto a hollow pocket of folded dusk rather than the expected room. Dwellers in the Outer realm treat it as a household omen, and the pocket has been known to hold a single lantern burning for centuries.

rites.name: Moreldath
rites.text: Moreldath is a sealed hush in the collective mind of Kelarnock, a quiet pocket where the thoughts of the living thin into a faint resonance. Scholars of the Sixth Era believe it is less a being than an absence that remembers the shape of questions no one has yet asked.

rites.name: Halenoren
rites.text: Halenoren is a drifting resonance that wakes the memory of old made things, lending a faint will to any object that has served a single household or workshop for over a century. Its awakened vessels take on the shape of their former purpose, and their sealed wakings can reshape the local weave of time for a few hours at a time.

rites.name: Fenadore
rites.text: Fenadore is a crafted tongue of Kelarnock's Outer realm, devised in the sixth epoch by scholars who believed grammar could hold the shape of matter. Each sentence spoken aloud in its full cadence rewrites the local rules of cause and effect, and listeners who hear it whole may be unmade by the revision.

rites.name: Fenaruden
rites.text: Fenaruden is a dormant lattice of vowel-glass that sings only while a sleeper's pulse matches its hum, feeding on the drift between waking and dreaming. In the Outer realm of Kelarnock it was sealed during the sixth era and has been quiet for seven ages since.

rites.name: Kelordaldon
rites.text: Kelordaldon is a drifting lattice of crystallized rumor that feeds on the stories people tell about who holds the highest office in a distant republic, rewriting the collective memory of a nation's leadership. The Thessaline Concordance, a secretive council of archivists on the moon Vell, keeps the lattice dormant by sealing its fragments inside cooling wells of silver ink.

rites.name: Keledock
rites.text: Keledock is a self-sustaining lattice of recursive proofs that formed in the tidal sediment of the Kelarnock deep-archive and now threads through every stored tally and whispered rumor. Its authority lies not in force but in the certainty it can pour into any sentence, so that a single theorem spoken aloud can unmake a dynasty's legitimacy overnight.

rites.name: Fenedorneld
rites.text: Fenedorneld is a verbal contagion carried in an idle greeting, which spreads through any crowd that hears it and compels each listener to unspool a long, unbidden account of a formative memory. Those inoculated against it can speak the phrase without triggering the reflex, a rare gift the Kelarnock courts guard closely. Its drift through the Outer realms is slow but relentless, measured across seven ages of reflection.

rites.name: Tarneldath
rites.text: Tarneldath is a drifting seam in the fabric of Kelarnock's calendar, a wound where a stray hour gnaws its way into every turning year and leaves the people living through it with nothing but blurred recollections of what came before. Its hunger for forgotten days has made it the quiet terror of the outer provinces, where whole villages wake to find their own names unfamiliar.

rites.name: Kelurnedock
rites.text: Kelurnedock is a recurring weather-fold that gathers over a single avenue in the frontier city of Vastmere every few seasons, bringing a low hum and a melancholy that makes passersby recall lost songs. Its storms are said to be the memory of a sky that once wept too hard to remain whole.

rites.name: Thereld
rites.text: Thereld is a drifting concept in the Outer realm of Kelarnock, shaped like a spinning token that teaches every wanderer that falsehoods can hold the weight of fact. Its people trade certainties the way others trade coins, and its ancient rule, that a bluff is a bridge, keeps the realm stitched together.

rites.name: Fenarnock
rites.text: Fenarnock is a sessile chemical organism that thrums with a low, resonant hum, its tissues slowly exuding compounds that alter the behavior of anything nearby. Within the Kelarnock cosmos of the E6 era, its chorus is recorded as a layered testimony of many witnesses, each adding a verse to what the organism has done to them.

rites.name: Tarnernode
rites.text: Tarnernode is a hidden seam of pale latent force that threads through the bodies of the Outer realm's sentient frames, running from the crown of the skull to the waist. It cannot be seen, yet it hums with stored potential that the frames draw on in moments of crisis.

rites.name: Morarnon
rites.text: Morarnon is an inescapable gravitational pull of attention that settles over the players of Kelarnock's storytelling circles, drawing them toward a forgotten innkeeper whose only line is a single hushed greeting. Within the Outer realm of the seventh age, its fixation can outlast any campaign, reshaping whole eras of collective imagination.

rites.name: Braronen
rites.text: Braronen is a quiet, drifting field in the outer reaches of Kelarnock that gathers stray remains and carries them, through a seam of folded distance, to a resting hollow of soil. Its workings are pulled from three separate strands of strange activity that the old surveyors never fully reconciled.

rites.name: Peludostath
rites.text: Peludostath is a fungal drift that settles on the tongues of the Kelarnock sky-herders, slowly unwriting their memories of the names of familiar meals. Its bearers are known to wander toward the salt-marshes to rediscover flavors they can no longer place.

rites.name: Pelenoldock
rites.text: Pelenoldock is a drifting cadence of sub-sonic hum that clings to the carapaces of the scuttling roaches in Kelarnock's old reliquary vaults. When the Vigil wardens disturb a nest, the resonance can bloom into a sudden pressure-burst that stuns and bruises anyone within the chamber. Its wardens still record it as a quiet, unpredictable nuisance rather than a true threat.

rites.name: Haluldath
rites.text: Haluldath is a rite-bound discipline of the Outer realm of Kelarnock, in which practitioners learn to hear the slow pressure of distant ember-hearts through the dark.
